ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-11\,;\,3\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&3\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-11\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(32\,;\,-7\,;\,-79\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{32^2+\left(-7\right)^2+\left(-79\right)^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{7314}=\frac{\sqrt{7314}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=\frac{\sqrt{7314}}{2}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-6\,;\,26\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\left(-36\right)^2+\left(-6\right)^2+26^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{2008}=\sqrt{502}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=\sqrt{502}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,23\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{18^2+23^2+\left(-24\right)^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1429}=\frac{\sqrt{1429}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=\frac{\sqrt{1429}}{2}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times1-\left(-1\right)\times7\right)=\left(10\,;\,-14\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{10^2+\left(-14\right)^2+8^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{360}=3 \sqrt{10}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=3 \sqrt{10}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-9\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-6\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-54\,;\,-38\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\left(-54\right)^2+\left(-38\right)^2+6^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{4396}=\sqrt{1099}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=\sqrt{1099}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times6-8\times3\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times6\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-60\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\left(-24\right)^2+\left(-60\right)^2+\left(-12\right)^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{4320}=6 \sqrt{30}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=6 \sqrt{30}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\9&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times9-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,19\,;\,26\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{28^2+19^2+26^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{1821}=\frac{\sqrt{1821}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=\frac{\sqrt{1821}}{2}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times0-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{0^2+\left(-4\right)^2+0^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{16}=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=2}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនាផលគុណវ៉ិចទ័រ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នា ហើយគណនាផ្ទៃក្រឡាត្រីកោណ $ABC$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $\vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times8-7\times3\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. ដោយ $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\neq\vec{0}$ នោះ $A\,,\,B\,,\,C$ មិនរត់ត្រង់គ្នាទេ ។
$$S_{ABC}=\frac{1}{2}\left\|\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right\|=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{3^2+\left(-5\right)^2+\left(-13\right)^2}=\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{203}=\frac{\sqrt{203}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{S_{ABC}=\frac{\sqrt{203}}{2}}$ ឯកតាផ្ទៃក្រឡា ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-7&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-9\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times9-4\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,4\times0-\left(-9\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\right)=\left(10\,;\,81\,;\,63\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times0+81\times\left(-1\right)+63\times8=423$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times423=\frac{141}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{141}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times6-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times1-1\times6\right)=\left(-5\,;\,30\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times8+30\times2+0\times2=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&7\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times5-\left(-5\right)\times3\right)=\left(45\,;\,-7\,;\,50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times4+\left(-7\right)\times4+50\times\left(-3\right)=2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-9\times6\,;\,9\times3-2\times5\,;\,2\times6-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(-59\,;\,17\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-59\right)\times2+17\times7+15\times4=61$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times61=\frac{61}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times1-6\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(43\,;\,-36\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=43\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-4\right)+13\times8=-53$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times53=\frac{53}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-11\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-11\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&-3\\-11&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-11\\-4&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,12\,;\,-44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-6\right)+12\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-44\right)\times\left(-5\right)=100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&9\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-9\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,9\times7-5\times5\right)=\left(18\,;\,-2\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times0+\left(-2\right)\times9+38\times\left(-1\right)=-56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-11\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&8\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times6-8\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-10\right)+5\times1+\left(-2\right)\times2=-39$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times39=\frac{13}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&8\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-8\times6\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-6\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-42\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-42\right)\times1+\left(-6\right)\times4+\left(-6\right)\times10=-126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\6&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times3-0\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,0\times6-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-8\right)\times6\right)=\left(-24\,;\,0\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times0+0\times\left(-7\right)+48\times9=432$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times432=72$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=72}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,11\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,8\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&8\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&11\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times2-8\times7\,;\,8\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-11\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,-46\,;\,59\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-46\right)\times8+59\times10=392$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times392=\frac{196}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{196}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-10\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-10&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-11\\-11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-6\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(56\,;\,-119\,;\,98\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=56\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-119\right)\times\left(-5\right)+98\times\left(-4\right)=-133$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times133=\frac{133}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{133}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,18\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-1\right)+18\times5+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-7\right)=174$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times174=29$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=29}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-10\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times5-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-2\times5\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-18\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-6\right)\times2=186$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times186=31$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=31}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-8\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-48\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-48\right)\times5+\left(-32\right)\times10=-728$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times728=\frac{364}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{364}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-8\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,8\times1-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\right)=\left(32\,;\,8\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-2\right)+8\times1+6\times2=-44$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times44=\frac{22}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{22}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-0\times5\,;\,0\times9-2\times4\,;\,2\times5-\left(-3\right)\times9\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-8\,;\,37\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-1\times2\,;\,1\times0-0\times1\,;\,0\times2-4\times0\right)=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times3+0\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-3\right)=6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,17\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times33=\frac{11}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-10\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&4\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-10\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times8-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times4-5\times8\right)=\left(25\,;\,-68\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times8+\left(-68\right)\times11+\left(-24\right)\times1=-572$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times572=\frac{286}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{286}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times6-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(54\,;\,-24\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=54\times3+\left(-24\right)\times6+6\times0=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-10\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-2\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-10\\-4&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,3\,;\,-90\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times6+3\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-90\right)\times3=-453$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times453=\frac{151}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{151}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-3\times1\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times9+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-7\right)\times1=-86$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times86=\frac{43}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-6\times2\,;\,6\times2-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times2\right)=\left(-20\,;\,16\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-4\right)+16\times0+4\times8=112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-7\times3\,;\,7\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times6\right)=\left(-6\,;\,36\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times9+36\times3+24\times0=54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times5-3\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,35\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times6+35\times6+27\times\left(-3\right)=189$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times189=\frac{63}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{63}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\5&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times5-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-15\,;\,-30\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-30\right)\times2+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-6\right)=144$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times144=24$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=24}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-50\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-50\right)\times2+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,8\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times2+8\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-7\right)=54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times1-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(30\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-3\right)+0\times\left(-6\right)+5\times\left(-1\right)=-95$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times95=\frac{95}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{95}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-9\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&5\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times1-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times7-5\times1\,;\,5\times1-\left(-5\right)\times7\right)=\left(4\,;\,-68\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times1+\left(-68\right)\times\left(-3\right)+40\times\left(-4\right)=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-10\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\8&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times8-2\times4\,;\,2\times\left(-10\right)-1\times8\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-56\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times4+\left(-56\right)\times1+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-7\right)=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,11\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\11&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&8\\3&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times3-\left(-4\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-\left(-7\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times11-8\times3\right)=\left(68\,;\,9\,;\,-101\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=68\times\left(-5\right)+9\times2+\left(-101\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-19$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times19=\frac{19}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&8\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times4-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-7\times4\,;\,7\times5-8\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(47\,;\,-25\,;\,43\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=47\times5+\left(-25\right)\times3+43\times1=203$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times203=\frac{203}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{203}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-43\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times3+\left(-43\right)\times0+38\times1=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-5\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,5\times7-2\times3\right)=\left(36\,;\,-3\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times3+\left(-3\right)\times8+29\times\left(-6\right)=-90$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times90=15$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=15}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-2\times8\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-9\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times0+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-36\right)\times0=45$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times45=\frac{15}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{15}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&8\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-7\times3\,;\,7\times6-8\times1\,;\,8\times3-4\times6\right)=\left(-17\,;\,34\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times0+34\times4+0\times3=136$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times136=\frac{68}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{68}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-5\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-6\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times0+14\times\left(-4\right)=64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-2\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-5\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times10+23\times\left(-6\right)=-138$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times138=23$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=23}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,-16\,;\,40\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&9\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-3\right)-3\times9\,;\,3\times1-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times9-9\times1\right)=\left(-54\,;\,21\,;\,45\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-54\right)\times\left(-2\right)+21\times6+45\times0=234$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=39}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-8\times4\,;\,8\times5-\left(-1\right)\times6\right)=\left(16\,;\,-56\,;\,46\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,11\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
