ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times193=\frac{193}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{193}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times8-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times4-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\right)=\left(-56\,;\,16\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times3+16\times\left(-1\right)+38\times\left(-3\right)=-298$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times298=\frac{149}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{149}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&10\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-4\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-10\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,10\times6-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(46\,;\,25\,;\,72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=46\times0+25\times0+72\times\left(-3\right)=-216$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times216=36$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=36}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-6\right)+3\times2=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-14\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-11\right)+18\times\left(-4\right)=78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times1-8\times0\,;\,8\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times5+0\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-38\right)\times\left(-7\right)=266$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times266=\frac{133}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{133}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-1\times5\,;\,1\times3-2\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,2\times5-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(11\,;\,19\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times6+19\times\left(-2\right)+16\times\left(-8\right)=-100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times4-2\times9\,;\,2\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-4\right)\times0=3$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times3=\frac{1}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times1+1\times0+\left(-9\right)\times3=-10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-1\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times0-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times1-5\times0\right)=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)+4\times5+4\times2=58$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times58=\frac{29}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-4&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times11-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(73\,;\,20\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=73\times1+20\times3+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-6\right)=349$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times349=\frac{349}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{349}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,10\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\10&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&10\\8&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-6\right)-0\times10\,;\,0\times8-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times10-10\times8\right)=\left(-60\,;\,6\,;\,-70\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-60\right)\times0+6\times3+\left(-70\right)\times1=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\7&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-3\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times7-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times6-6\times7\right)=\left(-24\,;\,7\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times7+7\times1+\left(-42\right)\times5=-371$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times371=\frac{371}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{371}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-7\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,7\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,22\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-4\right)+22\times2+11\times\left(-7\right)=-33$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times33=\frac{11}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-23\,;\,-18\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times7+\left(-18\right)\times4+11\times2=-211$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times211=\frac{211}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{211}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-5\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,5\times3-1\times6\right)=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-9\right)\times9+9\times\left(-4\right)=-135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&1\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times3-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times0-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-6\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times0+\left(-6\right)\times0+\left(-42\right)\times6=-252$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times252=42$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=42}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-6\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-8\right)-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(31\,;\,-50\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=31\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-2\right)\times2=265$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times265=\frac{265}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{265}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-11\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&4\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-46\,;\,56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-46\right)\times\left(-2\right)+56\times\left(-6\right)=76$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times76=\frac{38}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{38}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-3\times7\,;\,3\times3-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(-27\,;\,21\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times\left(-2\right)+21\times3+\left(-22\right)\times7=-37$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times37=\frac{37}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\9&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times9-\left(-1\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-3\times9\,;\,3\times9-3\times2\right)=\left(36\,;\,-29\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times2+\left(-29\right)\times\left(-1\right)+21\times7=248$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times248=\frac{124}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{124}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,11\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-10\times3\,;\,10\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-4\times1\right)=\left(-34\,;\,7\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times7+7\times11+\left(-13\right)\times9=-278$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times278=\frac{139}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{139}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-4&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(49\,;\,-16\,;\,-52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=49\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-16\right)\times1+\left(-52\right)\times5=-521$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times521=\frac{521}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{521}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times0-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-5\times0\,;\,5\times5-6\times3\right)=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times3+\left(-6\right)\times0+7\times8=86$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times86=\frac{43}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-9\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\right)=\left(-52\,;\,-39\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-39\right)\times0+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-11\right)=195$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times195=\frac{65}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-8&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\10&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{247}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-6\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,51\,;\,-18\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=33}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times7-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-6\times7\,;\,6\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(-47\,;\,-42\,;\,-36\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times7=\frac{7}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-11\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times1+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)+29\times\left(-1\right)=-1$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times1=\frac{1}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-5\times4\,;\,5\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-25\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-25\right)\times5+\left(-20\right)\times1=15$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times15=\frac{5}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\-1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-7\times1\right)=\left(-77\,;\,-17\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-77\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-17\right)\times7+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)=160$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times160=\frac{80}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{80}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-9\times4\,;\,9\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times4-2\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-14\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times3+\left(-14\right)\times9+\left(-14\right)\times6=-276$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times276=46$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=46}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,11\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times\left(-10\right)+11\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-48\,;\,28\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-48\right)\times0+28\times4+4\times\left(-5\right)=92$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times92=\frac{46}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{46}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times7-5\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,5\times2-\left(-3\right)\times7\right)=\left(39\,;\,3\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=39\times0+3\times\left(-5\right)+31\times\left(-1\right)=-46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times5-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times1-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times1\right)=\left(20\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times9+10\times0+0\times6=180$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times180=30$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=30}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&8\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&9\\7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&8\\8&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times7-8\times5\,;\,8\times8-9\times7\,;\,9\times5-8\times8\right)=\left(16\,;\,1\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times0+1\times2+\left(-19\right)\times4=-74$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times74=\frac{37}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-12\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+\left(-12\right)\times4+\left(-12\right)\times3=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\-7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-8\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,8\times0-\left(-1\right)\times7\right)=\left(7\,;\,28\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times5+28\times\left(-8\right)+7\times\left(-1\right)=-196$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times196=\frac{98}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{98}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(32\,;\,-31\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-31\right)\times1+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-9\right)=-174$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times174=29$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=29}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-5\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times8+\left(-5\right)\times0+11\times0=-112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times8-6\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,6\times2-\left(-4\right)\times8\right)=\left(24\,;\,14\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times10+14\times5+44\times\left(-5\right)=90$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times90=15$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=15}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,50\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times6+50\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-122$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times122=\frac{61}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-10\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times1-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(24\,;\,-80\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-80\right)\times4+23\times\left(-11\right)=-645$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times645=\frac{215}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{215}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&8\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-7\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-5\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times8-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,40\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)+40\times6+11\times1=315$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times315=\frac{105}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{105}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
