ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-4\times7\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-18\,;\,-31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-31\right)\times0=25$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times25=\frac{25}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-6\\9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times9-8\times8\,;\,8\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times8-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-55\,;\,22\,;\,-44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-55\right)\times\left(-9\right)+22\times6+\left(-44\right)\times8=275$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times275=\frac{275}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{275}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-2\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-2\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times8+\left(-2\right)\times2+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-5\right)=216$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times216=36$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=36}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&8\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,6\times2-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\right)=\left(16\,;\,28\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-2\right)+28\times1+\left(-12\right)\times1=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times5-6\times0\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-30\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-6\right)+7\times\left(-1\right)=227$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times227=\frac{227}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{227}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times3-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-1\times3\right)=\left(12\,;\,38\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-3\right)+38\times2+29\times0=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-8&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times8-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-0\times8\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-8\right)\times3+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)=2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\10&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times10-9\times1\,;\,9\times\left(-7\right)-3\times10\right)=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,-93\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-1\right)+1\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-93\right)\times0=-17$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times17=\frac{17}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-6\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times4-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-8\times2\right)=\left(26\,;\,-12\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times4+\left(-12\right)\times0+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-5\right)=184$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times184=\frac{92}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{92}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times1-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times0-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)+6\times\left(-2\right)+18\times\left(-4\right)=-69$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times69=\frac{23}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-7\times3\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,-14\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times0+\left(-14\right)\times3+\left(-4\right)\times1=-46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times2-0\times0\right)=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times10+0\times\left(-2\right)+0\times2=80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&2\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-9\\9&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times9-9\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times9\right)=\left(41\,;\,45\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=41\times1+45\times0+18\times\left(-1\right)=23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-7\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times3-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(27\,;\,-14\,;\,-59\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-59\right)\times\left(-9\right)=532$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times532=\frac{266}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{266}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times8-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times0-\left(-2\right)\times8\right)=\left(10\,;\,-49\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times5+\left(-49\right)\times\left(-5\right)+16\times0=295$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times295=\frac{295}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{295}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-11\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times2-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-40\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-40\right)\times0+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-9\right)=174$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times174=29$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=29}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-11\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-4\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-11\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,54\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-8\right)+54\times0+2\times\left(-1\right)=158$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times158=\frac{79}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{79}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&11\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-5\\8&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times6-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-11\times6\,;\,11\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\right)=\left(-38\,;\,-74\,;\,-48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times0+\left(-74\right)\times2+\left(-48\right)\times4=-340$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times340=\frac{170}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{170}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-4\times5\,;\,4\times2-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-0\times2\right)=\left(-20\,;\,8\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-2\right)+8\times9+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)=117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-8\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(-14\,;\,26\,;\,-69\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-1\right)+26\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-69\right)\times\left(-7\right)=419$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times419=\frac{419}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{419}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-3&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\11&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times11-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-7\right)-4\times11\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(46\,;\,-100\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=46\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-100\right)\times\left(-3\right)+2\times4=78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&5\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&7\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times2-5\times8\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-7\times2\,;\,7\times8-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-24\,;\,70\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times3+\left(-24\right)\times6+70\times2=-82$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times82=\frac{41}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times1+2\times\left(-6\right)+5\times2=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,21\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)+21\times3+\left(-9\right)\times0=126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-6\times1\,;\,6\times0-\left(-5\right)\times6\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-30\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times7+\left(-30\right)\times0+30\times\left(-5\right)=-185$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times185=\frac{185}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{185}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times5\,;\,5\times1-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times5-\left(-6\right)\times1\right)=\left(-19\,;\,8\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times2+8\times\left(-6\right)+21\times\left(-2\right)=-128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times0-3\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)+6\times7+12\times\left(-5\right)=-9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-4\times7\,;\,4\times5-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times7-1\times5\right)=\left(-32\,;\,28\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times7+28\times5+9\times\left(-2\right)=-102$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times102=17$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=17}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times3-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times1+0\times6+4\times8=32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-2\times2\,;\,2\times\left(-9\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-7\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times6+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-18\right)\times4=-98$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times98=\frac{49}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{49}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\10&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times10-6\times1\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times10\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-26\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times11+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-5\right)+36\times\left(-2\right)=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&11\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&5\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times7-11\times0\,;\,11\times1-5\times7\,;\,5\times0-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-24\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-24\right)\times6+2\times1=-100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times2-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times6-6\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,20\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-9\right)+20\times3+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times4-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(24\,;\,28\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-3\right)+28\times1+\left(-12\right)\times2=-68$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-7\times2\,;\,7\times\left(-7\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-51\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-51\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)=315$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times315=\frac{105}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{105}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-2\right)-7\times1\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-30\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times2+\left(-30\right)\times8+23\times5=-163$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times163=\frac{163}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{163}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,16\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times1+16\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-16\right)\times5=-168$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times168=28$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=28}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-5\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-9\right)=252$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times252=42$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=42}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-4\times7\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-49\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times2+\left(-49\right)\times1+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)=9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-7\times2\,;\,7\times\left(-6\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,-45\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-45\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-4\right)\times3=129$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times129=\frac{43}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\0&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\9&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times9-5\times0\,;\,5\times3-2\times9\,;\,2\times0-\left(-6\right)\times3\right)=\left(-54\,;\,-3\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-54\right)\times1+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)+18\times\left(-1\right)=-54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-6\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-8\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(48\,;\,14\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times\left(-5\right)+14\times\left(-3\right)+36\times10=78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times3-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-6\times3\,;\,6\times8-6\times0\right)=\left(26\,;\,-18\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times4+\left(-18\right)\times5+48\times\left(-3\right)=-130$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times130=\frac{65}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-0\times9\,;\,0\times1-4\times4\,;\,4\times9-2\times1\right)=\left(8\,;\,-16\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-16\right)\times2+34\times\left(-1\right)=-114$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times114=19$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=19}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times3-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-3\right)+6\times\left(-2\right)+30\times\left(-7\right)=-240$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times240=40$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=40}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-6\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-9\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-9\\-8&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-6\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,0\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-7\right)+0\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-10\right)=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times8-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\right)=\left(20\,;\,16\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times0+16\times2+20\times\left(-2\right)=-8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&9\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-4\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-9\times5\,;\,9\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-3\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-42\,;\,-41\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-42\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-41\right)\times7+\left(-5\right)\times6=-233$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times233=\frac{233}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{233}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times0+6\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times7-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,64\,;\,60\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-5\right)+64\times4+60\times5=456$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times456=76$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=76}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-8\times2\,;\,8\times1-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-22\,;\,11\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-1\right)+11\times4+0\times1=66$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times66=11$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=11}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-46\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times\left(-7\right)+2\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-5\right)\times4=294$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times294=49$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=49}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times3-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)+8\times1=8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times2-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times2\right)=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-4\right)+5\times5+0\times\left(-3\right)=5$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times5=\frac{5}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-5\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-12\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-12\right)\times3+14\times\left(-2\right)=26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-6\\-9&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-10\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times3-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-84\,;\,18\,;\,-30\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=104}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=37}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-5\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&11\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-9\\2&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-11\times1\,;\,11\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\right)=\left(-59\,;\,-21\,;\,-92\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times488=\frac{244}{3}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-5\times3\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
