$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times294=49$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=49}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times4-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times4-3\times4\right)=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times4+7\times\left(-3\right)+16\times\left(-4\right)=-97$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times97=\frac{97}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{97}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-6\times4\,;\,6\times2-3\times0\,;\,3\times4-3\times2\right)=\left(-24\,;\,12\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+12\times0+6\times\left(-1\right)=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times6-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\right)=\left(-29\,;\,-38\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-29\right)\times4+\left(-38\right)\times\left(-7\right)+4\times\left(-7\right)=122$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times122=\frac{61}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&-2\\-9&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-11\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(59\,;\,-33\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=59\times5+\left(-33\right)\times\left(-5\right)+34\times4=596$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times596=\frac{298}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{298}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,25\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-1\right)+25\times1+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-3\right)=162$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times2-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times1-\left(-8\right)\times2\right)=\left(32\,;\,8\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times5+8\times2+18\times2=212$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times212=\frac{106}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{106}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times0+0\times4+28\times\left(-5\right)=-140$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times140=\frac{70}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{70}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-8\times0\,;\,8\times8-4\times1\,;\,4\times0-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(-1\,;\,60\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times2+60\times\left(-10\right)+8\times7=-546$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times546=91$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=91}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times6-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times8-8\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(64\,;\,-2\,;\,56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=64\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-2\right)\times4+56\times8=248$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times248=\frac{124}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{124}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-5\right)\times1+1\times5=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times3-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,16\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+16\times\left(-2\right)+0\times\left(-4\right)=-14$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times14=\frac{7}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-2\times4\,;\,2\times3-0\times1\,;\,0\times4-0\times3\right)=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times5+6\times3+0\times\left(-2\right)=-22$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times22=\frac{11}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times2-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times7-4\times2\right)=\left(-8\,;\,10\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times2+10\times4+27\times\left(-2\right)=-30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-2\times2\,;\,2\times7-6\times0\,;\,6\times2-\left(-4\right)\times7\right)=\left(-4\,;\,14\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times6+14\times\left(-1\right)+40\times\left(-6\right)=-278$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times278=\frac{139}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{139}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times5-5\times2\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-0\times5\,;\,0\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-5\right)\times0+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)=64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&0\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-9\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,6\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times1+6\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-21\right)\times0=-15$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times15=\frac{5}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-10\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&-2\\-10&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-11\\-8&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-11\\-10&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(68\,;\,-68\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=68\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-68\right)\times\left(-8\right)+0\times2=136$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times136=\frac{68}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{68}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(17\,;\,11\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-3\right)+11\times4+8\times0=-7$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times7=\frac{7}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-9\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-6\times0\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times4+\left(-9\right)\times1+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-151$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times151=\frac{151}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{151}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,10\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-3\times3\,;\,3\times6-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-3\times6\right)=\left(0\,;\,27\,;\,-27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times3+27\times10+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-2\right)=324$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times324=54$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=54}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-8\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-6\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-8\times0\,;\,8\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-32\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-24\right)\times2=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(-39\,;\,-4\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-39\right)\times5+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(-39\,;\,0\,;\,-39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-39\right)\times8+0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-11\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times3-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(-55\,;\,-31\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-55\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)=518$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times518=\frac{259}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{259}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-3\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)+3\times3=51$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times51=\frac{17}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-4\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times6-7\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,12\,;\,52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times1+12\times3+52\times0=2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times1-1\times7\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-0\times1\right)=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-4\right)\times10=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times4-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(19\,;\,1\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=19\times\left(-4\right)+1\times7+15\times\left(-1\right)=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-25\,;\,7\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-5\right)+7\times\left(-7\right)+8\times3=100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(23\,;\,12\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times7+12\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-4\right)=205$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times205=\frac{205}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{205}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-3\times1\right)=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times0+\left(-2\right)\times8+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-2\right)=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-5\right)+11\times\left(-3\right)+1\times\left(-3\right)=34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times9-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times2-6\times9\right)=\left(0\,;\,-40\,;\,-40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times2+\left(-40\right)\times8+\left(-40\right)\times2=-400$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times400=\frac{200}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{200}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,-8\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times1+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-18\right)\times0=47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times5-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times5\,;\,3\times0-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,-14\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times8+\left(-14\right)\times4+1\times\left(-3\right)=-19$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times19=\frac{19}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times0-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-12\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-12\right)\times2+0\times\left(-5\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,-43\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-43\right)\times4+3\times\left(-3\right)=-244$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times244=\frac{122}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{122}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times2-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,18\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times6+18\times\left(-2\right)+18\times\left(-2\right)=-108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-8\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-7\times0\,;\,7\times2-\left(-8\right)\times4\right)=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,46\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)+46\times\left(-6\right)=-216$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times216=36$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=36}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-6\\-9&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(23\,;\,-43\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times2+\left(-43\right)\times\left(-5\right)+31\times\left(-11\right)=-80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times8-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times4-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times4\right)=\left(14\,;\,16\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-2\right)+16\times\left(-6\right)+7\times6=-82$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times82=\frac{41}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,20\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+20\times\left(-2\right)+7\times\left(-6\right)=-66$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times66=11$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=11}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-7\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-5\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-9\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,7\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times0+7\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-29\right)\times\left(-8\right)=211$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times211=\frac{211}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{211}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-0\times0\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-3\right)\times1=167$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times167=\frac{167}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{167}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&5\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times5-6\times2\,;\,6\times3-6\times5\,;\,6\times2-5\times3\right)=\left(13\,;\,-12\,;\,-3\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times172=\frac{86}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{86}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&3\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-10\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times0+\left(-2\right)\times3+16\times1=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,10\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+10\times3+\left(-22\right)\times4=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\-8&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\11&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times11-6\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-6\right)-2\times11\right)=\left(-52\,;\,-18\,;\,-58\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times1+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-58\right)\times\left(-2\right)=100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-9\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,-68\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-68\right)\times1+2\times10=-57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&8\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-8\times2\right)=\left(-14\,;\,0\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times7+0\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-28\right)\times2=-154$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times154=\frac{77}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-10\\-9&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-4\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-4&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-69\,;\,12\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-69\right)\times5+12\times\left(-7\right)+24\times\left(-2\right)=-477$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times477=\frac{159}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{159}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\3&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-5\times11\,;\,5\times3-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times11-0\times3\right)=\left(-55\,;\,29\,;\,77\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-55\right)\times\left(-1\right)+29\times7+77\times3=489$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times489=\frac{163}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{163}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-7\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,3\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times3+3\times\left(-7\right)+21\times3=150$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times150=25$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=25}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,14\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-3\right)+14\times1+\left(-13\right)\times6=-115$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times115=\frac{115}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-10\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-5\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-10\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-25\,;\,40\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-9\right)+40\times0+\left(-10\right)\times5=175$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times175=\frac{175}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{175}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times5-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\right)=\left(26\,;\,31\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times0+31\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-14\right)\times1=-169$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times169=\frac{169}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{169}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-9\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-77\,;\,-43\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-77\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-43\right)\times5=21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times4-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times10+4\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-8\right)\times5=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times2\right)=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-2\right)+4\times2+0\times\left(-3\right)=4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)=19$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times19=\frac{19}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&10\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&8\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-10\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,10\times2-8\times6\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-28\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times6+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-4&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\10&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times10-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times0-1\times10\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-50\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times9+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-10\right)\times1=354$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times354=59$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=59}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-6\times2\right)=\left(45\,;\,30\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times0+30\times2+0\times3=60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&10\\-9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-10\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times4\right)=\left(33\,;\,78\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times7+78\times\left(-3\right)+6\times\left(-6\right)=-39$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times39=\frac{13}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,10\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-8\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&10\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times4-10\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-38\,;\,55\,;\,64\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times\left(-1\right)+55\times10+64\times\left(-5\right)=268$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times268=\frac{134}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{134}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times0-4\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-152$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times152=\frac{76}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{76}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times3-9\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,25\,;\,33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times3+25\times\left(-1\right)+33\times\left(-11\right)=-379$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times379=\frac{379}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{379}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times2-8\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,8\times0-1\times2\right)=\left(-4\,;\,34\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times11+34\times0+\left(-2\right)\times4=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
