ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-17\,;\,62\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-17\right)\times7+62\times10=465$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times465=\frac{155}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{155}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-5\times5\,;\,5\times2-1\times5\,;\,1\times5-4\times2\right)=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)+5\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-3\right)\times1=-23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(64\,;\,8\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=64\times\left(-3\right)+8\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-196$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times196=\frac{98}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{98}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-8\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&0\\-8&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-10\right)-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-3\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(90\,;\,30\,;\,-51\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=90\times\left(-2\right)+30\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-51\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-75$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times75=\frac{25}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-7\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-11\,;\,35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-11\right)\times1+35\times\left(-7\right)=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-10\\6&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-10\right)\times6\right)=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times8+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)+36\times\left(-3\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&8\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times1-0\times1\right)=\left(7\,;\,9\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times7+9\times\left(-5\right)+8\times0=4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times6\right)=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times1+\left(-10\right)\times1+42\times\left(-2\right)=-92$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times92=\frac{46}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{46}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-4\times0\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-16\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times1+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-11\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&8\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times0-8\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-72\,;\,-95\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-72\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-95\right)\times10+16\times\left(-4\right)=-798$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times798=133$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=133}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\9&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-2\times3\,;\,2\times9-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-1\times9\right)=\left(-10\,;\,10\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times4+10\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-6\right)\times5\right)=\left(4\,;\,-20\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times3+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-4\right)+29\times\left(-4\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-6\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times5-5\times0\,;\,5\times6-7\times5\,;\,7\times0-\left(-6\right)\times6\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-5\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times6+\left(-5\right)\times2+36\times1=-154$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times154=\frac{77}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times7-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-5\times7\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-33\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times3+\left(-33\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-29\right)\times\left(-5\right)=247$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times247=\frac{247}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{247}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-5\times4\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,-14\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times4+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-29\right)\times2=-14$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times14=\frac{7}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-6\times2\,;\,6\times0-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-18\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-6\right)+12\times\left(-4\right)=44$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times44=\frac{22}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{22}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)+4\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-1\right)\times5=25$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times25=\frac{25}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-11\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-3\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(26\,;\,-4\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times1+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)=90$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times90=15$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=15}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-8\\10&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times1-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times10-9\times1\,;\,9\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times10\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-9\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times0+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)+8\times6=75$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times75=\frac{25}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times2-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-0\times2\,;\,0\times2-3\times4\right)=\left(12\,;\,-12\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+\left(-12\right)\times0+\left(-12\right)\times5=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times9-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times0+\left(-8\right)\times9+\left(-29\right)\times2=-130$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times130=\frac{65}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times6-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times4+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-1\right)\times3=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&11\\-6&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&4\\10&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times10-11\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,11\times\left(-4\right)-4\times10\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(66\,;\,-84\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=66\times4+\left(-84\right)\times5+\left(-24\right)\times2=-204$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times204=34$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=34}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times7-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times7\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-42\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times4+\left(-42\right)\times3+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-142$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times142=\frac{71}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-8\times4\,;\,8\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-35\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times4+\left(-35\right)\times1+\left(-29\right)\times0=-67$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times67=\frac{67}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times4\,;\,6\times4-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-23\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times8+\left(-23\right)\times3+21\times1=-112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times8-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-0\times8\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-18\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times3+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-6\right)\times3=-15$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times15=\frac{5}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times10-1\times2\right)=\left(77\,;\,-22\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=77\times1+\left(-22\right)\times6+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-10\right)=165$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times165=\frac{55}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,12\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-8\right)+12\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)=114$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times114=19$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=19}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(29\,;\,-28\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=29\times0+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-6\right)\times5=26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-8\times8\,;\,8\times4-4\times1\,;\,4\times8-0\times4\right)=\left(-64\,;\,28\,;\,32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-64\right)\times\left(-3\right)+28\times3+32\times9=564$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times564=94$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=94}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,8\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times1+8\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-7\right)=178$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times178=\frac{89}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{89}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-3&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\11&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times11-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times11\right)=\left(18\,;\,45\,;\,51\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times8+45\times3+51\times\left(-3\right)=126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times4-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times3+8\times\left(-1\right)+0\times0=-8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-5\right)-3\times4\,;\,3\times2-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times4-8\times2\right)=\left(-52\,;\,6\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times1+6\times3+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)=14$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times14=\frac{7}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-3\times8\,;\,3\times4-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times8-7\times4\right)=\left(-38\,;\,12\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times\left(-2\right)+12\times7+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-3\right)=244$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times244=\frac{122}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{122}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times4-2\times9\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-3\times4\,;\,3\times9-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-16\,;\,41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times6+\left(-16\right)\times3+41\times1=53$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times53=\frac{53}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times8-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times8\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-64\,;\,72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times5+\left(-64\right)\times\left(-7\right)+72\times\left(-2\right)=244$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times244=\frac{122}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{122}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-4\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&11\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times8-11\times5\right)=\left(21\,;\,-18\,;\,-39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-18\right)\times4+\left(-39\right)\times4=-270$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times270=45$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=45}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-8\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)+38\times0=168$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times168=28$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=28}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&9\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-4\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times0-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(45\,;\,-18\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-4\right)+4\times6=51$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times51=\frac{17}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-10\\0&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-1\\-11&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-10\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-1\times4\right)=\left(-11\,;\,-51\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-51\right)\times4+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)=-135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times10-2\times5\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-1\times10\,;\,1\times5-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-12\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times7+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)+7\times2=120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-11\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&4\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-11\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(53\,;\,-8\,;\,-75\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=53\times1+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-75\right)\times\left(-1\right)=200$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times200=\frac{100}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{100}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(45\,;\,-15\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-4\times4\,;\,4\times8-2\times2\,;\,2\times4-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(-18\,;\,28\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times4+28\times0+16\times8=56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times0-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(10\,;\,-2\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+10\times\left(-4\right)=-56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-3\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-15\,;\,-10\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-7\right)+15\times0=235$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times235=\frac{235}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{235}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-7\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,7\times2-\left(-5\right)\times4\right)=\left(28\,;\,12\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times7+12\times1+34\times\left(-2\right)=140$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times140=\frac{70}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{70}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)+0\times2+2\times6=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-3\times1\right)=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times6+\left(-5\right)\times2+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-11\right)=95$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times95=\frac{95}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{95}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\11&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\5&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-\left(-6\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times11-2\times5\right)=\left(68\,;\,-27\,;\,-43\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=68\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-27\right)\times5+\left(-43\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-99$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times99=\frac{33}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{33}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-13\,;\,46\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times2+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-5\right)+46\times4=281$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times281=\frac{281}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{281}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,14\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times\left(-5\right)+14\times6+0\times\left(-6\right)=49$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times49=\frac{49}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{49}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-5\times6\,;\,5\times1-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times6-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(-26\,;\,13\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times5+13\times3+13\times4=-39$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times39=\frac{13}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\3&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,4\times3-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(28\,;\,18\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-6\right)+18\times0+\left(-14\right)\times8=-280$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times280=\frac{140}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{140}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&9\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(61\,;\,-25\,;\,-33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=61\times6+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-33\right)\times8=252$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times252=42$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=42}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-10\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-7\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-6\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\right)=\left(45\,;\,39\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times7+39\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-3\right)\times0=-75$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times75=\frac{25}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-0\times5\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-6\right)+0\times2=72$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times72=12$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=12}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times2-3\times6\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\right)=\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times3+\left(-10\right)\times0+\left(-10\right)\times6=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-6\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,6\times3-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(42\,;\,26\,;\,41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times5+26\times\left(-8\right)+41\times\left(-2\right)=-80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,2\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-2\right)\times0+\left(-10\right)\times2=-32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times2-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times9+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-16\right)\times0=34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&10\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times1-\left(-5\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times3-10\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(25\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-2\right)+5\times2+10\times\left(-1\right)=-50$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times50=\frac{25}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&11\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-11\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,11\times8-2\times3\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\right)=\left(-4\,;\,82\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+82\times\left(-2\right)+38\times7=106$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times106=\frac{53}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-1\times0\,;\,1\times7-6\times1\,;\,6\times0-2\times7\right)=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times0+1\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-14\right)\times6=-88$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times88=\frac{44}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{44}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&5\\-10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-5\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(74\,;\,-21\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=74\times0+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-4\right)\times1=164$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times164=\frac{82}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{82}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-10\\4&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&4\\-9&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times4-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-10\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times4-4\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(32\,;\,76\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-2\right)+76\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-4\right)\times2=-452$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times452=\frac{226}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{226}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
