$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,-11\,;\,35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times3+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)+35\times\left(-2\right)=59$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times59=\frac{59}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{59}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,36\,;\,-39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times0+36\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-4\right)=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)+3\times3+1\times\left(-2\right)=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-8\\-2&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\-11&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-71\,;\,29\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-71\right)\times\left(-5\right)+29\times3+27\times\left(-2\right)=388$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times388=\frac{194}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{194}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,11\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times4-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times27=\frac{9}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{9}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-7\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(49\,;\,-35\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=49\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-6\right)+28\times0=-182$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times182=\frac{91}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{91}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times2-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-5\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,24\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times0+24\times5+18\times\left(-5\right)=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&1\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\9&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times9-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times9\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-85\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times10+\left(-85\right)\times\left(-4\right)+13\times0=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-10\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&1\\-10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\8&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times4-1\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,1\times8-1\times4\,;\,1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times8\right)=\left(-18\,;\,4\,;\,46\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times2+4\times\left(-10\right)+46\times0=-76$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times76=\frac{38}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{38}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&8\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times4-8\times3\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-52\,;\,4\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times1+4\times3+\left(-16\right)\times6=-136$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times136=\frac{68}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{68}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-10\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&3\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times5-8\times3\,;\,8\times0-\left(-10\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times3-3\times0\right)=\left(-9\,;\,50\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-9\right)+50\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-30\right)\times5=-119$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times119=\frac{119}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{119}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-3\times3\,;\,3\times4-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times4\right)=\left(-24\,;\,15\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times6+15\times\left(-1\right)+17\times0=-159$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times159=\frac{53}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-11\,;\,-17\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-2\right)+5\times\left(-3\right)=52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times8-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-7\times8\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-56\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times4+\left(-56\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)=135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times8-7\times2\,;\,7\times1-3\times8\,;\,3\times2-1\times1\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-17\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-17\right)\times6+5\times0=-90$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times90=15$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=15}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-4\times1\,;\,4\times0-0\times0\,;\,0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times0\right)=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times7+0\times3+0\times\left(-3\right)=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times5-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\right)=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times0+7\times2+4\times1=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times4-8\times4\,;\,8\times0-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-5\times0\right)=\left(-12\,;\,8\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times2+8\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times7=-104$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times104=\frac{52}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{52}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-8\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-7\right)=156$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times156=26$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=26}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\9&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times9-0\times3\,;\,0\times5-9\times9\,;\,9\times3-5\times5\right)=\left(45\,;\,-81\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times5+\left(-81\right)\times2+2\times5=73$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times73=\frac{73}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{73}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-5\times3\,;\,5\times8-4\times2\,;\,4\times3-\left(-4\right)\times8\right)=\left(-23\,;\,32\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times8+32\times1+44\times4=24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)+9\times2+6\times3=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-2\right)-4\times7\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,-14\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times2+\left(-14\right)\times4+2\times4=-116$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times116=\frac{58}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{58}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times0-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(20\,;\,25\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times3+25\times\left(-3\right)+0\times\left(-5\right)=-15$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times15=\frac{5}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-11\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times1+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)+6\times4=77$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times77=\frac{77}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times5-3\times1\,;\,3\times1-1\times5\,;\,1\times1-5\times1\right)=\left(22\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times9+\left(-2\right)\times8+\left(-4\right)\times6=158$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times158=\frac{79}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{79}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,11\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-3\\9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&11\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times1-\left(-3\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-6\times1\,;\,6\times9-11\times1\right)=\left(38\,;\,-9\,;\,43\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-9\right)\times1+43\times1=-4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times0-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times0+0\times7+2\times\left(-3\right)=-6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&7\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-9\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times2-7\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,7\times6-6\times2\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times6\right)=\left(10\,;\,30\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times9+30\times\left(-1\right)+30\times8=300$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times300=50$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=50}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&7\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times0-7\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-9\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-63\,;\,-67\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-63\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-67\right)\times0=-91$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times91=\frac{91}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{91}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,24\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-7\right)+24\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times2-8\times4\,;\,8\times0-4\times2\,;\,4\times4-1\times0\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-8\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times2+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)+16\times9=108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-6\times0\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,12\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times5+12\times2+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-11\right)=280$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times280=\frac{140}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{140}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times8-3\times4\,;\,3\times3-3\times8\,;\,3\times4-8\times3\right)=\left(52\,;\,-15\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=52\times8+\left(-15\right)\times4+\left(-12\right)\times4=308$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{154}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times9-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times1-\left(-7\right)\times9\right)=\left(18\,;\,-36\,;\,63\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times7+\left(-36\right)\times1+63\times\left(-1\right)=27$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times27=\frac{9}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{9}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times3-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times2\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-13\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times1+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-4\right)+0\times3=26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-35\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times7+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-9\right)+24\times\left(-4\right)=-173$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times173=\frac{173}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{173}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(-17\,;\,9\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times9+9\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-19\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-85$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times85=\frac{85}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{85}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-2\times5\,;\,2\times1-2\times3\,;\,2\times5-0\times1\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times4+\left(-4\right)\times2+10\times10=52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-20\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times8+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-2\right)+4\times\left(-7\right)=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\-4&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\10&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times10-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times7-0\times10\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-2\times7\right)=\left(44\,;\,42\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=44\times\left(-2\right)+42\times0+\left(-14\right)\times2=-116$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times116=\frac{58}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{58}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)+4\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-3\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-9\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-36\,;\,27\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times2+27\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-21\right)\times2=-249$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times249=\frac{83}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&9\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&6\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-9\times1\,;\,9\times0-6\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,-12\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-12\right)\times7+6\times\left(-2\right)=-108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-10\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&1\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times2-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-22\,;\,56\,;\,46\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-7\right)+56\times0+46\times\left(-2\right)=62$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times62=\frac{31}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-10\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-10&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\6&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\right)=\left(2\,;\,-18\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times5+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-6\right)+24\times\left(-4\right)=22$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times22=\frac{11}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times8-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-1\times8\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-55\,;\,-14\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-55\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-19\right)\times3=536$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times536=\frac{268}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{268}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\-9&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(-53\,;\,49\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-53\right)\times\left(-1\right)+49\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-97$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times97=\frac{97}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{97}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-4\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-4\right)\times5+\left(-16\right)\times2=68$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-10\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&4\\-8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times5-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times2-\left(-6\right)\times5\right)=\left(68\,;\,-18\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=68\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-18\right)\times5+38\times0=-294$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times294=49$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=49}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-7\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-11\,;\,21\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)+21\times5+36\times\left(-9\right)=-186$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times186=31$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=31}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
