ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times7-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\right)=\left(13\,;\,21\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times7+21\times\left(-2\right)+28\times\left(-3\right)=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,12\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)+12\times\left(-5\right)+11\times3=29$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times29=\frac{29}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times8-4\times3\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-8\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(52\,;\,44\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=52\times\left(-4\right)+44\times2+\left(-10\right)\times3=-150$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times150=25$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=25}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-5\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-10&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times2-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-43\,;\,56\,;\,-75\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-43\right)\times\left(-8\right)+56\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-75\right)\times0=8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&11\\6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&6\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times7-11\times6\,;\,11\times4-6\times7\,;\,6\times6-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(-80\,;\,2\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-80\right)\times7+2\times1+44\times10=-118$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times118=\frac{59}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{59}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(12\,;\,-10\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times1+\left(-10\right)\times5+18\times\left(-3\right)=-92$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times92=\frac{46}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{46}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-16\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-16\right)\times0+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)=8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-8&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-2\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\right)=\left(37\,;\,14\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=37\times\left(-1\right)+14\times\left(-2\right)+4\times\left(-10\right)=-105$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times105=\frac{35}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,10\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-5\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)+0\times10+8\times\left(-2\right)=-6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-3\times4\,;\,3\times4-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-18\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times0+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)+16\times\left(-1\right)=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-4&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-0\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-2\times4\,;\,2\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-8\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-42\right)\times8=-168$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times168=28$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=28}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&11\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-5\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-11\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,11\times5-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\right)=\left(8\,;\,60\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times3+60\times0+20\times5=124$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times124=\frac{62}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{62}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-27\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-27\right)\times1+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-4\right)=61$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times61=\frac{61}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times9-2\times3\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-5\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(39\,;\,6\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=39\times3+6\times0+24\times1=141$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times141=\frac{47}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-4\times6\,;\,4\times2-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times6-3\times2\right)=\left(-33\,;\,11\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-33\right)\times4+11\times6+0\times6=-66$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times66=11$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=11}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-7\right)-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)+2\times\left(-2\right)=42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-0\times1\right)=\left(35\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=35\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-3\right)\times8+\left(-7\right)\times1=-206$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times206=\frac{103}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{103}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times9-0\times3\right)=\left(18\,;\,4\,;\,45\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times4+4\times10+45\times\left(-5\right)=-113$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times113=\frac{113}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{113}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&10\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times2-10\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-58\,;\,2\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-58\right)\times\left(-2\right)+2\times6+20\times\left(-6\right)=8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-2\times3\,;\,2\times1-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(-12\,;\,20\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times0+20\times5+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)=132$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,16\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times0+16\times\left(-2\right)+16\times\left(-2\right)=-64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-9\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&1\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times4-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-31\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times10+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-1\right)+6\times\left(-2\right)=-61$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times61=\frac{61}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times4-7\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-0\times4\right)=\left(0\,;\,21\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times8+21\times4+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)=105$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times105=\frac{35}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-2\times1\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-5\right)\times0+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)=34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-2\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,2\times2-0\times0\right)=\left(4\,;\,18\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times0+18\times1+4\times\left(-5\right)=-2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-10\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-1\\-10&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-10\\6&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times6-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-10\right)\times6\right)=\left(40\,;\,19\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times\left(-1\right)+19\times1+10\times1=-11$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times11=\frac{11}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-3\times0\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-18\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,-10\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-10\right)\times1+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(2\,;\,-11\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-11\right)\times1+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)=50$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times50=\frac{25}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times6-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-0\times6\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-30\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times3+\left(-30\right)\times0+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\7&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-8&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,49\,;\,56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-4\right)+49\times\left(-3\right)+56\times2=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\-5&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-11&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times4-3\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(-15\,;\,-45\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-45\right)\times2+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&9\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&7\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times4-3\times4\,;\,3\times5-9\times4\,;\,9\times4-7\times5\right)=\left(16\,;\,-21\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times5+\left(-21\right)\times5+1\times5=-20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times7-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times5+3\times2+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)=53$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times53=\frac{53}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&10\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-10\\9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&0\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times9-10\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-10\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,30\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-8\right)+30\times\left(-7\right)+30\times6=-270$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times270=45$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=45}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,13\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times4+13\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-34\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times1+\left(-34\right)\times9+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-7\right)=-207$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times207=\frac{69}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{69}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&8\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-9\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times8-8\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-4\right)\times9=-20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(35\,;\,15\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=35\times8+15\times0+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-4\right)=400$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times400=\frac{200}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{200}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-9\right)\times6\right)=\left(31\,;\,-33\,;\,51\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=31\times7+\left(-33\right)\times0+51\times\left(-3\right)=64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times2-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times1-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times3+8\times7+12\times\left(-1\right)=50$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times50=\frac{25}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times1+4\times\left(-2\right)+11\times\left(-4\right)=-55$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times55=\frac{55}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,11\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,11\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\11&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&8\\8&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times6-2\times11\,;\,2\times8-6\times6\,;\,6\times11-8\times8\right)=\left(26\,;\,-20\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-20\right)\times11+2\times\left(-2\right)=-276$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times276=46$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=46}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-5\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times5-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-9\times5\right)=\left(-39\,;\,10\,;\,-43\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-39\right)\times0+10\times6+\left(-43\right)\times3=-69$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times69=\frac{23}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times1-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times3+3\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-11\right)\times0=-21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-8\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times1-\left(-8\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times6-0\times1\,;\,0\times8-8\times6\right)=\left(72\,;\,-48\,;\,-48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=72\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-48\right)\times7+\left(-48\right)\times1=-672$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times672=112$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=112}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-8\\-5&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-85\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-85\right)\times3+\left(-20\right)\times6=-495$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times495=\frac{165}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{165}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,11\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,11\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\11&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\-3&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times5-\left(-1\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-5\times5\,;\,5\times11-6\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(41\,;\,-22\,;\,73\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=41\times0+\left(-22\right)\times11+73\times6=196$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times196=\frac{98}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{98}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times1\right)=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times0+1\times0+1\times\left(-3\right)=-3$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times3=\frac{1}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-7\\10&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&6\\-4&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times0-\left(-7\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times10-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(70\,;\,28\,;\,-56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=70\times\left(-9\right)+28\times7+\left(-56\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-378$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times378=63$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=63}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-7\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times5-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\right)=\left(22\,;\,-5\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)+20\times\left(-6\right)=-112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&11\\-6&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-3\\11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times11-11\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,11\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(99\,;\,11\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=99\times1+11\times\left(-4\right)+24\times4=151$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times151=\frac{151}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{151}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-11\\-10&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-6\\-11&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\-4&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-77\,;\,-22\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-77\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-1\right)+48\times\left(-7\right)=148$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times148=\frac{74}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{74}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times7-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-4\right)-2\times7\right)=\left(-30\,;\,10\,;\,-50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-1\right)+10\times5+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-10\right)=580$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times580=\frac{290}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{290}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-4&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-9&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(-63\,;\,51\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-63\right)\times\left(-5\right)+51\times\left(-7\right)+27\times\left(-1\right)=-69$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times69=\frac{23}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(-62\,;\,-12\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-62\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-12\right)\times0+17\times\left(-3\right)=135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&1\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&11\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times1-1\times1\,;\,1\times7-7\times1\,;\,7\times1-11\times7\right)=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,-70\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times5+0\times4+\left(-70\right)\times\left(-3\right)=260$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times260=\frac{130}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{130}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-8&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,22\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-2\right)+22\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-1\right)\times6=-142$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times142=\frac{71}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times0+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-24\right)\times2=-13$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times13=\frac{13}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-4\times4\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,4\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-4\right)+4\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-30\right)\times9=-230$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times230=\frac{115}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&8\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times7-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times0-8\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(56\,;\,57\,;\,32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=56\times3+57\times4+32\times\left(-1\right)=364$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times364=\frac{182}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{182}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\9&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-\left(-1\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times9-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,26\,;\,-38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-7\right)+26\times9+\left(-38\right)\times\left(-3\right)=327$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times327=\frac{109}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{109}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times8-0\times2\,;\,0\times2-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-6\times2\right)=\left(48\,;\,8\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times\left(-2\right)+8\times4+\left(-14\right)\times5=-134$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times134=\frac{67}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times4-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-4\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(13\,;\,16\,;\,14\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-3\times3\,;\,3\times0-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times3-7\times0\right)=\left(-23\,;\,8\,;\,12\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&10\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&7\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-10\times2\,;\,10\times2-7\times4\,;\,7\times2-2\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-8\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times2+\left(-8\right)\times7+10\times0=-80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,10\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&6\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&10\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&10\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times6-6\times4\,;\,6\times0-10\times6\,;\,10\times4-10\times0\right)=\left(36\,;\,-60\,;\,40\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&3\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-10\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times5-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times6-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-10\right)\times6\right)=\left(-41\,;\,33\,;\,69\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-41\right)\times1+33\times\left(-8\right)+69\times2=-167$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times167=\frac{167}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{167}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&11\\4&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-2\\11&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
