$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times11-11\times4\,;\,11\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times11\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-66\,;\,-55\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times6+\left(-66\right)\times0+\left(-55\right)\times3=-297$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times297=\frac{99}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{99}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times9-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-1\times9\right)=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times5+5\times0+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-10\right)=95$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times95=\frac{95}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{95}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times6-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-4\right)-4\times6\right)=\left(-16\,;\,20\,;\,-44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-2\right)+20\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-44\right)\times\left(-2\right)=100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-0\times5\right)=\left(12\,;\,-16\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-16\right)\times2+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(-59\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-59\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)+1\times0=299$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times299=\frac{299}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{299}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-9\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&2\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-62\,;\,31\,;\,62\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-62\right)\times\left(-4\right)+31\times2+62\times\left(-11\right)=-372$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times372=62$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=62}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,10\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\10&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\9&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times10\,;\,2\times9-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times10-\left(-1\right)\times9\right)=\left(-18\,;\,18\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times9+18\times10+9\times5=63$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times63=\frac{21}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{21}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times8\,;\,3\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times8-\left(-1\right)\times0\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-4\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-4\right)\times0+\left(-16\right)\times1=6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times8-1\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-7\right)+5\times5+\left(-19\right)\times4=-107$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times107=\frac{107}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{107}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(58\,;\,-66\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=58\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-66\right)\times0+\left(-3\right)\times2=-528$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times528=88$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=88}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\5&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-10&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-7\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-10\right)-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,-70\,;\,-50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-70\right)\times0+\left(-50\right)\times4=-416$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times416=\frac{208}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{208}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-1\times4\,;\,1\times0-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(-20\,;\,32\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-9\right)+32\times1+\left(-32\right)\times3=116$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times116=\frac{58}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{58}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times6-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-2\right)\times6=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&5\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\9&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-5\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times9-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-7\times9\right)=\left(-25\,;\,70\,;\,-73\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times2+70\times1+\left(-73\right)\times5=-345$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times345=\frac{115}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,7\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-27\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-27\right)\times7+10\times\left(-10\right)=-142$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times142=\frac{71}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)-4\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,-7\,;\,70\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-7\right)\times1+70\times5=547$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times547=\frac{547}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{547}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\right)=\left(10\,;\,-56\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-56\right)\times\left(-9\right)+14\times\left(-7\right)=366$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times366=61$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=61}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-5\times4\,;\,5\times0-\left(-1\right)\times6\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-32\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times3+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-3\right)+6\times\left(-1\right)=78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&4\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times1-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-2\times1\right)=\left(-48\,;\,6\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-48\right)\times0+6\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-3\right)=24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-8\times5\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,-46\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times6+\left(-46\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-18\right)\times1=80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-31\,;\,80\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-5\right)+80\times0=211$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times211=\frac{211}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{211}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-2\times3\,;\,2\times0-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-0\times0\right)=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times6+5\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-3\right)\times1=-64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times0-8\times2\,;\,8\times\left(-6\right)-2\times0\right)=\left(16\,;\,-16\,;\,-48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times8+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-48\right)\times\left(-5\right)=416$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times416=\frac{208}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{208}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-4\times2\right)=\left(-11\,;\,-8\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times4+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-18\right)\times3=-82$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times82=\frac{41}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times2-2\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,0\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-4\right)+0\times7+14\times\left(-4\right)=-104$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times104=\frac{52}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{52}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times5-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times4-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times4\right)=\left(-12\,;\,13\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-5\right)+13\times\left(-3\right)+20\times7=161$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times161=\frac{161}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{161}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-10\\9&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&3\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-10\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times2-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times9-3\times2\right)=\left(66\,;\,4\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=66\times0+4\times5+21\times\left(-6\right)=-106$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times106=\frac{53}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times2-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,2\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-6\right)+2\times\left(-3\right)+24\times1=-66$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times66=11$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=11}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&8\\6&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&9\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times6-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times9-8\times6\,;\,8\times2-9\times9\right)=\left(60\,;\,-75\,;\,-65\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=60\times7+\left(-75\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-65\right)\times5=170$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times170=\frac{85}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{85}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times8-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times8\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-23\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times0+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-10\right)+38\times3=344$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times344=\frac{172}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{172}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-6\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-7\times4\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-32\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times7+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-5\right)=47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-8\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times7-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\right)=\left(-46\,;\,-56\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times4+\left(-56\right)\times\left(-7\right)+21\times\left(-2\right)=166$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times166=\frac{83}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times5-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times1\right)=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times1+6\times4+4\times5=42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times0\right)=\left(-36\,;\,24\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times\left(-4\right)+24\times\left(-10\right)+36\times\left(-3\right)=-204$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times204=34$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=34}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,28\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times3+28\times3+48\times\left(-3\right)=-108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-1\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times4+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times4-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times1-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\right)=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+3\times\left(-3\right)+7\times7=47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,16\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-5\right)+16\times2+\left(-4\right)\times4=-64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&10\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&6\\9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-10\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,10\times1-6\times9\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-44\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-44\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-9\right)\times6=41$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times41=\frac{41}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-5&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,39\,;\,-23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-4\right)+39\times0+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-4\right)=44$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times44=\frac{22}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{22}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,10\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-8\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&10\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-10\times1\right)=\left(-74\,;\,-53\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-74\right)\times3+\left(-53\right)\times2+\left(-20\right)\times1=-348$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times348=58$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=58}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-5\times2\,;\,5\times1-8\times2\,;\,8\times2-2\times1\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-11\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times7+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)+14\times5=94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-4\times5\,;\,4\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-4\times2\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-4\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-28\right)\times0=136$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times136=\frac{68}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{68}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-\left(-7\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(-4\,;\,16\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times4+16\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)=2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&10\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-3\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times4-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times7-10\times4\right)=\left(-30\,;\,6\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times7+6\times11+\left(-26\right)\times2=-196$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times196=\frac{98}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{98}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-3\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)+0\times7+24\times\left(-6\right)=-123$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times123=\frac{41}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-10&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,40\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)+40\times1+\left(-20\right)\times1=56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-9\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-3\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-51\,;\,62\,;\,39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-51\right)\times1+62\times\left(-7\right)+39\times\left(-1\right)=-524$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times524=\frac{262}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{262}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-1\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,1\times2-\left(-1\right)\times7\right)=\left(12\,;\,-6\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times4+\left(-6\right)\times2+9\times0=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(30\,;\,-23\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-23\right)\times1+2\times0=-83$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times83=\frac{83}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times6-2\times0\,;\,2\times0-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-5\times0\right)=\left(30\,;\,18\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-3\right)+18\times10+0\times\left(-3\right)=90$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times90=15$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=15}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-7\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times1\right)=\left(63\,;\,-35\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=63\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-1\right)+4\times\left(-5\right)=-300$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times300=50$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=50}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\-4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times7-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times0-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-5\times0\right)=\left(51\,;\,-14\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=51\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-14\right)\times2+\left(-8\right)\times6=-229$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times229=\frac{229}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{229}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-0\times4\right)=\left(63\,;\,-43\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=63\times8+\left(-43\right)\times4+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)=353$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times353=\frac{353}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{353}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-\left(-4\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-2\times1\,;\,2\times6-1\times0\right)=\left(25\,;\,-2\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-2\right)\times5+12\times\left(-1\right)=-122$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times122=\frac{61}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,44\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times\left(-6\right)+44\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-4\right)\times6=94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&11\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&5\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times9-11\times2\,;\,11\times0-5\times9\,;\,5\times2-0\times0\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-45\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-45\right)\times5+10\times8=-57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,11\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\11&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-1&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-8\times11\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-1\times7\,;\,1\times11-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-88\,;\,-15\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-88\right)\times0+\left(-15\right)\times0+11\times11=121$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times121=\frac{121}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{121}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times5-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-13\,;\,28\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times\left(-6\right)+28\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-22\right)\times0=-34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,11\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\11&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\2&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times8-6\times11\,;\,6\times2-0\times8\,;\,0\times11-0\times2\right)=\left(-66\,;\,12\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-66\right)\times7+12\times0+0\times5=-462$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times462=77$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=77}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-2\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times3-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times4-6\times3\right)=\left(-12\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times1+4\times4+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)=24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-1\\6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&10\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times6-10\times3\right)=\left(-54\,;\,9\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-54\right)\times2+9\times1+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-8\right)=45$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times45=\frac{15}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{15}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,7\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-8\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&7\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&7\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-7\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,7\times1-7\times0\right)=\left(-27\,;\,35\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times1+35\times6+7\times0=183$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times183=\frac{61}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&8\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-5\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-8\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,8\times2-\left(-5\right)\times3\right)=\left(26\,;\,23\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times1+23\times4+31\times2=180$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times180=30$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=30}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-2\right)+3\times\left(-6\right)+6\times\left(-3\right)=6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-6\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,6\times4-3\times9\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(21\,;\,-3\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,18\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times2+18\times0+10\times\left(-1\right)=-4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times6-4\times4\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times3+\left(-4\right)\times4+2\times0=-22$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times22=\frac{11}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\10&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-9\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-\left(-6\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times10-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(60\,;\,12\,;\,-84\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=60\times0+12\times1+\left(-84\right)\times\left(-1\right)=96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។
