ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&9\\-6&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times0-3\times9\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-5\times0\,;\,5\times9-9\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,-18\,;\,99\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-18\right)\times0+99\times\left(-5\right)=-360$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times360=60$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=60}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-11\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&-1\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-11\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times0-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(11\,;\,8\,;\,-33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times1+8\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-33\right)\times\left(-4\right)=127$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times127=\frac{127}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{127}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times7-7\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-28\,;\,-27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-27\right)\times2=163$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times163=\frac{163}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{163}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times7-8\times0\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-3\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)+12\times1=-231$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times231=\frac{77}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-6\times5\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-28\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-28\right)\times4+\left(-12\right)\times2=-8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,11\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\11&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-3&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times8-8\times11\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-1\times8\,;\,1\times11-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-64\,;\,-32\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-64\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-32\right)\times4+20\times6=56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times4-8\times5\right)=\left(-44\,;\,-1\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-44\right)\times11+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-8\right)=-226$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times226=\frac{113}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{113}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times6+0\times3+\left(-29\right)\times10=-290$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times290=\frac{145}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{145}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-1\times3\,;\,1\times3-6\times1\,;\,6\times3-2\times3\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times4+\left(-3\right)\times5+12\times3=17$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times17=\frac{17}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(46\,;\,-33\,;\,19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=46\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-33\right)\times1+19\times7=-314$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times314=\frac{157}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{157}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-10\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&5\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-1\right)-8\times3\,;\,8\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times3-5\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-29\,;\,-66\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-29\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-66\right)\times6+5\times3=-352$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times352=\frac{176}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{176}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-10&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-4&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,12\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-5\right)+12\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-42\right)\times\left(-6\right)=354$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times354=59$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=59}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&9\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times8-9\times6\,;\,9\times4-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-6\times4\right)=\left(-6\,;\,52\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times3+52\times3+\left(-36\right)\times4=-6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times7-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times7\right)=\left(5\,;\,35\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times5+35\times0+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-4\right)=77$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times77=\frac{77}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\9&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times9-9\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,9\times6-\left(-2\right)\times9\right)=\left(-8\,;\,36\,;\,72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)+36\times\left(-3\right)+72\times\left(-2\right)=-244$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times244=\frac{122}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{122}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-4\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-34\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-34\right)\times2+34\times1=-34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&6\\-9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-7\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times4-6\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(22\,;\,16\,;\,47\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times0+16\times\left(-8\right)+47\times4=60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\10&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-6\times10\,;\,6\times2-7\times5\,;\,7\times10-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-65\,;\,-23\,;\,72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-65\right)\times2+\left(-23\right)\times8+72\times5=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&8\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-1\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times1-8\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-10\right)\times4+\left(-1\right)\times0=23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(-26\,;\,18\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times8+18\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-42\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-328$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times328=\frac{164}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{164}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-8\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-5\right)-1\times7\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(70\,;\,-47\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=70\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-47\right)\times\left(-7\right)+3\times1=-228$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times228=38$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=38}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,24\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times5+24\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-156$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times156=26$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=26}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-3&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-9\\10&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times10-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times1-\left(-9\right)\times10\right)=\left(28\,;\,2\,;\,94\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times3+2\times1+94\times4=462$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times462=77$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=77}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-7\times8\,;\,7\times0-6\times0\,;\,6\times8-3\times0\right)=\left(-56\,;\,0\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times2+0\times0+48\times5=128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-6\right)+4\times\left(-2\right)+0\times0=64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times6-8\times5\,;\,8\times3-3\times6\,;\,3\times5-3\times3\right)=\left(-22\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times5+6\times\left(-3\right)+6\times1=-122$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times122=\frac{61}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-29\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-29\right)\times\left(-8\right)+5\times\left(-9\right)=219$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times219=\frac{73}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{73}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,-11\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-11&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-11\\-6&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-2\\-11&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(-54\,;\,0\,;\,99\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-54\right)\times\left(-8\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)+99\times\left(-11\right)=-657$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times657=\frac{219}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{219}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-9\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&2\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times0-2\times1\right)=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-4\right)+7\times2+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)=8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-3\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(34\,;\,21\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-2\right)+21\times4+6\times\left(-1\right)=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&10\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-4\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-10\times4\,;\,10\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-6\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-46\,;\,-14\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-14\right)\times8+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times5-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,25\,;\,-59\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-7\right)+25\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-59\right)\times7=-333$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times333=\frac{111}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{111}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-7\times6\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-50\,;\,-2\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-22\right)\times1=182$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times182=\frac{91}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{91}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&7\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times4-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-29\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-29\right)\times7+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,10\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times2-8\times8\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-58\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-58\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-6\right)\times10+\left(-5\right)\times7=311$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times311=\frac{311}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{311}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-9\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-2\right)-4\times3\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,-30\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times4+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-16\right)\times6=228$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times228=38$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=38}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)+3\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)=1$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times1=\frac{1}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times1-7\times0\,;\,7\times2-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times2\right)=\left(-6\,;\,15\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times2+15\times\left(-2\right)+12\times6=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-11\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-1\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-2\times3\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-11\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,-38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-38\right)\times\left(-3\right)=140$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times140=\frac{70}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{70}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\right)=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+8\times1=-9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\5&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-9&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,13\,;\,56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-6\right)+13\times\left(-5\right)+56\times3=-23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times3-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times5-7\times0\right)=\left(31\,;\,18\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=31\times\left(-6\right)+18\times9+\left(-30\right)\times1=-54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-7\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-0\times1\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-20\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-20\right)\times0+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)=60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-4\times1\right)=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times0+\left(-4\right)\times3+\left(-8\right)\times5=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times5-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-0\times5\right)=\left(6\,;\,16\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-1\right)+16\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-6\times3\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times3-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-24\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-24\right)\times2+8\times9=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-4\times4\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times4-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-24\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-2\right)+6\times4=224$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times224=\frac{112}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{112}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-6\times2\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-15\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times0+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)=129$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times129=\frac{43}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&11\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&0\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times5-11\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,11\times\left(-2\right)-0\times5\right)=\left(4\,;\,32\,;\,-22\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times278=\frac{139}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{139}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)+3\times\left(-3\right)=6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-2\,;\,10\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=29}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-7&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times2-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,20\,;\,-30\right)$$
