$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times160=\frac{80}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{80}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-6\times0\,;\,6\times0-\left(-6\right)\times3\right)=\left(0\,;\,-15\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times4+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-8\right)+18\times\left(-8\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-1\times5\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times5-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)+6\times4+21\times\left(-6\right)=-66$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times66=11$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=11}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,11\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-1\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&11\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-11\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-86\,;\,-2\,;\,64\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-86\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times8+64\times0=156$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times156=26$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=26}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-9\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-6\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-9\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,42\,;\,-39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-3\right)+42\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-8\right)=174$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times174=29$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=29}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times0\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-14\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times4+\left(-14\right)\times4+6\times2=-124$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times124=\frac{62}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{62}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times6-6\times2\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times2-7\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-18\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-18\right)\times8+21\times\left(-1\right)=-435$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times435=\frac{145}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{145}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-10\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-10\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-10&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&8\\6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\7&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-6\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,6\times7-8\times6\,;\,8\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\right)=\left(36\,;\,-6\,;\,-52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times4+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-2\right)=308$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times308=\frac{154}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{154}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times4-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(13\,;\,35\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times\left(-4\right)+35\times6+1\times4=162$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&5\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-8\times0\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-5\times3\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-18\,;\,-31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-18\right)\times4+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-8\right)=188$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times188=\frac{94}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{94}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times8-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(53\,;\,50\,;\,57\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=53\times0+50\times4+57\times\left(-3\right)=29$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times29=\frac{29}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times9-0\times4\,;\,0\times0-4\times9\,;\,4\times4-1\times0\right)=\left(9\,;\,-36\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times5+\left(-36\right)\times4+16\times2=-67$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times67=\frac{67}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,1\times1-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,45\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)+45\times7+7\times\left(-8\right)=265$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times265=\frac{265}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{265}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-9&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&9\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-9\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(-11\,;\,63\,;\,-75\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times0+63\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-75\right)\times\left(-10\right)=246$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times246=41$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=41}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(33\,;\,-11\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-22\right)\times2=-88$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times88=\frac{44}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{44}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,14\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)+14\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times7-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times1-9\times7\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-3\times1\right)=\left(33\,;\,-59\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times0+\left(-59\right)\times4+\left(-30\right)\times8=-476$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times476=\frac{238}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{238}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-10\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&5\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times8-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-10\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times3-5\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(37\,;\,77\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=37\times\left(-1\right)+77\times8+\left(-15\right)\times4=519$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times519=\frac{173}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{173}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-4\times2\,;\,4\times7-1\times2\,;\,1\times2-2\times7\right)=\left(-4\,;\,26\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+26\times0+\left(-12\right)\times2=-20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times6-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times6-3\times6\right)=\left(45\,;\,-42\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-42\right)\times0+6\times\left(-10\right)=-150$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times150=25$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=25}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-0\times1\,;\,0\times2-8\times5\,;\,8\times1-0\times2\right)=\left(0\,;\,-40\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times4+\left(-40\right)\times\left(-3\right)+8\times1=128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&8\\9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-1\right)-8\times9\,;\,8\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times9-9\times4\right)=\left(-81\,;\,30\,;\,-54\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-81\right)\times7+30\times3+\left(-54\right)\times1=-531$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times531=\frac{177}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{177}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times7-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(30\,;\,-24\,;\,42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times10+\left(-24\right)\times4+42\times\left(-2\right)=120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-5\times6\,;\,5\times1-2\times3\right)=\left(17\,;\,-45\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times3+\left(-45\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)=100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-51\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-51\right)\times4=-204$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times204=34$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=34}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-4\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,14\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times2+14\times0+18\times1=38$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times38=\frac{19}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-19\right)\times\left(-5\right)=79$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times79=\frac{79}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{79}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times4-5\times7\,;\,5\times1-2\times4\,;\,2\times7-5\times1\right)=\left(-15\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times0+\left(-3\right)\times1+9\times10=87$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times87=\frac{29}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-9\right)\times5+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-27$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times27=\frac{9}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{9}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times1-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-0\times1\,;\,0\times0-7\times5\right)=\left(7\,;\,-25\,;\,-35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times0+\left(-25\right)\times7+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times4-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-12\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times3+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-30\right)\times4=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&10\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-9\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-5\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-10\times3\,;\,10\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-25\,;\,-19\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-19\right)\times2+\left(-32\right)\times6=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,20\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times0+20\times\left(-6\right)+4\times\left(-3\right)=-132$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times132=22$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=22}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,-24\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times1+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-3\right)\times3=173$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times173=\frac{173}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{173}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-10&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,35\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)+35\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-15\right)\times6=-145$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times145=\frac{145}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{145}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&10\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&9\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times3-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-10\times3\,;\,10\times3-9\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,-31\,;\,39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times3+\left(-31\right)\times0+39\times1=111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&10\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-10\times4\,;\,10\times3-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-1\times3\right)=\left(-41\,;\,25\,;\,-23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-41\right)\times\left(-3\right)+25\times2+\left(-23\right)\times7=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-4\times6\,;\,4\times1-0\times2\,;\,0\times6-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-28\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times3+4\times\left(-5\right)+2\times2=-100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,62\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times\left(-5\right)+62\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-22\right)\times1=-202$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times202=\frac{101}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{101}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-8\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)+5\times\left(-5\right)=111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\right)=\left(2\,;\,-16\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-10\right)+14\times\left(-1\right)=138$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times138=23$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=23}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(31\,;\,-27\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=31\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-27\right)\times0+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-107$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times107=\frac{107}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{107}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(35\,;\,-50\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=35\times0+\left(-50\right)\times2+9\times\left(-7\right)=-163$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times163=\frac{163}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{163}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times8-5\times2\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-2\times8\right)=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,-31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times1+\left(-2\right)\times6+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-2\right)=57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-10\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&4\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-68\,;\,32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times0+\left(-68\right)\times4+32\times\left(-9\right)=-560$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times560=\frac{280}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{280}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-6\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&8\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-8\times0\right)=\left(-72\,;\,-45\,;\,0\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=96}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times6-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-44\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-44\right)\times2+2\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times0=-94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-10\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times0+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)+29\times\left(-2\right)=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times2-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-5\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-7\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)+15\times5=-11$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times11=\frac{11}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times4-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times0-4\times4\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-5\times0\right)=\left(27\,;\,-16\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times0+\left(-16\right)\times1+\left(-4\right)\times0=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(37\,;\,-17\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=37\times2+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-7\right)=238$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times238=\frac{119}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{119}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times1+\left(-4\right)\times2+5\times\left(-3\right)=-21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&10\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-10\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-50\,;\,-41\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times2+\left(-41\right)\times1+\left(-2\right)\times0=-141$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times141=\frac{47}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&3\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\10&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-10\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times10-3\times1\,;\,3\times3-\left(-2\right)\times10\right)=\left(28\,;\,-103\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times8+\left(-103\right)\times4+29\times\left(-8\right)=-420$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times420=70$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=70}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times4\right)=\left(28\,;\,-28\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-4\right)+28\times\left(-1\right)=56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(63\,;\,26\,;\,-35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=63\times5+26\times3+\left(-35\right)\times2=323$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times323=\frac{323}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{323}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times8-7\times6\,;\,7\times1-\left(-5\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times6-1\times1\right)=\left(-34\,;\,47\,;\,-31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times\left(-1\right)+47\times3+\left(-31\right)\times4=51$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times51=\frac{17}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&8\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-8\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,4\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-7\right)+4\times6+40\times5=336$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times336=56$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=56}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times1+5\times4+2\times9=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-7&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-50\,;\,-2\,;\,33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times1+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+33\times\left(-1\right)=-79$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times79=\frac{79}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{79}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times3-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times0-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(12\,;\,18\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+18\times2+36\times2=108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-11\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&0\\-11&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-10\\9&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,0\times9-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-10\right)\times9\right)=\left(50\,;\,45\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=50\times5+45\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)=169$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times169=\frac{169}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{169}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times4-2\times2\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times2+8\times\left(-2\right)+0\times\left(-1\right)=-8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-3&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\10&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times10-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,48\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-2\right)+48\times\left(-2\right)+18\times0=-132$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times132=22$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=22}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times4-5\times1\right)=\left(-18\,;\,21\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times5+21\times3+11\times1=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&8\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-8\times0\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,24\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times5+24\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-70$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times70=\frac{35}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)+2\times\left(-7\right)=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-4\times4\,;\,4\times9-9\times2\,;\,9\times4-2\times9\right)=\left(-12\,;\,18\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times1+18\times\left(-1\right)+18\times\left(-1\right)=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)+1\times\left(-10\right)=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times2-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,46\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+46\times\left(-10\right)+13\times3=-417$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times417=\frac{139}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{139}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។
