ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times9-0\times3\,;\,0\times4-\left(-3\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(-9\,;\,27\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times2+27\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-5\right)\times4=-119$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times119=\frac{119}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{119}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-6\times0\,;\,6\times5-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times5\right)=\left(-2\,;\,40\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)+40\times4+5\times5=195$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times195=\frac{65}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times1-5\times2\,;\,5\times0-0\times1\,;\,0\times2-9\times0\right)=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)+0\times9+0\times6=6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&10\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&2\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-10\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,10\times2-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(10\,;\,20\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times3+20\times\left(-3\right)+4\times10=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times1+1\times5+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)=16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&10\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&7\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times9-10\times1\,;\,10\times2-7\times9\,;\,7\times1-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-43\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times10+\left(-43\right)\times\left(-1\right)+9\times7=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-4\times8\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times8-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-8\right)\times6+2\times\left(-7\right)=93$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times93=\frac{31}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,47\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-2\right)+47\times2+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)=184$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times184=\frac{92}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{92}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&11\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-1\times0\,;\,1\times2-11\times0\,;\,11\times0-2\times2\right)=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times10+2\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(-17\,;\,-12\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-15\right)\times7=71$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times71=\frac{71}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times3-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times0-\left(-8\right)\times3\right)=\left(48\,;\,15\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times1+15\times0+24\times1=72$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times72=12$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=12}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-11&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\0&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(-52\,;\,-6\,;\,-33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times3+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-33\right)\times1=-153$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times153=\frac{51}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{51}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-5\times3\,;\,5\times6-4\times6\,;\,4\times3-2\times6\right)=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times3+6\times\left(-4\right)+0\times\left(-5\right)=-33$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times33=\frac{11}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\right)=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times3+0\times\left(-3\right)+9\times1=-9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-3\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times9-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-8\times9\right)=\left(-26\,;\,3\,;\,-76\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times5+3\times5+\left(-76\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-39$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times39=\frac{13}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-\left(-6\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-0\times3\,;\,0\times6-3\times2\right)=\left(45\,;\,-12\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times5+\left(-12\right)\times7+\left(-6\right)\times5=111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-7\times6\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-42\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times9+\left(-42\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-14\right)\times0=-72$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times72=12$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=12}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-5\times4\,;\,5\times1-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times4-2\times1\right)=\left(-22\,;\,8\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-4\right)+8\times\left(-3\right)+10\times2=84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&10\\-2&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&2\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times10-10\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-3\right)-2\times10\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-50\,;\,-50\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-25\right)\times0=600$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times600=100$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=100}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-5\times1\,;\,5\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(11\,;\,-24\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-3\times4\,;\,3\times2-2\times1\,;\,2\times4-3\times2\right)=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times9+4\times5+2\times7=-47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\0&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-2\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,2\times0-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-10\right)\times2=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\-2&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times10-9\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,9\times1-5\times10\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(8\,;\,-41\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times10+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-9\right)\times1=317$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times317=\frac{317}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{317}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(15\,;\,-26\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-26\right)\times4+9\times3=-122$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times122=\frac{61}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times8-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-1\times8\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\right)=\left(-58\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-58\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times0+\left(-1\right)\times7=167$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times167=\frac{167}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{167}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,7\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\7&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&9\\-10&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\8&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-8\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times8-9\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,9\times7-4\times8\right)=\left(16\,;\,26\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times8+26\times6+31\times0=284$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times284=\frac{142}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{142}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times6-0\times2\,;\,0\times6-9\times6\,;\,9\times2-4\times6\right)=\left(24\,;\,-54\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times1+\left(-54\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-6\right)\times4=108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&5\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-3\times5\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times5-5\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,15\,;\,35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times9+15\times2+35\times1=-205$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times205=\frac{205}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{205}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times3-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-53\,;\,14\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-53\right)\times\left(-6\right)+14\times\left(-7\right)+2\times1=222$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times222=37$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=37}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,-27\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-2\right)+14\times\left(-8\right)=-41$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times41=\frac{41}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times2-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times3-3\times2\right)=\left(-18\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times7+2\times3+\left(-6\right)\times1=-126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-12\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-12\right)\times8+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-6\right)=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times1+\left(-5\right)\times1+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)=5$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times5=\frac{5}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-1\times0\,;\,1\times6-1\times7\,;\,1\times0-0\times6\right)=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times7+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)+0\times\left(-1\right)=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times7-3\times3\,;\,3\times0-\left(-4\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times0\right)=\left(-16\,;\,28\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-7\right)+28\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-12\right)\times3=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,11\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-1\\10&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&11\\-1&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times5-\left(-1\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times10-11\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(65\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=65\times5+6\times8+1\times\left(-1\right)=372$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times372=62$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=62}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&7\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&8\\7&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times1-7\times8\,;\,7\times7-6\times1\,;\,6\times8-8\times7\right)=\left(-48\,;\,43\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-48\right)\times6+43\times8+\left(-8\right)\times10=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-2\times4\,;\,2\times2-1\times5\,;\,1\times4-4\times2\right)=\left(12\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times2+\left(-1\right)\times2+\left(-4\right)\times6=-2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-15\,;\,38\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times\left(-2\right)+38\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-5&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-7\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(67\,;\,-25\,;\,55\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=67\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-4\right)+55\times3=-70$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times70=\frac{35}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\-1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\9&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times9-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times9\right)=\left(-33\,;\,-28\,;\,-45\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-33\right)\times0+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-45\right)\times\left(-1\right)=297$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times297=\frac{99}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{99}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,11\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&9\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times4-9\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,9\times6-3\times4\right)=\left(18\,;\,44\,;\,42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-2\right)+44\times11+42\times\left(-7\right)=154$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times154=\frac{77}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times6-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)+4\times0+8\times\left(-6\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&0\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times2-0\times6\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times6-9\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,-2\,;\,42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times7+\left(-2\right)\times2+42\times6=374$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times374=\frac{187}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{187}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-7&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-11&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times5-8\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-7\right)-2\times5\right)=\left(-64\,;\,58\,;\,-66\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-64\right)\times5+58\times1+\left(-66\right)\times0=-262$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times262=\frac{131}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{131}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&9\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times5-9\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,9\times5-1\times5\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times5\right)=\left(23\,;\,40\,;\,33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times8+40\times\left(-8\right)+33\times6=62$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times62=\frac{31}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\1&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times11-4\times1\right)=\left(58\,;\,-10\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=58\times7+\left(-10\right)\times0+\left(-26\right)\times0=406$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times406=\frac{203}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{203}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\0&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-11&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-11\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times3-8\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,8\times0-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(33\,;\,88\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times2+88\times\left(-4\right)+9\times\left(-6\right)=-340$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times340=\frac{170}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{170}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&5\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times7-5\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-1\times7\right)=\left(-16\,;\,-16\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-16\right)\times8+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-10\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-2\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,26\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-11\right)+26\times2+6\times\left(-7\right)=340$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times340=\frac{170}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{170}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-7\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-4\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-4\right)\times7+44\times\left(-4\right)=-134$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times134=\frac{67}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)+9\times\left(-2\right)=-101$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times101=\frac{101}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{101}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&10\\-9&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-6\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times5-10\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,10\times0-\left(-6\right)\times5\right)=\left(54\,;\,50\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=54\times1+50\times\left(-4\right)+30\times\left(-7\right)=-356$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times356=\frac{178}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{178}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-6\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-57\,;\,0\,;\,57\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-57\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times4+57\times0=57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)+4\times5=-78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-5\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,-17\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-3\right)+16\times\left(-5\right)=-71$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times71=\frac{71}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times1-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times3+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times1=22$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times22=\frac{11}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&1\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times3-9\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,19\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times1+19\times1+21\times\left(-7\right)=-152$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times152=\frac{76}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{76}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-25\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-8\right)\times9+2\times\left(-2\right)=99$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times99=\frac{33}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{33}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-12\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times1+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times7=15$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times15=\frac{5}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&9\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times3-9\times5\right)=\left(-30\,;\,20\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times0+20\times1+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-6\right)=128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-9\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times7-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-8\times7\right)=\left(-72\,;\,-2\,;\,-56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-72\right)\times0+\left(-2\right)\times8+\left(-56\right)\times\left(-6\right)=320$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times320=\frac{160}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{160}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-2&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\11&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times11-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times3-\left(-1\right)\times11\right)=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times5+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+17\times\left(-5\right)=-53$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times53=\frac{53}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&6\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-37\,;\,26\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-37\right)\times\left(-3\right)+26\times2+8\times5=203$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times203=\frac{203}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{203}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&6\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&10\\7&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&8\\10&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times7-6\times3\,;\,6\times10-10\times7\,;\,10\times3-8\times10\right)=\left(38\,;\,-10\,;\,-50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times8+\left(-10\right)\times9+\left(-50\right)\times6=-86$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times86=\frac{43}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-8\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times8-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times8\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-26\,;\,46\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-7\right)+46\times\left(-6\right)=-86$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times86=\frac{43}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&11\\7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-6\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times7-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times3-11\times7\,;\,11\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-65\,;\,-48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times10+\left(-65\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-48\right)\times\left(-2\right)=111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-16\,;\,11\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times1+11\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)=13$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times13=\frac{13}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times3-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times2-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(4\,;\,22\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times6+22\times1+28\times0=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
