ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times3-7\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,2\,;\,59\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-10\right)+2\times5+59\times0=150$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times150=25$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=25}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&9\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times7-9\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,27\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times0+27\times9+48\times2=339$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times339=\frac{113}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{113}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-4\\-5&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-2\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\right)=\left(70\,;\,10\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=70\times\left(-5\right)+10\times\left(-5\right)+10\times\left(-4\right)=-440$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times440=\frac{220}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{220}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(22\,;\,4\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times3+4\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-21\right)\times8=-118$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times118=\frac{59}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{59}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times8-2\times3\right)=\left(28\,;\,-10\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times3+\left(-10\right)\times1+2\times\left(-11\right)=52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times8-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(38\,;\,3\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times2+3\times\left(-1\right)+23\times9=280$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times280=\frac{140}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{140}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-5\times4\,;\,5\times2-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-28\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times2+\left(-28\right)\times1+16\times\left(-4\right)=-100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times9-6\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-6\times9\,;\,6\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-72\,;\,-60\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+\left(-72\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-60\right)\times8=24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-5&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-3\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(-20\,;\,22\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times4+22\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-19\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(34\,;\,-8\,;\,-27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-27\right)\times1=-315$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times315=\frac{105}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{105}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times5\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,-16\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times2+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-25\right)\times6=-124$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times124=\frac{62}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{62}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&4\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times7-6\times2\,;\,6\times7-4\times7\,;\,4\times2-7\times7\right)=\left(37\,;\,14\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=37\times4+14\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-41\right)\times7=-153$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times153=\frac{51}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{51}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times7-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-3\times7\right)=\left(-9\,;\,1\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times2+1\times2+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-3\right)=47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-10\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-1\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-10\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,30\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)+30\times6+7\times\left(-4\right)=179$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times179=\frac{179}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{179}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&5\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times3-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-12\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-24\right)\times5=192$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times192=32$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=32}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(34\,;\,4\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-11\right)+4\times\left(-2\right)+14\times\left(-1\right)=-396$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times396=66$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=66}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&9\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,57\,;\,-61\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times8+57\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-61\right)\times\left(-9\right)=456$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times456=76$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=76}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times4\,;\,2\times3-7\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,7\times4-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(-5\,;\,27\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times6+27\times8+31\times3=279$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times279=\frac{93}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{93}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-7\times0\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times7\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-21\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-3\right)=108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(23\,;\,15\,;\,-51\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times1+15\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-51\right)\times\left(-2\right)=35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times2-7\times0\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(5\,;\,10\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times2+10\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)=5$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times5=\frac{5}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-11\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&11\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-5\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-7\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,7\times8-11\times5\,;\,11\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\right)=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times1+1\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-15\right)\times3=-46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times3-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(24\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-3\right)\times1+3\times\left(-3\right)=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-5\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-9&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-8\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-72\,;\,-11\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-72\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-11\right)\times4+40\times\left(-9\right)=-116$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times116=\frac{58}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{58}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times2-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,19\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times\left(-1\right)+19\times\left(-2\right)+8\times2=-29$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times29=\frac{29}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-7\times1\,;\,7\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-54\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-54\right)\times6+\left(-3\right)\times4=-294$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times294=49$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=49}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times0-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-27\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-27\right)\times1+1\times6=3$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times3=\frac{1}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times7\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-6\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-6\right)\times0+13\times5=75$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times75=\frac{25}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-13\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-13\right)\times7+5\times2=-33$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times33=\frac{11}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-0\times0\right)=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)+0\times0+\left(-12\right)\times0=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-2\times4\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-14\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times7+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-5\right)+4\times\left(-7\right)=-168$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times168=28$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=28}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&5\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times0-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times3-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times3\right)=\left(20\,;\,15\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-5\right)+15\times\left(-7\right)+40\times6=35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(8\,;\,-17\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-2\right)+7\times\left(-2\right)=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-2\times1\,;\,2\times2-5\times3\,;\,5\times1-3\times2\right)=\left(7\,;\,-11\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times4+\left(-11\right)\times2+\left(-1\right)\times5=1$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times1=\frac{1}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&8\\5&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\11&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times11-8\times5\,;\,8\times0-4\times11\,;\,4\times5-7\times0\right)=\left(37\,;\,-44\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=37\times5+\left(-44\right)\times1+20\times3=201$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times201=\frac{67}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-10\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&10\\-10&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-2\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-9\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times10-10\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-10\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-7\right)\times1=-37$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times37=\frac{37}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-7\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times0-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\right)=\left(22\,;\,12\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times0+12\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&10\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times6-7\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,7\times4-10\times6\right)=\left(-50\,;\,19\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times3+19\times7+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-4\right)=111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(29\,;\,12\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=29\times\left(-6\right)+12\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-8\right)=26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times7+9\times1+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)=23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\-5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\right)=\left(-27\,;\,-51\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times0+\left(-51\right)\times\left(-5\right)+15\times\left(-2\right)=225$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times225=\frac{75}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{75}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times3-3\times5\,;\,3\times3-5\times3\,;\,5\times5-4\times3\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,13\right)$$
