$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times83=\frac{83}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times4-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times1-3\times4\right)=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times5+0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-4\right)\times4=-31$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times31=\frac{31}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&9\\2&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&7\\10&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times2-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times10-9\times2\,;\,9\times2-7\times10\right)=\left(22\,;\,-58\,;\,-52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times8+\left(-58\right)\times0+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-2\right)=280$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times280=\frac{140}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{140}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-10\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times0-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-24\,;\,-80\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-80\right)\times\left(-4\right)=344$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times344=\frac{172}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{172}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times3-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times8-2\times3\right)=\left(58\,;\,-24\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=58\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-24\right)\times1+\left(-6\right)\times0=-256$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times256=\frac{128}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{128}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-11\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-11&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-3&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times6-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-85\,;\,3\,;\,-37\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-85\right)\times\left(-1\right)+3\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-37\right)\times\left(-2\right)=144$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times144=24$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=24}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times4\,;\,2\times0-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times6+\left(-6\right)\times1+1\times\left(-1\right)=17$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times17=\frac{17}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\8&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\-10&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times8-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-60\,;\,-44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-60\right)\times3+\left(-44\right)\times0=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&8\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times7-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\right)=\left(9\,;\,62\,;\,41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times4+62\times5+41\times2=428$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times428=\frac{214}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{214}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,8\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times8-3\times7\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,18\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-5\right)+18\times8+\left(-15\right)\times0=129$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times129=\frac{43}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-13\,;\,31\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times\left(-1\right)+31\times4+\left(-16\right)\times1=121$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times121=\frac{121}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{121}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,50\,;\,-35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-8\right)+50\times0+\left(-35\right)\times0=240$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times240=40$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=40}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-0\times0\,;\,0\times4-3\times3\right)=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times3+\left(-3\right)\times2+\left(-9\right)\times2=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-4\times4\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-51\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-51\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-7\right)=333$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times333=\frac{111}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{111}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times2-\left(-5\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times9-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(55\,;\,35\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=55\times3+35\times5+\left(-20\right)\times0=340$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times340=\frac{170}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{170}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-28\,;\,37\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times0+\left(-28\right)\times4+37\times\left(-2\right)=-186$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times186=31$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=31}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-3&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-11&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-2\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-5\times7\right)=\left(-64\,;\,1\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-64\right)\times1+1\times5+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-9\right)=310$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times310=\frac{155}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{155}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\10&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times10-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(40\,;\,40\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times\left(-5\right)+40\times7+0\times6=80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times2-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times4-6\times2\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-7\times4\right)=\left(20\,;\,-4\,;\,-46\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times9+\left(-4\right)\times6+\left(-46\right)\times6=-120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-11\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-4\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(34\,;\,-98\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-98\right)\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)=-392$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times392=\frac{196}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{196}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\5&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-10&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,30\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times1+30\times6+\left(-10\right)\times1=162$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-2\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-12\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-12\right)\times8=-164$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times164=\frac{82}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{82}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,10\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)+10\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-42\right)\times1=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times0-\left(-5\right)\times4\right)=\left(20\,;\,8\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-2\right)+8\times4+20\times1=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-0\times2\,;\,0\times2-2\times3\,;\,2\times2-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times11+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)+6\times7=45$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times45=\frac{15}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{15}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times7-0\times4\,;\,0\times0-3\times7\,;\,3\times4-\left(-7\right)\times0\right)=\left(-49\,;\,-21\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-49\right)\times10+\left(-21\right)\times0+12\times4=-442$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times442=\frac{221}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{221}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-11\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-10\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times0-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,5\,;\,-90\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-1\right)+5\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-90\right)\times\left(-1\right)=60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&9\\8&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times8-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-9\times8\right)=\left(21\,;\,-43\,;\,-90\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times6+\left(-43\right)\times4+\left(-90\right)\times\left(-4\right)=314$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times314=\frac{157}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{157}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&9\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\7&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-9\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,9\times7-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\right)=\left(95\,;\,65\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=95\times2+65\times\left(-7\right)+40\times8=55$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times55=\frac{55}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-10\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-2\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times4\,;\,4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-42\,;\,-56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-42\right)\times2+\left(-56\right)\times3=-112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-6&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-11&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-11\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(33\,;\,-11\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-11\right)\times5+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-343$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times343=\frac{343}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{343}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times4-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times4+1\times\left(-6\right)+19\times\left(-4\right)=-94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-5\right)-6\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,6\times6-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-2\times6\right)=\left(2\,;\,41\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times1+41\times4+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)=208$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times208=\frac{104}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{104}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\-7&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\9&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times9-9\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times9\right)=\left(27\,;\,72\,;\,-27\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times567=\frac{189}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{189}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-8&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(50\,;\,32\,;\,-38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=50\times0+32\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-38\right)\times\left(-10\right)=284$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times284=\frac{142}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{142}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-4&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\11&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times11-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times1-6\times11\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(11\,;\,-66\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-66\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-25\right)\times6=-106$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times106=\frac{53}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times9-6\times1\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-7\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(57\,;\,12\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=57\times6+12\times2+5\times8=406$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times406=\frac{203}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{203}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-7\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,-5\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times0+\left(-5\right)\times5+13\times3=14$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times14=\frac{7}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times3-6\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-33\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times8-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(42\,;\,5\,;\,41\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times200=\frac{100}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{100}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-8\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,-32\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-24\right)\times2=42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-10&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\0&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-6\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-30\right)\times2=-148$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times148=\frac{74}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{74}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,32\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times1+32\times\left(-6\right)+20\times\left(-2\right)=-266$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times266=\frac{133}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{133}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times0-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-5\times0\,;\,5\times0-7\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times5+\left(-3\right)\times3+7\times3=12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-6\right)-2\times3\,;\,2\times5-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times3-0\times5\right)=\left(-6\,;\,22\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+22\times6+6\times4=162$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\4&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-10&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-2\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,34\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times1+34\times0+20\times\left(-7\right)=-132$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times132=22$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=22}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,22\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-5\right)+22\times1+20\times4=42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-4\times1\,;\,4\times1-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-16\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-16\right)\times3+10\times8=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times3-4\times5\,;\,4\times1-0\times3\,;\,0\times5-\left(-6\right)\times1\right)=\left(-38\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times0+4\times0+6\times6=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-17\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-5\right)+14\times1=107$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times107=\frac{107}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{107}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times5-0\times5\,;\,0\times6-3\times5\,;\,3\times5-\left(-2\right)\times6\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-15\,;\,27\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&8\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-3\times7\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,-21\,;\,-1\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-3\right)\times4+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-6\times0\,;\,6\times\left(-9\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times0-3\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-54\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-54\right)\times8+27\times1=-405$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times405=\frac{135}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{135}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-8\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-7\times8\,;\,7\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-60\,;\,-17\,;\,-71\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-60\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-71\right)\times7=17$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times17=\frac{17}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\6&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times6-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times6\right)=\left(44\,;\,32\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=44\times1+32\times\left(-1\right)+36\times\left(-1\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-6\\-8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-5&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,18\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-7\right)+18\times2+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-5\right)=156$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times156=26$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=26}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-10\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\-10&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,10\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-3\right)+10\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-75$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times75=\frac{25}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&1\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&11\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-1\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times4-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times1-11\times4\right)=\left(-12\,;\,11\,;\,-37\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times2+11\times7+\left(-37\right)\times2=-21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&10\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-4\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times8-10\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-28\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-28\right)\times1+\left(-22\right)\times5=-126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-\left(-6\right)\times4\right)=\left(44\,;\,-28\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=44\times2+\left(-28\right)\times3+9\times4=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-1\times8\,;\,1\times2-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times8-7\times2\right)=\left(-22\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times3+6\times\left(-2\right)+2\times2=-74$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times74=\frac{37}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-9\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-3\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,57\,;\,-34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times2+57\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-359$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times359=\frac{359}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{359}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times0+6\times\left(-1\right)+2\times7=8$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times8=\frac{4}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{4}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times1+\left(-3\right)\times4=-6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-3\times2\,;\,3\times6-6\times3\,;\,6\times2-0\times6\right)=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+0\times0+12\times\left(-5\right)=-42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times3-8\times2\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-10\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-10\right)\times0+0\times6=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-7\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-5\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,35\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times\left(-7\right)+35\times2+3\times\left(-3\right)=257$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times257=\frac{257}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{257}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-11\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&0\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-11\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times4-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times4-0\times4\right)=\left(44\,;\,-44\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=44\times6+\left(-44\right)\times\left(-6\right)+0\times\left(-7\right)=528$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times528=88$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=88}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
