$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\-5&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,23\,;\,-69\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-5\right)+23\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-69\right)\times\left(-5\right)=184$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times184=\frac{92}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{92}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times5-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times5\right)=\left(16\,;\,28\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-2\right)+28\times0+1\times1=-31$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times31=\frac{31}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&8\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times3-2\times0\,;\,2\times9-8\times3\,;\,8\times0-8\times9\right)=\left(24\,;\,-6\,;\,-72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times4+\left(-6\right)\times10+\left(-72\right)\times0=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-29\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-29\right)\times7+17\times\left(-2\right)=-253$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times253=\frac{253}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{253}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times8-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,18\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-5\right)+18\times9+16\times\left(-2\right)=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\9&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times9-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-3\times9\right)=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,-29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times6+6\times2+\left(-29\right)\times6=-216$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times216=36$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=36}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-11\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(19\,;\,-26\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=19\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-11\right)+48\times\left(-3\right)=28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times3-8\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(48\,;\,44\,;\,-52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times8+44\times0+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-3\right)=540$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times540=90$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=90}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,7\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&4\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times5-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times0-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times0\right)=\left(38\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times7+5\times7+2\times9=319$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times319=\frac{319}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{319}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-4\times6\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-24\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times0+\left(-24\right)\times4+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times3-9\times6\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times6-1\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-51\,;\,-24\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-51\right)\times0+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-3\right)\times1=93$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times93=\frac{31}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\7&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-7\times3\,;\,7\times7-3\times1\,;\,3\times3-0\times7\right)=\left(-21\,;\,46\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times0+46\times\left(-4\right)+9\times7=-121$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times121=\frac{121}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{121}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times1\right)=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-4\right)\times5+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times8-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-13\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times1+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-3\right)=65$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times65=\frac{65}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-1\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-13\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-13\right)\times5+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times2-3\times0\right)=\left(-19\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times8+7\times5+2\times\left(-2\right)=-121$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times121=\frac{121}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{121}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times2-9\times4\,;\,9\times1-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-1\times1\right)=\left(-34\,;\,13\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times\left(-6\right)+13\times9+\left(-9\right)\times8=249$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times249=\frac{83}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-10\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\1&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-4\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,4\times1-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\right)=\left(24\,;\,16\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times3+16\times\left(-3\right)+34\times6=228$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times228=38$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=38}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times5\right)=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times0+\left(-4\right)\times0+12\times\left(-4\right)=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times1+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+8\times1=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-1\times5\,;\,1\times5-0\times3\,;\,0\times5-0\times5\right)=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)+5\times6+0\times2=45$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times45=\frac{15}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{15}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\9&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times8-2\times6\,;\,2\times9-9\times8\,;\,9\times6-\left(-1\right)\times9\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-54\,;\,63\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times5+\left(-54\right)\times6+63\times6=-46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\2&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-8\\-11&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times2-1\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times0+5\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)=34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\9&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times9-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times9\right)=\left(35\,;\,-3\,;\,66\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=35\times10+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)+66\times\left(-2\right)=230$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times230=\frac{115}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times1-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times7+8\times\left(-1\right)+1\times\left(-7\right)=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-8\right)\times10+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times6-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-7\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(42\,;\,12\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times0+12\times2+13\times3=63$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times63=\frac{21}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{21}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times7-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times4-1\times7\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(-13\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-3\right)\times1+7\times0=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-11\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-11&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\6&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-2\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,2\times6-4\times3\,;\,4\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\right)=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times9+0\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-14\right)\times7=-35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times6-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-41\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-41\right)\times0+\left(-32\right)\times2=68$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times1-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times3-1\times1\right)=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)+5\times2+11\times\left(-1\right)=15$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times15=\frac{5}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&9\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times1-9\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,9\times3-4\times1\right)=\left(-19\,;\,37\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times9+37\times5+23\times2=60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\5&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-10&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times7-3\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,3\times5-7\times7\right)=\left(-35\,;\,-19\,;\,-34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times5+\left(-19\right)\times2+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-10\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&4\\-4&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-3\times10\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times10-4\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,-22\,;\,-84\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times0+\left(-22\right)\times0+\left(-84\right)\times\left(-4\right)=336$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times336=56$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=56}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-6\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-6\times1\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,0\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times1+0\times3+\left(-12\right)\times3=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times7-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-29\,;\,4\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-29\right)\times0+4\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-16\right)\times0=-4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\9&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times9-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-4\times9\,;\,4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\right)=\left(-71\,;\,-41\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-71\right)\times5+\left(-41\right)\times0+3\times4=-343$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times343=\frac{343}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{343}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-9&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-10\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(80\,;\,-70\,;\,55\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=80\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-70\right)\times\left(-6\right)+55\times\left(-6\right)=-70$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times70=\frac{35}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-2\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&11\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times3-11\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,26\,;\,35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times2+26\times7+35\times\left(-2\right)=58$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times58=\frac{29}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\right)=\left(14\,;\,9\,;\,26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-2\right)+9\times3+26\times1=25$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times25=\frac{25}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times5\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times5-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,-12\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-12\right)\times1+\left(-24\right)\times0=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times4-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-16\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)+24\times4=128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(19\,;\,-13\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=19\times2+\left(-13\right)\times0+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)=83$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times83=\frac{83}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,12\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-5\right)+12\times3+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-8\right)=102$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times102=17$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=17}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times5-\left(-2\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-4\times5\,;\,4\times7-9\times5\right)=\left(59\,;\,-30\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=59\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-30\right)\times3+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-368$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times368=\frac{184}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{184}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-11\,;\,25\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times4+25\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-11\right)=257$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times257=\frac{257}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{257}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\-10&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-13\,;\,34\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times\left(-8\right)+34\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)=-120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times6-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times1-3\times6\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-3\times1\right)=\left(25\,;\,-11\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times11+\left(-11\right)\times3+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)=254$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times254=\frac{127}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{127}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times1-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-7\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-5\right)=155$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times155=\frac{155}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{155}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-1\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-2\times6\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-4\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times7+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\6&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&7\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times9-10\times6\,;\,10\times2-7\times9\,;\,7\times6-4\times2\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-43\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-43\right)\times5+34\times7=47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-10&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-2\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-28\,;\,52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-3\right)+52\times1=136$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times136=\frac{68}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{68}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,-12\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-192$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times192=32$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=32}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times1-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times7-3\times1\right)=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,53\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times9+8\times\left(-2\right)+53\times4=169$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times169=\frac{169}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{169}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times2-2\times3\right)=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times8+3\times\left(-4\right)+6\times2=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+6\times\left(-9\right)+2\times\left(-7\right)=-62$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times62=\frac{31}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-1\,;\,63\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)+63\times\left(-4\right)=-268$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times268=\frac{134}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{134}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,5\,;\,-27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times3+5\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&11\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-4\right)-2\times5\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-11\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-54\,;\,-42\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-54\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-42\right)\times5+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,13\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times0+13\times\left(-4\right)+1\times\left(-1\right)=-53$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times53=\frac{53}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\10&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\0&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-7\right)-1\times10\,;\,1\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times10-7\times0\right)=\left(-59\,;\,-28\,;\,-40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-59\right)\times3+\left(-28\right)\times6+\left(-40\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-265$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times265=\frac{265}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{265}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-1\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-44\,;\,32\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-44\right)\times1+32\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,-10\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)+20\times4=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,11\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,11\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-9\\3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&11\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-11\times1\right)=\left(-50\,;\,-37\,;\,-23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-37\right)\times11+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-3\right)=112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-7\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\right)=\left(27\,;\,9\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times5+9\times2+24\times\left(-1\right)=129$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times129=\frac{43}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-8\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-64\,;\,-6\,;\,50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-64\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+50\times\left(-7\right)=180$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times180=30$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=30}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-0\times1\right)=\left(4\,;\,24\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times3+24\times1+\left(-20\right)\times1=16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\9&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times9-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-30\,;\,33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times5+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-2\right)+33\times2=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
