$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times3-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(16\,;\,30\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times4+30\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-0\times3\right)=\left(0\,;\,-28\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-9\right)=28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,14\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-2\right)+14\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times0=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times5-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times5\right)=\left(57\,;\,27\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=57\times\left(-5\right)+27\times0+24\times0=-285$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times285=\frac{95}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{95}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,28\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+28\times\left(-6\right)+10\times0=-152$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times152=\frac{76}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{76}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-5\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times0-3\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-20\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-20\right)\times6+15\times\left(-2\right)=-150$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times150=25$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=25}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-7\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times4-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\right)=\left(42\,;\,-14\,;\,26\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times140=\frac{70}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{70}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\4&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-9&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times4-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-0\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,22\,;\,-3\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times146=\frac{73}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{73}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&9\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-7\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,7\times6-9\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-15\,;\,29\,;\,78\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times77=\frac{77}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&11\\-2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-3\right)-2\times10\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times10-11\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-53\,;\,2\,;\,42\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times428=\frac{214}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{214}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-11\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-8\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times0-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-11\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,64\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-5\right)+0\times\left(-3\right)+64\times2=128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\9&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times9-6\times1\,;\,6\times8-1\times9\right)=\left(17\,;\,-24\,;\,39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times8+\left(-24\right)\times3+39\times\left(-6\right)=-170$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times170=\frac{85}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{85}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times4-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-0\times4\right)=\left(18\,;\,8\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-2\right)+8\times2+\left(-24\right)\times2=-68$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&5\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&8\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-2\right)-5\times7\,;\,5\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-8\times0\right)=\left(-51\,;\,-6\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-51\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times8+\left(-21\right)\times5=51$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times51=\frac{17}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times8-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times7-2\times8\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times9+5\times2+10\times1=-70$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times70=\frac{35}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times8-5\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-1\times8\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-23\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times1+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-19\right)\times5=-23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times7-\left(-1\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-0\times7\,;\,0\times7-5\times0\right)=\left(42\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times\left(-7\right)+0\times8+0\times\left(-3\right)=-294$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times294=49$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=49}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\right)=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,30\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=35}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,-45\,;\,49\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times2+\left(-45\right)\times0+49\times1=83$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times83=\frac{83}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&10\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times4-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-10\times5\right)=\left(40\,;\,-11\,;\,-50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times6+\left(-11\right)\times0+\left(-50\right)\times0=240$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times240=40$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=40}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times1-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times6-0\times1\right)=\left(-12\,;\,18\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times2+18\times6+24\times1=108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-6\times7\,;\,6\times4-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-\left(-4\right)\times4\right)=\left(-66\,;\,42\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-66\right)\times8+42\times1+\left(-5\right)\times5=-511$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times511=\frac{511}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{511}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,2\times2-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,22\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times5+22\times\left(-6\right)+13\times\left(-6\right)=-310$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times310=\frac{155}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{155}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-9\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&6\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-9\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times6-6\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,6\times2-7\times6\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-30\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times1+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-17\right)\times8=110$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times110=\frac{55}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-5\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-7\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,7\times0-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,43\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times2+43\times0+\left(-21\right)\times5=-49$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times49=\frac{49}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{49}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-7\times1\,;\,7\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-23\,;\,-38\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-38\right)\times0+\left(-25\right)\times2=-27$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times27=\frac{9}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{9}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)+2\times1+7\times\left(-6\right)=-37$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times37=\frac{37}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&1\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-26\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-1\right)+27\times\left(-5\right)=-117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-10\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-10\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times0-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(14\,;\,-80\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-80\right)\times\left(-1\right)+10\times\left(-5\right)=2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&9\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-6\\10&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times1-6\times2\,;\,6\times10-9\times1\,;\,9\times2-\left(-6\right)\times10\right)=\left(-18\,;\,51\,;\,78\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times1+51\times\left(-2\right)+78\times7=426$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times426=71$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=71}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,10\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\-7&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times4-4\times10\,;\,4\times\left(-7\right)-4\times4\,;\,4\times10-9\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-44\,;\,103\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times2+\left(-44\right)\times5+103\times7=493$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times493=\frac{493}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{493}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,7\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-11\\1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&8\\-9&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&7\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-11\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times6-8\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,8\times1-7\times6\right)=\left(-52\,;\,6\,;\,-34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times5+6\times6+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-88$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times88=\frac{44}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{44}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\right)=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times0+5\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&10\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-6\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times0-7\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,7\times2-10\times0\right)=\left(-60\,;\,42\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-60\right)\times\left(-3\right)+42\times3+14\times\left(-2\right)=278$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times278=\frac{139}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{139}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-6\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times0-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-3\right)+6\times5+8\times\left(-9\right)=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-11\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&3\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times1-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(-41\,;\,13\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-41\right)\times1+13\times2+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-6\right)=45$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times45=\frac{15}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{15}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times1\,;\,4\times1-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(11\,;\,23\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-3\right)+23\times9+10\times\left(-1\right)=164$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times164=\frac{82}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{82}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-2\times0\right)=\left(12\,;\,-6\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-6\right)\times1+\left(-12\right)\times0=-18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(22\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-3\right)\times3+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-8\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,47\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times2+47\times3+28\times10=381$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times381=\frac{127}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{127}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-7\times1\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times7+\left(-7\right)\times2+\left(-25\right)\times8=-270$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times270=45$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=45}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\10&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-8\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,8\times10-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-0\times10\right)=\left(48\,;\,80\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times5+80\times3+0\times9=480$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times480=80$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=80}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times9-5\times2\,;\,5\times4-2\times9\,;\,2\times2-3\times4\right)=\left(17\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-4\right)+2\times10+\left(-8\right)\times6=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\0&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-2\times0\,;\,2\times4-\left(-5\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(-27\,;\,53\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times2+53\times\left(-8\right)+12\times11=-346$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times346=\frac{173}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{173}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-15\right)\times4=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,8\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\8&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&10\\-8&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&4\\8&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-8\right)-1\times8\,;\,1\times8-10\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,10\times8-4\times8\right)=\left(-40\,;\,88\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times0+88\times7+48\times\left(-6\right)=328$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times328=\frac{164}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{164}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-12\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times2+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-6\right)+18\times\left(-5\right)=-42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times6-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times2-1\times6\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times10+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-3\right)\times4=-114$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times114=19$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=19}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-10\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-5\\-10&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,10\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-4\right)+10\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-7&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-4\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(31\,;\,32\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=31\times2+32\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\4&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\10&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times4-4\times1\,;\,4\times10-2\times4\,;\,2\times1-\left(-2\right)\times10\right)=\left(-12\,;\,32\,;\,22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times8+32\times3+22\times1=22$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times22=\frac{11}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(27\,;\,-11\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times1+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)=54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-8\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times1-6\times2\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-2\times1\,;\,2\times2-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-26\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-24\right)\times7=135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-9\right)-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,-44\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-44\right)\times4+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-173$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times173=\frac{173}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{173}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(19\,;\,-11\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=19\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-11\right)\times6+\left(-5\right)\times0=-85$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times85=\frac{85}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{85}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times4\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times1+\left(-2\right)\times4+\left(-8\right)\times1=-30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&7\\-4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times7-7\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,7\times4-1\times7\right)=\left(32\,;\,-35\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times0+\left(-35\right)\times9+21\times\left(-6\right)=-441$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times441=\frac{147}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{147}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,9\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&8\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-8\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&9\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times8-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(80\,;\,24\,;\,53\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=80\times\left(-3\right)+24\times3+53\times3=-9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,11\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&4\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&11\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times3-4\times2\,;\,4\times3-0\times3\,;\,0\times2-11\times3\right)=\left(25\,;\,12\,;\,-33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times1+12\times4+\left(-33\right)\times1=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,6\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\6&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-9&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\11&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times11-1\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,1\times6-1\times11\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times0+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-5\right)\times0=4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-1\times9\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times9-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,1\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-5\right)+1\times1+13\times1=99$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times99=\frac{33}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{33}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times2-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,20\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times0+20\times6+4\times\left(-8\right)=88$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times88=\frac{44}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{44}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-2\right)-0\times5\,;\,0\times7-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times5-5\times7\right)=\left(-10\,;\,10\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times3+10\times5+\left(-10\right)\times0=20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-4\right)+10\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-9\right)\times1=-55$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times55=\frac{55}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-7\times3\,;\,7\times2-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times2\right)=\left(-25\,;\,18\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times0+18\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-2\right)\times0=-72$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times72=12$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=12}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&6\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,10\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times3+10\times2+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)=126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-9\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,9\times2-\left(-7\right)\times5\right)=\left(32\,;\,26\,;\,53\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times3+26\times\left(-6\right)+53\times4=152$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times152=\frac{76}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{76}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-13\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times5+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-11\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&0\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(15\,;\,-90\,;\,55\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-90\right)\times4+55\times\left(-3\right)=-660$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times660=110$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=110}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&9\\-1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\9&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times9-9\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times9\right)=\left(-25\,;\,-54\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times8+\left(-54\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-9\right)\times1=-47$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times47=\frac{47}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-9\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&2\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-2\times0\,;\,2\times1-4\times5\right)=\left(9\,;\,-45\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times3+\left(-45\right)\times1+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-10\right)=162$$
