ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)+8\times0+\left(-4\right)\times2=9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-7\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-8\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,46\,;\,60\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times\left(-4\right)+46\times6+60\times\left(-3\right)=200$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times200=\frac{100}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{100}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-5\times4\,;\,5\times2-6\times1\,;\,6\times4-3\times2\right)=\left(-17\,;\,4\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)+4\times0+18\times7=143$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times143=\frac{143}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{143}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\9&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&8\\0&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times3-1\times9\,;\,1\times0-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times9-8\times0\right)=\left(15\,;\,9\,;\,-27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-3\right)+9\times0+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-8\right)=171$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times171=\frac{57}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{57}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times1-6\times0\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\right)=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times1+6\times1+\left(-2\right)\times1=10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&10\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-10\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-2\right)-1\times3\right)=\left(-18\,;\,19\,;\,-23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times6+19\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-5&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-11&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-3\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,61\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-5\right)+61\times1+30\times\left(-6\right)=-134$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times134=\frac{67}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-1\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times4-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-2\times4\,;\,2\times2-\left(-8\right)\times0\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times6+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)+4\times0=-124$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times124=\frac{62}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{62}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\5&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-9&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-4\times3\,;\,4\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-4\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-11\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-7\right)+21\times0=37$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times37=\frac{37}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\9&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times9-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-8\right)-0\times9\,;\,0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-40\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-40\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-8\right)\times6=194$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times194=\frac{97}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{97}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times8\right)=\left(6\,;\,13\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times5+13\times1+3\times\left(-6\right)=25$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times25=\frac{25}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-6\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,38\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-5\right)+38\times0+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-9\right)=274$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times274=\frac{137}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{137}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-1\times1\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-22\,;\,42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times9+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-1\right)+42\times4=-62$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times62=\frac{31}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times8-1\times2\,;\,1\times0-3\times8\,;\,3\times2-3\times0\right)=\left(22\,;\,-24\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times6+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-6\right)+6\times2=288$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times288=48$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=48}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-6&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times9-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times0-\left(-4\right)\times9\right)=\left(24\,;\,-18\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times3+\left(-18\right)\times0+36\times\left(-8\right)=-216$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times216=36$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=36}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,10\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\10&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-5\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,5\times10-1\times2\right)=\left(3\,;\,33\,;\,48\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-4\right)+33\times3+48\times1=135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times2-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-8\times2\right)=\left(-34\,;\,9\,;\,-19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times10+9\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-19\right)\times3=-424$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times424=\frac{212}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{212}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-8\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times1-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)-4\times1\right)=\left(29\,;\,13\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=29\times2+13\times\left(-1\right)+36\times3=153$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times3-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\right)=\left(35\,;\,0\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=35\times\left(-4\right)+0\times\left(-7\right)+15\times\left(-6\right)=-230$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times230=\frac{115}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times5-1\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,14\,;\,22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times5+14\times\left(-9\right)+22\times3=-70$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times70=\frac{35}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times5-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\right)=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times8+2\times\left(-8\right)+2\times\left(-6\right)=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-5&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)-3\times2\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-58\,;\,34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-58\right)\times4+34\times\left(-6\right)=-202$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times202=\frac{101}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{101}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times9-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,6\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times2+6\times\left(-3\right)+16\times9=166$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times166=\frac{83}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{83}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-10\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&2\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\-8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-10\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times5-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times0-\left(-10\right)\times5\right)=\left(80\,;\,34\,;\,50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=80\times8+34\times0+50\times\left(-7\right)=290$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times290=\frac{145}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{145}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&9\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times6-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-9\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times3+\left(-9\right)\times0+\left(-12\right)\times9=-135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-14\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times0+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-7\right)+6\times\left(-5\right)=68$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-5&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-11&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(55\,;\,-55\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=55\times4+\left(-55\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)=305$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times305=\frac{305}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{305}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&8\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-8\times0\,;\,8\times5-2\times0\,;\,2\times0-\left(-3\right)\times5\right)=\left(0\,;\,40\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+40\times\left(-9\right)+15\times3=-315$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times315=\frac{105}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{105}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-3\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,32\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-9\right)+32\times\left(-6\right)+12\times2=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-3\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,3\times0-5\times0\right)=\left(-45\,;\,27\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-45\right)\times6+27\times0+0\times\left(-4\right)=-270$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times270=45$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=45}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,-39\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)=104$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times104=\frac{52}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{52}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times8-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times4-0\times8\right)=\left(16\,;\,-25\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times4+\left(-25\right)\times3+28\times\left(-3\right)=-95$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times95=\frac{95}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{95}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,9\,;\,32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-5\right)+9\times\left(-2\right)+32\times0=137$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times137=\frac{137}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{137}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\7&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\9&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times9-5\times7\,;\,5\times3-7\times9\,;\,7\times7-3\times3\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-48\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-48\right)\times10+40\times5=-264$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times264=44$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=44}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,10\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-9\right)+10\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-128$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times128=\frac{64}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{64}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times8-4\times2\,;\,4\times3-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(-16\,;\,28\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times5+28\times0+\left(-1\right)\times5=-85$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times85=\frac{85}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{85}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\4&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-10&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times4-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,24\,;\,52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-4\right)+24\times6+52\times\left(-1\right)=28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-2\times1\,;\,2\times4-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-0\times4\right)=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+8\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-4\right)\times10=-92$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times92=\frac{46}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{46}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-2\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times1-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-21\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-21\right)\times6+\left(-6\right)\times3=-54$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)+2\times\left(-1\right)+4\times\left(-6\right)=-23$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times23=\frac{23}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\9&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times9-7\times4\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-1\times9\,;\,1\times4-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-44\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times4+\left(-44\right)\times3+4\times6=-220$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times220=\frac{110}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{110}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-7&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\11&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times11-6\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-0\times11\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-35\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times9+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-4\right)=268$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times268=\frac{134}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{134}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\8&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times8-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(37\,;\,-51\,;\,-10\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times309=\frac{103}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{103}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-7\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times200=\frac{100}{3}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times156=26$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=26}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times5\,;\,0\times4-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times5-\left(-4\right)\times4\right)=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times4+3\times\left(-3\right)+31\times2=69$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times69=\frac{23}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
