ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times7-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times5-1\times7\right)=\left(28\,;\,-28\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times9+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-2\right)+28\times\left(-7\right)=112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times1\,;\,4\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,8\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-2\right)+8\times\left(-4\right)+11\times\left(-6\right)=-132$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times132=22$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=22}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-2\times3\,;\,2\times1-\left(-7\right)\times6\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-18\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times6+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-5\right)+44\times2=64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-8\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-3\times1\right)=\left(21\,;\,-10\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-10\right)\times1+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-121$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times121=\frac{121}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{121}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-1\times3\,;\,1\times1-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-9\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times2+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)+11\times3=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\-4&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-11&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\right)=\left(16\,;\,-57\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times5+\left(-57\right)\times\left(-1\right)+28\times\left(-10\right)=-143$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times143=\frac{143}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{143}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\9&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times6-3\times9\,;\,3\times4-3\times6\,;\,3\times9-4\times4\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times9+\left(-6\right)\times0+11\times\left(-1\right)=-38$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times38=\frac{19}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,10\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times0+10\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-22\right)\times6=-162$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&10\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-6\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times6-10\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-34\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-4\right)+27\times\left(-1\right)=-115$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times115=\frac{115}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times5-9\times4\right)=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times0+0\times8+\left(-16\right)\times2=-32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times1-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times2-3\times1\right)=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times1+4\times3+3\times\left(-1\right)=4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\6&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\10&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times6-7\times5\,;\,7\times10-0\times6\,;\,0\times5-\left(-2\right)\times10\right)=\left(-47\,;\,70\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-47\right)\times3+70\times4+20\times\left(-1\right)=119$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times119=\frac{119}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{119}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-11\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&2\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-11\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times5-2\times0\,;\,2\times1-\left(-3\right)\times5\right)=\left(11\,;\,-55\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-55\right)\times0+17\times\left(-5\right)=-129$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times129=\frac{43}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-6\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times6-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times1-\left(-6\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times1\right)=\left(45\,;\,45\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times5+45\times\left(-3\right)+30\times6=270$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times270=45$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=45}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times1-3\times6\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-16\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times3+\left(-16\right)\times0+1\times5=-61$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times61=\frac{61}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{61}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(8\,;\,-23\,;\,25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times1+\left(-23\right)\times0+25\times\left(-6\right)=-142$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times142=\frac{71}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\8&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times5-4\times5\,;\,4\times8-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times8\right)=\left(-35\,;\,47\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times\left(-2\right)+47\times6+9\times0=352$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times352=\frac{176}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{176}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,8\,;\,40\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times\left(-2\right)+8\times9+40\times0=124$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times124=\frac{62}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{62}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,32\,;\,-52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-5\right)+32\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-52\right)\times3=-68$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-9&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\9&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\8&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times9-6\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,6\times8-2\times9\,;\,2\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\right)=\left(18\,;\,30\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times8+30\times1+14\times8=286$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times286=\frac{143}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{143}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(3\,;\,15\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-4\right)+15\times4+15\times\left(-1\right)=33$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times33=\frac{11}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{11}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-6\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-5\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,7\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-7\right)+7\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times7-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times5+\left(-4\right)\times7+6\times6=-77$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times77=\frac{77}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,5\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&11\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-9\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&5\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times6-11\times2\,;\,11\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times2-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-1\right)\times1+7\times0=-41$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times41=\frac{41}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times5-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(39\,;\,-15\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=39\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-15\right)\times5+21\times\left(-6\right)=-357$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times357=\frac{119}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{119}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&8\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-7\times2\,;\,7\times8-8\times4\,;\,8\times2-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(-18\,;\,24\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times4+24\times\left(-1\right)+24\times6=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-9\times4\right)=\left(-31\,;\,-18\,;\,-50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times2+\left(-18\right)\times5+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-8\right)=248$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times248=\frac{124}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{124}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&5\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\0&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-\left(-8\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-5\times1\,;\,5\times10-0\times0\right)=\left(80\,;\,-5\,;\,50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=80\times5+\left(-5\right)\times3+50\times\left(-1\right)=335$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times335=\frac{335}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{335}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&6\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-6\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,6\times0-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\right)=\left(48\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times2+8\times0+\left(-4\right)\times7=68$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times68=\frac{34}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{34}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-4\times3\,;\,4\times3-0\times5\,;\,0\times3-4\times3\right)=\left(8\,;\,12\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times1+12\times0+\left(-12\right)\times9=-100$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times100=\frac{50}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{50}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times0-4\times5\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-4\times0\right)=\left(20\,;\,-20\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-24\right)\times6=-164$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times164=\frac{82}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{82}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times7-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-9\times7\,;\,9\times\left(-1\right)-4\times2\right)=\left(26\,;\,-67\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times7+\left(-67\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-3\right)=434$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times434=\frac{217}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{217}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-8\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times0-\left(-8\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-0\times0\,;\,0\times9-9\times1\right)=\left(72\,;\,-8\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=72\times0+\left(-8\right)\times8+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\10&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times10-4\times5\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-8\right)\times10\right)=\left(-52\,;\,-40\,;\,56\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times10+\left(-40\right)\times\left(-6\right)+56\times6=56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\10&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&9\\-2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times8-\left(-2\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-9\times8\,;\,9\times10-9\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(92\,;\,-68\,;\,108\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=92\times3+\left(-68\right)\times1+108\times1=316$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times316=\frac{158}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{158}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times4-9\times0\,;\,9\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times11+0\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)=42$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times42=7$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=7}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-3\right)-7\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,24\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times9+24\times1+\left(-11\right)\times0=-228$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times228=38$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=38}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-2\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times3-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times1-6\times3\right)=\left(-12\,;\,2\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)+2\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)=49$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times49=\frac{49}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{49}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times3-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,9\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)+9\times0+11\times0=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times7+\left(-2\right)\times1+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)=27$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times27=\frac{9}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{9}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(15\,;\,-21\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-4\right)+18\times\left(-9\right)=-123$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times123=\frac{41}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\6&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-6\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,6\times6-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times6\right)=\left(72\,;\,36\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=72\times7+36\times\left(-4\right)+36\times2=432$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times432=72$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=72}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times5-5\times3\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-1\times5\,;\,1\times3-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times5+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+5\times\left(-1\right)=-10$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times10=\frac{5}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{5}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&10\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-4\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-10\times3\,;\,10\times0-\left(-4\right)\times4\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-34\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times1+\left(-34\right)\times5+16\times5=-102$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times102=17$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=17}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times3-9\times4\,;\,9\times3-5\times3\,;\,5\times4-2\times3\right)=\left(-30\,;\,12\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times4+12\times6+14\times1=-34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&1\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-10\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times2-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times2+11\times\left(-7\right)+2\times\left(-2\right)=-117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-8\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-7\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times3\right)=\left(25\,;\,26\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times5+26\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-11\right)\times1=-94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-11\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&1\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-5\times3\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times3-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-63\,;\,-27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-63\right)\times0+\left(-27\right)\times1=117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&9\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-4\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-9\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(72\,;\,-54\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=72\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-54\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-4\right)\times7=-28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times3-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-4\right)-2\times3\right)=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times6+5\times3+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-4\right)=107$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times107=\frac{107}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{107}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times4-3\times8\right)=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times9+\left(-5\right)\times3+\left(-12\right)\times2=-30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-3&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-11&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(15\,;\,-42\,;\,-55\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times0+\left(-42\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-55\right)\times1=239$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times239=\frac{239}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{239}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times2-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-4\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,12\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times9+12\times3+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times8-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-1\times8\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-16\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times4+\left(-16\right)\times1+\left(-11\right)\times0=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-3\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-16\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-16\right)\times2+6\times4=34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-34\,;\,22\,;\,-26\right)$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times154=\frac{77}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-3\times0\,;\,3\times4-3\times1\,;\,3\times0-4\times4\right)=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,-16\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times4-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,25\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times7+25\times10+16\times2=310$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times310=\frac{155}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{155}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times3-5\times5\right)=\left(-27\,;\,1\,;\,-22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times2+1\times3+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-5\right)=59$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times59=\frac{59}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{59}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times5\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times5-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,4\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times2+4\times\left(-2\right)+18\times\left(-4\right)=-114$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times114=19$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=19}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times8-2\times1\,;\,2\times0-\left(-2\right)\times8\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-18\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times9+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)+16\times\left(-1\right)=2$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times2=\frac{1}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-7\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times2-3\times0\,;\,3\times2-6\times2\,;\,6\times0-\left(-7\right)\times2\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-6\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)+14\times8=120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&0\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times1-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times2-2\times1\right)=\left(8\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times11+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-2\right)\times1=131$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times131=\frac{131}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{131}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times5-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\right)=\left(8\,;\,32\,;\,54\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times7+32\times\left(-6\right)+54\times3=26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-2\times3\right)=\left(34\,;\,-21\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-21\right)\times4+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-98$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times98=\frac{49}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{49}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-3\times3\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-36\,;\,-34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-3\right)=154$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times154=\frac{77}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-0\times1\,;\,0\times3-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-4\times3\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+0\times5+\left(-18\right)\times8=-144$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times144=24$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=24}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\11&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-7&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times2-\left(-6\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times11-4\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(74\,;\,40\,;\,39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=74\times1+40\times5+39\times2=352$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times352=\frac{176}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{176}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times0-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(20\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times5+0\times\left(-6\right)+10\times\left(-2\right)=80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-6\right)+10\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)=76$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times76=\frac{38}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{38}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
