$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-0\times1\,;\,0\times8-9\times6\,;\,9\times1-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-54\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times7+\left(-54\right)\times1+17\times8=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-10\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times0-\left(-10\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,20\,;\,5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-9\right)+20\times4+5\times\left(-11\right)=-245$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times245=\frac{245}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{245}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\right)=\left(20\,;\,-16\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times0+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-1\right)+12\times2=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&7\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-6\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&9\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times4-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(43\,;\,-25\,;\,69\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=43\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-1\right)+69\times\left(-2\right)=-199$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times199=\frac{199}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{199}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&10\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-7\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times4-10\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,10\times0-0\times4\right)=\left(0\,;\,78\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times8+78\times1+0\times\left(-6\right)=78$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times78=13$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=13}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-6\times3\,;\,6\times2-3\times5\right)=\left(11\,;\,-23\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times3+\left(-23\right)\times4+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-53$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times53=\frac{53}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times2-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-5\times2\,;\,5\times0-7\times5\right)=\left(14\,;\,-35\,;\,-35\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times7+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-1\right)=203$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times203=\frac{203}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{203}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\9&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\-1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times6-\left(-1\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times9-8\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(57\,;\,-5\,;\,17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=57\times1+\left(-5\right)\times0+17\times0=57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times6-7\times3\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\right)=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times7+3\times\left(-5\right)+16\times2=-32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times9+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times7=-138$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times138=23$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=23}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-6&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times1-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times9-8\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(26\,;\,18\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times2+18\times0+\left(-6\right)\times1=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,39\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-7\right)\times2+39\times\left(-2\right)=-85$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times85=\frac{85}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{85}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&11\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-11\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,11\times\left(-4\right)-2\times5\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(50\,;\,-54\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=50\times1+\left(-54\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-14\right)\times10=72$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times72=12$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=12}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-7\times5\,;\,7\times2-4\times5\,;\,4\times5-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-6\,;\,22\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times0+\left(-6\right)\times4+22\times7=130$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times130=\frac{65}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&7\\7&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times3-\left(-2\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-8\times3\,;\,8\times10-7\times7\right)=\left(41\,;\,-38\,;\,31\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=41\times8+\left(-38\right)\times5+31\times4=262$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times262=\frac{131}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{131}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times8-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-6\times8\right)=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-58\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-5\right)\times4+\left(-58\right)\times\left(-2\right)=84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&9\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&9\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&9\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times3-9\times8\,;\,9\times4-9\times3\,;\,9\times8-9\times4\right)=\left(-45\,;\,9\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-45\right)\times11+9\times7+36\times0=-432$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times432=72$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=72}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-2\times2\right)=\left(8\,;\,6\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times0+6\times4+\left(-20\right)\times2=-16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-9\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,30\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times6+30\times10+6\times\left(-5\right)=126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-8\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-10\right)\times0\right)=\left(-16\,;\,8\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times2+8\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-14\right)\times0=-80$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times80=\frac{40}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{40}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&8\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-6\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-1\right)-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-8\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-38\,;\,38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-38\right)\times0+38\times2=76$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times76=\frac{38}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{38}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times2-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-6\times2\right)=\left(-27\,;\,7\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times\left(-3\right)+7\times3+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-1\right)=117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-4\times5\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-8\,;\,-38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-8\right)\times3+\left(-38\right)\times2=28$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times28=\frac{14}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{14}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,6\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-1\right)+6\times0+\left(-11\right)\times5=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-3\times4\right)=\left(-13\,;\,0\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times3+0\times2+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-6\right)=117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times2\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times6+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,-30\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-32\right)\times4=-50$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times50=\frac{25}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times4-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-7\times7\right)=\left(43\,;\,-9\,;\,-64\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=43\times5+\left(-9\right)\times4+\left(-64\right)\times\left(-7\right)=627$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times627=\frac{209}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{209}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times2-7\times6\,;\,7\times6-0\times2\,;\,0\times6-6\times6\right)=\left(-30\,;\,42\,;\,-36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times2+42\times7+\left(-36\right)\times2=162$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times162=27$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=27}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-8\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times5-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times4-5\times5\right)=\left(17\,;\,-40\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-40\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-2\right)=233$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times233=\frac{233}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{233}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times0-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(12\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+4\times3+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\right)=\left(11\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times1+5\times2+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)=24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times6-\left(-3\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times8-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times0+6\times6+2\times5=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&11\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&10\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-11\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,11\times4-10\times3\right)=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times8+2\times7+14\times\left(-5\right)=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-2\times1\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-7\right)\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)=52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-6&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times5-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-23\,;\,14\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times3+14\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-141$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times141=\frac{47}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&10\\4&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\11&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times11-10\times4\,;\,10\times4-\left(-5\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-0\times4\right)=\left(-40\,;\,95\,;\,-20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times4+95\times6+\left(-20\right)\times3=350$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times350=\frac{175}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{175}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-8\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times0-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-9\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-3\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times2-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times0-7\times2\right)=\left(-21\,;\,18\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times5+18\times1+\left(-14\right)\times2=-115$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times115=\frac{115}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{115}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times4-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times3-2\times4\,;\,2\times\left(-8\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times0+\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-16\right)\times6=-112$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times112=\frac{56}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{56}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times5-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-3\times5\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(-23\,;\,-23\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times3+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-5\right)+0\times\left(-5\right)=46$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times46=\frac{23}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-10\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&4\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-6\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,6\times6-4\times6\,;\,4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\right)=\left(18\,;\,12\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-1\right)+12\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-4\right)\times1=-142$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times142=\frac{71}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{71}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-8\times0\,;\,8\times1-0\times1\,;\,0\times0-4\times1\right)=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times1+8\times5+\left(-4\right)\times2=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&10\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&5\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-10\times2\,;\,10\times1-5\times4\,;\,5\times2-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-10\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times8+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)+13\times9=-119$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times119=\frac{119}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{119}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-10\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-5\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-30\,;\,25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-6\right)+25\times0=336$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times336=56$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=56}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,18\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times0+18\times0+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-8\right)=144$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times144=24$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=24}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\9&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times9-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-64\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times3+\left(-64\right)\times0+44\times\left(-1\right)=-56$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times56=\frac{28}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{28}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&6\\10&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times10-8\times1\,;\,8\times6-6\times10\,;\,6\times1-1\times6\right)=\left(2\,;\,-12\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times4+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-3\right)+0\times2=44$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times44=\frac{22}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{22}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-9\times4\,;\,9\times6-1\times2\,;\,1\times4-\left(-2\right)\times6\right)=\left(-40\,;\,52\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-1\right)+52\times3+16\times\left(-1\right)=180$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times180=30$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=30}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times8-3\times5\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-0\times8\,;\,0\times5-5\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(25\,;\,-18\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-18\right)\times2+30\times9=134$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times134=\frac{67}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&10\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-6\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times8-10\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,10\times0-\left(-6\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times0\right)=\left(46\,;\,48\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=46\times\left(-8\right)+48\times\left(-4\right)+18\times10=-380$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times380=\frac{190}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{190}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\-10&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-0\times8\right)=\left(9\,;\,-82\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times4+\left(-82\right)\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)=-38$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times38=\frac{19}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times5-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\right)=\left(27\,;\,23\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times2+23\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-1\right)\times2=-86$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times86=\frac{43}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{43}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,18\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times1+18\times\left(-4\right)+12\times4=-36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-2&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-11&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,12\,;\,-50\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-10\right)+12\times2+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-10\right)=444$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times444=74$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=74}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-9\\-8&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(78\,;\,-72\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=78\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-72\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-214$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times214=\frac{107}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{107}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-1\times1\,;\,1\times0-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times0+\left(-9\right)\times5+2\times0=-45$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times45=\frac{15}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{15}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-6\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-13\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times1+\left(-13\right)\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)=18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-9&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\1&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(-20\,;\,40\,;\,-76\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-2\right)+40\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-76\right)\times\left(-11\right)=516$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times516=86$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=86}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-10\right)+12\times5=84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-11\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-8\\-11&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-10\\1&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-10\right)\times1\right)=\left(-48\,;\,-24\,;\,54\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-48\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-5\right)+54\times\left(-1\right)=546$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times546=91$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=91}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times0-1\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-3\right)\times6+3\times5=1$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times1=\frac{1}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times2\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-22\,;\,-4\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times144=24$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=24}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&11\\4&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-3\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times10-11\times4\,;\,11\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-84\,;\,-3\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-84\right)\times6+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-24\right)\times5=-615$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times615=\frac{205}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{205}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
