ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-2\times1\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-2\right)\times3+\left(-9\right)\times6=-44$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times44=\frac{22}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{22}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-5\right)-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-25\,;\,-20\,;\,6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-20\right)\times0+6\times\left(-2\right)=13$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times13=\frac{13}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-6\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-6&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&10\\-10&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-4\\9&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times9-10\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\right)=\left(4\,;\,46\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times4+46\times2+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-6\right)=252$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times252=42$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=42}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-7&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\10&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times10-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times0-1\times10\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-1\times0\right)=\left(24\,;\,-10\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times3+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)=179$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times179=\frac{179}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{179}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times5-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times1-7\times5\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times1\right)=\left(-23\,;\,-32\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-3\right)=141$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times141=\frac{47}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times1+2\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-3\right)\times2=-19$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times19=\frac{19}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times6-6\times6\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times6-3\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-36\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-36\right)\times1+15\times5=57$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times57=\frac{19}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{19}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times8-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times8\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-39\,;\,27\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-1\right)+27\times\left(-1\right)=30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\-8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times6-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,46\,;\,29\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)+46\times\left(-5\right)+29\times2=-130$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times130=\frac{65}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{65}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-8\times1\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-7\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times2+\left(-7\right)\times8+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-7\right)=32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times4-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times4\right)=\left(8\,;\,32\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times2+32\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-14\right)\times2=-140$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times140=\frac{70}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{70}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times4-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(13\,;\,35\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times1+35\times\left(-6\right)+12\times1=-185$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times185=\frac{185}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{185}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-0\times3\,;\,0\times2-3\times1\,;\,3\times3-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times5+\left(-3\right)\times1+11\times2=14$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times14=\frac{7}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-9\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&5\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&9\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times7-5\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,5\times0-9\times7\right)=\left(-72\,;\,-23\,;\,-63\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-72\right)\times3+\left(-23\right)\times4+\left(-63\right)\times\left(-8\right)=196$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times196=\frac{98}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{98}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,11\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&0\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&11\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times3-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-11\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(33\,;\,6\,;\,64\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times3+6\times0+64\times2=227$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times227=\frac{227}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{227}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-10\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-10\right)\times5+20\times1=330$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times330=55$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=55}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times4-2\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-0\times4\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-2\right)\times1=36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times7-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(22\,;\,19\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-1\right)+19\times0+8\times\left(-5\right)=-62$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times62=\frac{31}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times9-6\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,6\times2-3\times9\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(12\,;\,-15\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times5+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-6\right)\times6=69$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times69=\frac{23}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-8\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&6\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-4\times1\,;\,4\times4-6\times4\right)=\left(38\,;\,-36\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times1+\left(-36\right)\times6+\left(-8\right)\times0=-178$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times178=\frac{89}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{89}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-6\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,33\,;\,52\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-1\right)+33\times0+52\times0=31$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times31=\frac{31}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\4&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-10&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times8-1\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,1\times4-\left(-2\right)\times8\right)=\left(52\,;\,-54\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=52\times7+\left(-54\right)\times2+20\times\left(-4\right)=176$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times176=\frac{88}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{88}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&5\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times2-0\times2\,;\,0\times7-6\times2\,;\,6\times2-5\times7\right)=\left(10\,;\,-12\,;\,-23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times3+\left(-12\right)\times6+\left(-23\right)\times4=-134$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times134=\frac{67}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times7+\left(-4\right)\times0+\left(-2\right)\times2=-4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times3\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,-15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-9\right)\times5+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-7\right)=60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times2-8\times2\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times2+\left(-2\right)\times6+\left(-16\right)\times5=-104$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times104=\frac{52}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{52}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times0-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\right)=\left(-5\,;\,20\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)+20\times1+8\times8=104$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times104=\frac{52}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{52}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times7-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-33\,;\,-20\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-33\right)\times5+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-17\right)\times4=-93$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times93=\frac{31}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-6\times6\right)=\left(-33\,;\,7\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-33\right)\times3+7\times3+\left(-41\right)\times3=-201$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times201=\frac{67}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(-13\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times1+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)+4\times\left(-1\right)=7$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times7=\frac{7}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&9\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-9\times0\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-12\,;\,-25\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times5+\left(-12\right)\times0+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-8\right)=110$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times110=\frac{55}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-6&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,39\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-8\right)+39\times1+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-9\right)=328$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times328=\frac{164}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{164}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-10\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-4\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times1-\left(-10\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\right)=\left(16\,;\,4\,;\,44\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-8\right)+4\times\left(-6\right)+44\times1=-108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\right)=\left(42\,;\,-39\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-5\right)+20\times\left(-2\right)=-55$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times55=\frac{55}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&10\\7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-9\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times7-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-10\times7\,;\,10\times0-\left(-9\right)\times8\right)=\left(-63\,;\,-78\,;\,72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-63\right)\times4+\left(-78\right)\times\left(-3\right)+72\times9=630$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times630=105$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=105}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-1\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times6+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)+21\times7=94$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times94=\frac{47}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{47}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-5\times1\,;\,5\times3-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(10\,;\,-21\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times5+\left(-21\right)\times1+23\times1=52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-9\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times5-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-5\times5\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\right)=\left(-53\,;\,-33\,;\,8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-53\right)\times3+\left(-33\right)\times\left(-2\right)+8\times\left(-3\right)=-117$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times117=\frac{39}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{39}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\6&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\9&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times6-0\times5\,;\,0\times9-6\times6\,;\,6\times5-0\times9\right)=\left(0\,;\,-36\,;\,30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times10+\left(-36\right)\times1+30\times\left(-2\right)=-96$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times96=16$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=16}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times7-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-5\times6\right)=\left(31\,;\,-26\,;\,-34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=31\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-26\right)\times6+\left(-34\right)\times7=-425$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times425=\frac{425}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{425}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-8\right)-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times1-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,24\,;\,12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times5+24\times1+12\times\left(-4\right)=-114$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times114=19$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=19}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-22\,;\,7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times0+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-7\right)+7\times\left(-3\right)=133$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times133=\frac{133}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{133}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-4\times7\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-28\,;\,-28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times9+\left(-28\right)\times0+\left(-28\right)\times5=-464$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times464=\frac{232}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{232}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(25\,;\,-17\,;\,-18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-6\right)=202$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times202=\frac{101}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{101}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(-22\,;\,6\,;\,-10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times5+6\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-82$$

$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times82=\frac{41}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
