ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\2&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&9\\-11&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times2-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times9-9\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,42\,;\,9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times\left(-5\right)+42\times9+9\times3=225$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times225=\frac{75}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{75}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-4\times4\,;\,4\times2-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times4-2\times2\right)=\left(-18\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times3+9\times\left(-1\right)+0\times5=-63$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times63=\frac{21}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{21}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&9\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-9\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(15\,;\,-25\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-25\right)\times\left(-2\right)+0\times3=35$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times35=\frac{35}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{35}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)+1\times\left(-2\right)=40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)+2\times\left(-2\right)=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-15\,;\,42\,;\,11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times\left(-6\right)+42\times\left(-5\right)+11\times3=-87$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times87=\frac{29}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-9\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&5\\-6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\8&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-9\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times8-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times8-5\times8\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times8\right)=\left(-42\,;\,0\,;\,42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-42\right)\times2+0\times\left(-9\right)+42\times5=126$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times126=21$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=21}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times7-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times1-1\times7\right)=\left(-4\,;\,27\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times6+27\times6+\left(-1\right)\times1=137$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times137=\frac{137}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{137}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,24\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times1+24\times2+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)=50$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times50=\frac{25}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{25}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-2\times5\,;\,2\times2-4\times0\,;\,4\times5-0\times2\right)=\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,20\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)+4\times\left(-1\right)+20\times\left(-5\right)=-74$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times74=\frac{37}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times7-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-5\times7\,;\,5\times3-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,-35\,;\,24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-35\right)\times8+24\times1=-298$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times298=\frac{149}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{149}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-3\right)\times3+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)=3$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times3=\frac{1}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-7\times2\,;\,7\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-2\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-12\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-12\right)\times4+2\times10=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-8\times0\,;\,8\times1-3\times7\right)=\left(4\,;\,-28\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times10+\left(-28\right)\times3+\left(-13\right)\times0=-44$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times44=\frac{22}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{22}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times7-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,21\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-8\right)+21\times\left(-4\right)+4\times5=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-11\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-6\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-11\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times6-6\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,36\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times1+36\times9+0\times0=360$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times360=60$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=60}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-7\times0\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-31\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-31\right)\times0+\left(-6\right)\times4=-32$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times32=\frac{16}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{16}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&11\\-9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-8\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times7-11\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,11\times0-\left(-8\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(64\,;\,56\,;\,72\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=64\times0+56\times\left(-8\right)+72\times11=344$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times344=\frac{172}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{172}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&7\\4&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\11&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times11-7\times4\,;\,7\times1-\left(-1\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-9\times1\right)=\left(71\,;\,18\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=71\times10+18\times2+\left(-13\right)\times4=694$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times694=\frac{347}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{347}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&0\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&9\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times0-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-9\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,55\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-2\right)+0\times6+55\times\left(-7\right)=-385$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times385=\frac{385}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{385}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times7-5\times1\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times0+\left(-4\right)\times1+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)=41$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times41=\frac{41}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{41}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&9\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&0\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times0-9\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,9\times2-0\times0\right)=\left(14\,;\,72\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times6+72\times\left(-5\right)+18\times\left(-7\right)=-402$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times402=67$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=67}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&11\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&1\\8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times8-11\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,11\times5-1\times8\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\right)=\left(21\,;\,47\,;\,28\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times2+47\times\left(-5\right)+28\times1=-165$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times165=\frac{55}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\0&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\11&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times11-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times11\right)=\left(6\,;\,11\,;\,33\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times11+11\times\left(-6\right)+33\times\left(-2\right)=-66$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times66=11$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=11}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times7-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-7\times7\,;\,7\times1-6\times2\right)=\left(43\,;\,-51\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=43\times4+\left(-51\right)\times1+\left(-5\right)\times0=121$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times121=\frac{121}{6}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times3-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-4\times3\,;\,4\times5-4\times1\right)=\left(32\,;\,-16\,;\,16\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times7-6\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,-56\,;\,-49\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-56\right)\times1+\left(-49\right)\times2=-203$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times203=\frac{203}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{203}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-8\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
