ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=15}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,11\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-9\\10&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-3\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\0&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times10-4\times0\right)=\left(54\,;\,-27\,;\,-30\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=54\times3+\left(-27\right)\times11+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-9\right)=135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-4\times0\,;\,4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-2\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-35\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-35\right)\times5+16\times5=-77$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times77=\frac{77}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-8\times2\,;\,8\times2-1\times1\,;\,1\times2-3\times2\right)=\left(-13\,;\,15\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times0+15\times5+\left(-4\right)\times9=39$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times39=\frac{13}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&9\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-9\times2\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-23\,;\,-12\,;\,-41\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times9+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-106$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times106=\frac{53}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{53}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,11\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-4\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&11\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times4-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times8-0\times4\,;\,0\times2-11\times8\right)=\left(52\,;\,-32\,;\,-88\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=52\times8+\left(-32\right)\times11+\left(-88\right)\times0=64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times6-5\times2\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\right)=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times2+2\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-4\right)\times3=-20$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times20=\frac{10}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{10}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times3-4\times0\right)=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times5+10\times7+15\times\left(-9\right)=-30$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times30=5$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=5}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times5-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times8-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\right)=\left(-19\,;\,8\,;\,32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times7+8\times\left(-3\right)+32\times4=-29$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times29=\frac{29}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{29}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-9\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times3-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times0-7\times3\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-15\,;\,-21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times3+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-21\right)\times1=-24$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times24=4$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=4}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&5\\10&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\-1&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times0-5\times10\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-5\times0\,;\,5\times10-7\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-50\,;\,-5\,;\,57\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times4+\left(-5\right)\times6+57\times3=-59$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times59=\frac{59}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{59}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times8-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-6\times8\,;\,6\times\left(-5\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(49\,;\,-58\,;\,-24\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=49\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-58\right)\times2+\left(-24\right)\times9=-430$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times430=\frac{215}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{215}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-11\,;\,-1\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times6+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)+10\times\left(-2\right)=-84$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times84=14$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=14}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-0\times3\right)=\left(20\,;\,-17\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)=21$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times21=\frac{7}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-2\times2\,;\,2\times0-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-8\right)\times2=-12$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times12=2$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=2}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times3-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,-12\,;\,19\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-12\right)\times0+19\times4=67$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times67=\frac{67}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{67}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-3\times2\right)=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-9\right)\times0=-7$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times7=\frac{7}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{7}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times3\right)=\left(11\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-3\right)+5\times\left(-3\right)+2\times6=-36$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times36=6$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=6}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-10\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-7\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-5\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-10\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(15\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times2+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)=120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-9&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\10&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times10-2\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-1\times10\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-14\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-11\right)\times7=-107$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times107=\frac{107}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{107}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times6-2\times3\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-3\times6\,;\,3\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-32\,;\,-12\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times2+\left(-32\right)\times3+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-120$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times120=20$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=20}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times1-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\right)=\left(-21\,;\,19\,;\,13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-3\right)+19\times6+13\times\left(-3\right)=138$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times138=23$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=23}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times6-7\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-7\right)-4\times6\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-73\,;\,-38\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times1+\left(-73\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-38\right)\times3=354$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times354=59$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=59}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-11\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-11\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&0\\-11&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-11\\3&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times3-0\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,0\times3-3\times3\,;\,3\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-11\right)\times3\right)=\left(-33\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-33\right)\times6+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-7\right)=-189$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times189=\frac{63}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{63}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times4\right)=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,-14\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times2+\left(-8\right)\times1+\left(-14\right)\times3=-40$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times40=\frac{20}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{20}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times7+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)+3\times\left(-7\right)=-165$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times165=\frac{55}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{55}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-2\times5\,;\,2\times4-6\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,6\times5-1\times4\right)=\left(-14\,;\,32\,;\,26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-1\right)+32\times6+26\times5=336$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times336=56$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=56}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times6\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times6-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-16\,;\,-34\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-16\right)\times1+\left(-34\right)\times6=4$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times4=\frac{2}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{2}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-10\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&6\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times3-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,10\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-2\right)+10\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-26$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times26=\frac{13}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{13}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times1-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times5-1\times1\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,15\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)+15\times5=77$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times77=\frac{77}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{77}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times8-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times8\right)=\left(36\,;\,30\,;\,23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times6+30\times\left(-3\right)+23\times\left(-4\right)=34$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times34=\frac{17}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{17}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times6-2\times2\,;\,2\times3-2\times6\,;\,2\times2-5\times3\right)=\left(26\,;\,-6\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-11\right)\times2=48$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times48=8$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=8}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times0-\left(-8\right)\times4\right)=\left(32\,;\,-4\,;\,32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)+32\times\left(-6\right)=-316$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times316=\frac{158}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{158}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,20\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times3+20\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-8\right)=111$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times111=\frac{37}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{37}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-4\times8\,;\,4\times1-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times8-4\times1\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-3\,;\,-60\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-60\right)\times8=-330$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times330=55$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=55}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,10\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&10\\-10&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times10-10\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(40\,;\,47\,;\,70\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times\left(-10\right)+47\times5+70\times\left(-6\right)=-585$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times585=\frac{195}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{195}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-2\times6\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-4\times4\,;\,4\times6-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-20\,;\,16\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times2+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-1\right)+16\times\left(-5\right)=-116$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times116=\frac{58}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{58}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-8\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times1-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-8\times1\right)=\left(-67\,;\,-47\,;\,-26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-67\right)\times4+\left(-47\right)\times2+\left(-26\right)\times2=-414$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times414=69$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=69}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-4\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(1\,;\,37\,;\,-11\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-6\right)+37\times0+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-2\right)=16$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times16=\frac{8}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{8}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-7\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,7\times7-0\times7\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-0\times7\right)=\left(42\,;\,49\,;\,0\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times6+49\times\left(-8\right)+0\times\left(-1\right)=-140$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times140=\frac{70}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{70}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times5-2\times7\,;\,2\times3-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times7-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(-34\,;\,31\,;\,-23\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times5+31\times1+\left(-23\right)\times3=-208$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times208=\frac{104}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{104}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times7-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-4\times7\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-31\,;\,-17\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times0+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-17\right)\times3=135$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times135=\frac{45}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{45}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times5-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times5-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\right)=\left(-31\,;\,25\,;\,36\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times1+25\times\left(-10\right)+36\times5=-101$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times101=\frac{101}{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{101}{6}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&-1\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-10\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-10\right)\times0\right)=\left(48\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times5+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)+2\times\left(-10\right)=250$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times250=\frac{125}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{125}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,9\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\9&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\-10&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&5\\-8&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times9-5\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-40\,;\,-32\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-40\right)\times9+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-234$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times234=39$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=39}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times7-5\times0\right)=\left(1\,;\,-28\,;\,-49\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-28\right)\times7+\left(-49\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-52$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times52=\frac{26}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{26}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times3-1\times6\,;\,1\times1-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times6-1\times1\right)=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)+4\times5+\left(-7\right)\times5=-6$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times6=1$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=1}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times6-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times3-1\times6\right)=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times2+6\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-6\right)\times2=-64$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times64=\frac{32}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{32}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,44\,;\,-42\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+44\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-42\right)\times\left(-3\right)=62$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times62=\frac{31}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{31}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-2\times10\,;\,2\times4-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times10-4\times4\right)=\left(-32\,;\,14\,;\,4\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times2+14\times0+4\times1=-60$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times60=10$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=10}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times5-5\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,54\,;\,45\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-2\right)+54\times\left(-2\right)+45\times2=-18$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times18=3$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=3}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times0-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times7-5\times0\right)=\left(-15\,;\,9\,;\,21\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times8+9\times3+21\times4=-9$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times9=\frac{3}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{3}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times8-9\times5\,;\,9\times1-\left(-3\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-61\,;\,33\,;\,-13\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-61\right)\times6+33\times9+\left(-13\right)\times0=-69$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times69=\frac{23}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{23}{2}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times6-6\times7\,;\,6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-5\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-24\,;\,18\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-24\right)\times3+18\times6=108$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times108=18$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=18}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-11\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-9\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-11\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-62\,;\,70\,;\,26\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-62\right)\times0+70\times\left(-6\right)+26\times1=-394$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times394=\frac{197}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{197}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

ក. $\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-10\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times4-5\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,-22\,;\,10\right)$$
ខ. $$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-10\right)+10\times1=158$$
ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times158=\frac{79}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=\frac{79}{3}}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
ក. គណនា $\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}$ ។
ខ. បង្ហាញថា $A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D$ មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ហើយគណនាមាឌតេត្រាអែត $ABCD$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-12\right)$$

ដោយផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ នោះចំណុចទាំងបួនមិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយទេ ។
$$V_{ABCD}=\frac{1}{6}\left|\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}\right|=\frac{1}{6}\times54=9$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{V_{ABCD}=9}$ ឯកតាមាឌ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
