$$=\left(6\times3-9\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,9\times3-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-6\times3\right)=\left(45\,;\,30\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times7+30\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-10\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times3-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\right)=\left(70\,;\,-50\,;\,31\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=70\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-50\right)\times\left(-9\right)+31\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-7\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-7&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\11&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\8&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times11-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times8-6\times11\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-0\times8\right)=\left(21\,;\,-42\,;\,-42\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times8+\left(-42\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-42\right)\times7=84$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&6\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-7\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times2-4\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,4\times6-6\times2\right)=\left(-48\,;\,30\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-48\right)\times\left(-2\right)+30\times10+12\times\left(-7\right)=312$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,19\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,22\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times0-4\times1\,;\,4\times2-0\times0\,;\,0\times1-7\times2\right)=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times2+8\times22+\left(-14\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-8&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times8-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times4-3\times8\right)=\left(-16\,;\,16\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times3+16\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-10\right)=16$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,-13\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-7\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(15\,;\,-16\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-9\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&6\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-7\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-6\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,6\times2-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(67\,;\,69\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=67\times15+69\times\left(-16\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,11\,;\,15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-43\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-43\right)\times5+15\times9=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-14\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-1\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&9\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times8-7\times0\,;\,7\times0-9\times8\,;\,9\times0-1\times0\right)=\left(8\,;\,-72\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-72\right)\times\left(-1\right)+0\times9=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times7-7\times0\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(20\,;\,35\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times\left(-7\right)+35\times6+\left(-14\right)\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,6\,;\,-16\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times6-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-6\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times0-0\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,44\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times10+44\times0+0\times\left(-13\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times3-1\times6\right)=\left(8\,;\,-16\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-5\right)+0\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&8\\-10&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times2-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-8\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,24\,;\,66\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-5\right)+24\times6+66\times5=384$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,10\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times1+10\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-12\right)\times1=-44$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-10\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-2\times2\,;\,2\times6-\left(-1\right)\times6\right)=\left(22\,;\,-28\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-28\right)\times3+18\times\left(-2\right)=-164$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&8\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times7-8\times5\,;\,8\times1-4\times7\,;\,4\times5-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(-61\,;\,-20\,;\,23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-61\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-20\right)\times7+23\times3=51$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-2\times1\right)=\left(12\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-2\right)+0\times10+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-2\right)+6\times4+8\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,13\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&4\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&6\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,-11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times3-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-5\times3\,;\,5\times1-2\times6\right)=\left(8\,;\,-27\,;\,-7\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,-15\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-66\right)\times5+30\times9+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-15\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,-27\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-2\right)+3\times\left(-10\right)=6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-4\right)\times1+9\times0=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-14\,;\,17\right)$ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times11+\left(-12\right)\times4+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,-6\,;\,-14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-10\\-8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-5\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-7\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times2-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\right)=\left(-38\,;\,-50\,;\,54\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,17\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times7-5\times9\,;\,5\times2-2\times7\,;\,2\times9-1\times2\right)=\left(-38\,;\,-4\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times2+\left(-4\right)\times17+16\times9=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times3+2\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-1\right)\times7=32$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,6\,;\,-11\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-1\times7\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times7-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times3+\left(-1\right)\times9+4\times\left(-3\right)=-78$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-8\right)\times8+\left(-31\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&7\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,22\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,17\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-1\times0\right)=\left(-23\,;\,4\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times\left(-4\right)+4\times17+32\times\left(-5\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&6\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-41\right)\times8+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)+32\times9=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-6\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times0-7\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-35\,;\,-2\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times6+28\times0=58$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-4\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,36\,;\,-22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-12\right)+36\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-2\times5\,;\,2\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-5\times5\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-2\,;\,-35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-35\right)\times1=51$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។

$$=\left(0\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(-18\,;\,1\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-4\right)+1\times\left(-2\right)+30\times6=250$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,21\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times5+21\times4+0\times\left(-5\right)=49$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times5-2\times4\,;\,2\times1-0\times5\,;\,0\times4-8\times1\right)=\left(32\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-1\right)+2\times9+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&9\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,9\times2-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\right)=\left(88\,;\,19\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=88\times\left(-3\right)+19\times\left(-2\right)+5\times10=-252$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,28\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,5\,;\,32\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times8-8\times5\,;\,8\times1-3\times8\,;\,3\times5-0\times1\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-16\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times10+\left(-16\right)\times5+15\times32=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-9&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-2\times8\,;\,2\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times8-0\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,-28\,;\,-40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-28\right)\times5+\left(-40\right)\times4=-252$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\3&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&11\\-9&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times3-2\times3\,;\,2\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-11\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(27\,;\,3\,;\,78\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times\left(-11\right)+3\times\left(-5\right)+78\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(12\,;\,-1\,;\,-11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,-14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times3-2\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(20\,;\,38\,;\,17\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times10+38\times1+17\times\left(-14\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times8-1\times5\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,51\,;\,-45\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-12\right)+51\times3+\left(-45\right)\times9=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(18\,;\,-3\,;\,-16\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(23\,;\,-1\,;\,-17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-5&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\11&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times11-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times5-\left(-2\right)\times11\right)=\left(30\,;\,-24\,;\,42\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times23+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+42\times\left(-17\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,17\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-7&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(41\,;\,-26\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=41\times0+\left(-26\right)\times1+2\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,12\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times2-2\times8\,;\,2\times4-3\times2\,;\,3\times8-4\times4\right)=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times5+2\times12+8\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-2\times6\,;\,2\times5-5\times3\,;\,5\times6-3\times5\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times5+\left(-5\right)\times9+15\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,7\,;\,-14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,7\,;\,-19\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-9\\1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&5\\-10&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times2-5\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,5\times1-6\times2\right)=\left(-51\,;\,32\,;\,-7\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-51\right)\times7+32\times7+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-19\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-7\times6\right)=\left(-53\,;\,-19\,;\,-40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-53\right)\times6+\left(-19\right)\times5+\left(-40\right)\times0=-413$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(29\,;\,-15\,;\,14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(31\,;\,-20\,;\,18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times6-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times7-8\times6\,;\,8\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times7\right)=\left(8\,;\,-20\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times31+\left(-20\right)\times\left(-20\right)+\left(-36\right)\times18=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times8-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,26\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)+26\times1+8\times2=50$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&10\\-1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\9&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times9-10\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,10\times8-0\times9\right)=\left(32\,;\,-26\,;\,80\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times6+\left(-26\right)\times8+80\times\left(-1\right)=-96$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-5\times8\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times8-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-16\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-16\right)\times4+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-2\right)=144$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&8\\-1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\10&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times10-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times6-1\times10\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\right)=\left(-32\,;\,38\,;\,23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times0+38\times5+23\times6=328$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\0&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\10&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&11\\-11&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times10-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-11\right)-0\times10\,;\,0\times0-11\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(110\,;\,-22\,;\,121\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=110\times0+\left(-22\right)\times5+121\times0=-110$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-22\,;\,20\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times2+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-8\right)+20\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-1\times0\right)=\left(15\,;\,-8\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-2\right)=13$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times4-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-3\times2\right)=\left(12\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-1\right)+0\times9+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-10\,;\,14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-16\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,18\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times\left(-5\right)+18\times\left(-16\right)+8\times11=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,20\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,17\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&11\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&1\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times4-11\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,11\times\left(-8\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(30\,;\,38\,;\,-92\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times3+38\times17+\left(-92\right)\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times2-4\times3\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times1+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times4=-33$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-7\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times1-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times0-\left(-10\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\right)=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,70\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times\left(-5\right)+10\times\left(-2\right)+70\times11=715$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,8\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&1\\8&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&11\\4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times10-1\times8\,;\,1\times4-4\times10\,;\,4\times8-11\times4\right)=\left(102\,;\,-36\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=102\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-36\right)\times8+\left(-12\right)\times5=-552$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-8\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,12\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)+12\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-14\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times5-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-1\times5\right)=\left(-25\,;\,-35\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-35\right)\times7+\left(-5\right)\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times5-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,41\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-5\right)+41\times5+5\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-15\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-18\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times3-0\times2\right)=\left(12\,;\,-24\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-18\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-13\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,17\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-13\right)+17\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-8\,;\,-9\,;\,-14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-11\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,-15\,;\,-18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-11&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-8&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\-8&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)-2\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(78\,;\,-48\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=78\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-48\right)\times\left(-15\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-18\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times5-5\times2\,;\,5\times1-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-1\times1\right)=\left(-5\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)+10\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-3\right)\times4=-57$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-4\times4\,;\,4\times5-2\times5\,;\,2\times4-4\times5\right)=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-2\right)+10\times6+\left(-12\right)\times6=-20$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-3\times1\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-9\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-9\right)\times9+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-8\times0\,;\,8\times1-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-3\times1\right)=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+8\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-13$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\8&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-10&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times8-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-32\,;\,32\,;\,-60\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-11\right)+32\times4+\left(-60\right)\times2=360$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\-2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,15\,;\,-31\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times3+15\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-92$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&10\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times2-10\times3\,;\,10\times\left(-6\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(18\,;\,-24\,;\,-60\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times10+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-60\right)\times\left(-6\right)=612$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,3\,;\,-37\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(15\,;\,5\,;\,-43\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-11\\2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&3\\-10&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-11\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times6-3\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,3\times2-1\times6\right)=\left(12\,;\,-36\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times15+\left(-36\right)\times5+0\times\left(-43\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,3\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-5\right)+3\times3+15\times10=99$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,-17\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,-8\,;\,-23\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-10&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,66\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-16\right)+66\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-23\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,-3\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times0+\left(-3\right)\times3+\left(-12\right)\times2=-33$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-2\times4\right)=\left(7\,;\,-14\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times6+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-14\right)\times1=42$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-15\,;\,-9\,;\,-21\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?
