ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-7\\-5&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-9\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-2\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times1\right)=\left(55\,;\,13\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=55\times\left(-2\right)+13\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-131$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-4\times2\,;\,4\times2-2\times3\,;\,2\times2-\left(-2\right)\times2\right)=\left(-14\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times3+2\times\left(-5\right)+8\times\left(-3\right)=-76$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(31\,;\,12\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(36\,;\,8\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&10\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&2\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-10\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,10\times2-2\times6\right)=\left(-6\,;\,38\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times36+38\times8+8\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-9\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times3-1\times3\right)=\left(17\,;\,-13\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-5\right)+12\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-8&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\9&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times9-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times9\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-21\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times4+\left(-21\right)\times1+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)=-91$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-13\,;\,-15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times8-4\times6\,;\,4\times0-\left(-6\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times6-2\times0\right)=\left(-8\,;\,48\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)+48\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,12\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,17\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-0\times9\,;\,0\times3-0\times4\,;\,0\times9-1\times3\right)=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times6+0\times17+\left(-3\right)\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-2\times1\right)=\left(38\,;\,-10\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-17\,;\,4\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-7\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-10\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&5\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,9\,;\,45\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times\left(-17\right)+9\times4+45\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,-7\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-26\,;\,24\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times\left(-12\right)+24\times\left(-7\right)+18\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-9\times2\,;\,9\times\left(-2\right)-2\times7\right)=\left(0\,;\,-32\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-32\right)\times1=64$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&9\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-6\right)-4\times0\,;\,4\times0-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times0-9\times0\right)=\left(-54\,;\,18\,;\,0\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times1\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-10\,;\,56\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-8\right)+56\times4=400$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,11\,;\,-12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,-18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-11\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-5\\-4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-59\,;\,57\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-59\right)\times\left(-3\right)+57\times7+32\times\left(-18\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-29\,;\,6\,;\,-30\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-32\,;\,7\,;\,-36\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\4&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\-9&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-1\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(27\,;\,0\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times\left(-32\right)+0\times7+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-36\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(22\,;\,46\,;\,-30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-6\right)+46\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-30\right)\times0=-500$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,22\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times4+22\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&5\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-10\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times5-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-25\,;\,20\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-25\right)\times\left(-4\right)+20\times\left(-6\right)+10\times3=10$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(12\,;\,15\,;\,-34\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(14\,;\,17\,;\,-40\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-11\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&3\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times5-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-6\times5\right)=\left(-53\,;\,-34\,;\,-33\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-53\right)\times14+\left(-34\right)\times17+\left(-33\right)\times\left(-40\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\2&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times2-3\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(13\,;\,-20\,;\,42\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times1+\left(-20\right)\times1+42\times\left(-2\right)=-91$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(26\,;\,-57\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-57\right)\times0+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-13\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(40\,;\,-18\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times6+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-4\right)=390$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,15\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,14\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-4\times0\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-1\right)\times14+\left(-2\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-2\times8\,;\,2\times3-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times8-2\times3\right)=\left(-20\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,13\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,13\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,11\,;\,-10\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-10\right)+0\times6+18\times10=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&9\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-7\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(76\,;\,-43\,;\,40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=76\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-43\right)\times\left(-2\right)+40\times7=-470$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times3-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-1\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-1\right)\times3+10\times\left(-4\right)=-219$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times4-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-4\times4\right)=\left(-26\,;\,-22\,;\,-20\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times6+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-20\right)\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(16\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-9\times1\,;\,9\times7-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-2\times7\right)=\left(-1\,;\,71\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times16+71\times0+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-9\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-7\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-5\\7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times3-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-3\times3\,;\,3\times7-7\times4\right)=\left(56\,;\,-29\,;\,-7\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=56\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-29\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\0&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\11&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-5\times6\,;\,5\times11-6\times0\,;\,6\times6-2\times11\right)=\left(-30\,;\,55\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times3+55\times0+14\times6=-6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times5-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times0-3\times5\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-23\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times4+\left(-23\right)\times1+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-7\right)=70$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times1-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times4+\left(-8\right)\times1+2\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times0-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-7\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,12\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-8\right)+12\times7+28\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(23\,;\,14\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(28\,;\,19\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times7-4\times7\right)=\left(13\,;\,-7\,;\,21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times28+\left(-7\right)\times19+21\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times1-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-3\times1\right)=\left(-15\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times4+5\times3+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&11\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-4\\9&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-11\times2\,;\,11\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-49\,;\,-19\,;\,-23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-49\right)\times4+\left(-19\right)\times2+\left(-23\right)\times10=-464$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times6-4\times3\,;\,4\times0-3\times6\,;\,3\times3-0\times0\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-18\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times3+\left(-18\right)\times3+9\times10=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&7\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-6\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-8\times2\,;\,8\times9-7\times4\,;\,7\times2-\left(-6\right)\times9\right)=\left(-40\,;\,44\,;\,68\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times4+44\times\left(-3\right)+68\times\left(-1\right)=-360$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,20\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-2\right)+20\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)=37$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times1-2\times7\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-2\times1\right)=\left(16\,;\,-12\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times1+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-4\right)\times6=40$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,13\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,17\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-2&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\7&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times8-9\times7\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-3\,;\,-47\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times9+\left(-3\right)\times17+\left(-47\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-4\right)-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times1-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-4\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(12\,;\,16\,;\,-13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times5+16\times6+\left(-13\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times0-6\times4\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-15\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-15\right)\times6+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times4+2\times2+\left(-2\right)\times14=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times0\right)=\left(8\,;\,-20\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-20\right)\times3+\left(-8\right)\times4=-108$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&6\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times1-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times0-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(15\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times3+10\times2+5\times\left(-6\right)=35$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-3\times3\,;\,3\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-0\times2\right)=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times3+0\times3+\left(-9\right)\times4=-63$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\right)=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times2+0\times\left(-6\right)+0\times\left(-3\right)=14$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-13\,;\,-6\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-19\,;\,-7\,;\,13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-8\\4&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-11&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times4-9\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-8\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-67\,;\,-39\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-19\right)+\left(-67\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-39\right)\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,11\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\11&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\2&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times11-3\times2\right)=\left(57\,;\,-6\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=57\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-6\right)\times5+16\times\left(-4\right)=-322$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\8&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-7\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&3\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times8-3\times2\right)=\left(41\,;\,-49\,;\,-62\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=41\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-49\right)\times3+\left(-62\right)\times\left(-10\right)=227$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&7\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\-3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-8\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times6\right)=\left(38\,;\,36\,;\,52\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=38\times6+36\times\left(-4\right)+52\times\left(-3\right)=-72$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times6-4\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,4\times1-2\times6\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-20\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times2+\left(-20\right)\times3+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times1-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-12\right)\times2=3$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,10\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,11\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-1\right)\times11+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-\left(-6\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,21\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-3\right)+21\times8+\left(-12\right)\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,13\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,16\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times1-1\times8\,;\,1\times1-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-8\times1\right)=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times0+2\times16+\left(-16\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&9\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-9\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,-7\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times0+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-5\right)\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,18\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,20\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-8&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times0-4\times5\,;\,4\times\left(-8\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times5-5\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-32\,;\,45\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-32\right)\times20+45\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-1\times7\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-13\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times2+\left(-13\right)\times1+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-10\right)=69$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-17\,;\,-8\,;\,-9\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\9&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\10&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times10-3\times9\,;\,3\times4-2\times10\,;\,2\times9-8\times4\right)=\left(53\,;\,-8\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=53\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times7+\left(-14\right)\times10=-355$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times2-5\times3\right)=\left(3\,;\,-11\,;\,-13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times0+\left(-11\right)\times1+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-4\right)=41$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,2\,;\,27\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-6\right)+2\times2+27\times1=115$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times0\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-6\right)\times5+6\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,9\,;\,-14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(14\,;\,9\,;\,-16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times0-7\times4\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-2\times0\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-28\,;\,-35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times14+\left(-28\right)\times9+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-16\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times1-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-5\right)\times8=-37$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(7\,;\,-14\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-19\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,9\,;\,-13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times5+9\times\left(-19\right)+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-7\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,-8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-11\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-4\\-8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-11\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-0\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(33\,;\,1\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times\left(-5\right)+1\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-14\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-29\,;\,3\,;\,11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-35\,;\,2\,;\,14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\5&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-11&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times5-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-8\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(22\,;\,7\,;\,54\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-35\right)+7\times2+54\times14=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-2\right)-4\times8\,;\,4\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-2\times0\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-2\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-2\right)\times10+\left(-8\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(28\,;\,-13\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-13\right)\times0+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-1\right)-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,-30\,;\,24\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-17\,;\,6\right)$ ។
