ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times6-2\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times2+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+0\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-9\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-11\right)+8\times\left(-9\right)+1\times\left(-5\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-5&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&6\\8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times8-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times6-6\times8\,;\,6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\right)=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times2+6\times\left(-7\right)+0\times4=-32$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\right)=\left(-24\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+2\times4+4\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times7\right)=\left(40\,;\,10\,;\,45\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times1+10\times\left(-1\right)+45\times\left(-1\right)=-15$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times0-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-5\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,17\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+0\times1+17\times\left(-3\right)=-51$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&10\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&1\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times5-6\times4\,;\,6\times1-10\times5\,;\,10\times4-1\times1\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-44\,;\,39\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times6+\left(-44\right)\times4+39\times2=-212$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+3\times2+\left(-3\right)\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times3-1\times4\,;\,1\times7-1\times3\,;\,1\times4-7\times7\right)=\left(17\,;\,4\,;\,-45\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times7+4\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-45\right)\times7=-204$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times3-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-3\times3\,;\,3\times6-4\times1\right)=\left(42\,;\,-14\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-14\right)\times8+14\times11=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,23\,;\,8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,26\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&4\\8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-4&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-4\right)-4\times8\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times8-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-20\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-20\right)\times26+16\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&6\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-8\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,8\times3-6\times3\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\6&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times3-1\times8\,;\,1\times6-2\times3\,;\,2\times8-1\times6\right)=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times1+0\times0+10\times2=15$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&6\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-7\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times0-5\times1\,;\,5\times4-6\times0\,;\,6\times1-\left(-7\right)\times4\right)=\left(-5\,;\,20\,;\,34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times10+20\times\left(-6\right)+34\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-12\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(-36\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times1+0\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-11\,;\,-8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-12\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-5\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,23\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-4\right)+23\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,15\,;\,31\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,16\,;\,36\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\4&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-3\\9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times9-9\times4\,;\,9\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,18\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-10\right)+18\times16+\left(-8\right)\times36=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,-9\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-10\right)=90$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,11\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-11\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-11&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\0&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-6\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,6\times0-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(66\,;\,0\,;\,-33\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=66\times6+0\times5+\left(-33\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-10\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-2\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-4\times0\right)=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times2+\left(-8\right)\times0+\left(-4\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&9\\-1&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times7-9\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(-68\,;\,-61\,;\,-49\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-68\right)\times10+\left(-61\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-49\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-411$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,11\,;\,17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\10&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times10-7\times5\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(25\,;\,16\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-5\right)+16\times11+\left(-3\right)\times17=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-31\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-37\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-10\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&1\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-10\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times5-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(57\,;\,57\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=57\times\left(-2\right)+57\times2+0\times\left(-37\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\2&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\10&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times10-9\times2\,;\,9\times2-1\times10\,;\,1\times2-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-28\,;\,8\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times10+8\times2+4\times8=-232$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-14\,;\,8\,;\,-13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-13\,;\,5\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-1\times5\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\right)=\left(-35\,;\,-19\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times\left(-13\right)+\left(-19\right)\times5+30\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,7\,;\,14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\0&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\11&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times11-3\times0\,;\,3\times9-1\times11\,;\,1\times0-7\times9\right)=\left(77\,;\,16\,;\,-63\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=77\times10+16\times7+\left(-63\right)\times14=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-10\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-73\,;\,31\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-73\right)\times3+31\times9+6\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,-13\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-13\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-5\times2\right)=\left(-46\,;\,-32\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times8+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-13\right)+6\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&1\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times8-1\times0\,;\,1\times1-3\times8\right)=\left(9\,;\,-72\,;\,-23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times8+\left(-72\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-3\right)=285$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-7\right)-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-17\,;\,-24\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-17\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-24\right)\times8+18\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,13\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,17\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\8&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\-8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&9\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times8-9\times1\right)=\left(-32\,;\,19\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times4+19\times17+15\times\left(-13\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&8\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times6-8\times5\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-3\times6\,;\,3\times5-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(2\,;\,-34\,;\,29\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-34\right)\times3+29\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,-24\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times4-0\times8\,;\,0\times0-4\times4\,;\,4\times8-3\times0\right)=\left(12\,;\,-16\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-16\right)\times1+32\times6=140$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-5\times3\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-2\times4\,;\,2\times3-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-33\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-33\right)\times4+16\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-10\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\0&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-11&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-1\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,33\,;\,56\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times\left(-5\right)+33\times\left(-10\right)+56\times3=-27$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(13\,;\,-8\,;\,12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-13\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-8&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(64\,;\,-8\,;\,-69\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=64\times7+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-13\right)+\left(-69\right)\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-6&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times9-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\right)=\left(27\,;\,27\,;\,27\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times\left(-3\right)+27\times\left(-5\right)+27\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-11\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-11&0\\-9&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-11\\4&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-11\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,0\times4-5\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-11\right)\times4\right)=\left(88\,;\,40\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=88\times\left(-4\right)+40\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)=-704$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,13\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,11\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times0-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times1-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-5\right)+1\times11+14\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-4\right)+0\times3+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times0-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-18\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-18\right)\times2+6\times7=8$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,-7\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)+12\times6=111$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-10\\3&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&0\\-11&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-10\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times0-0\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,0\times3-3\times0\right)=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times0+0\times3+0\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-11\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-10\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)+5\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times3\,;\,3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-42\,;\,-6\,;\,-28\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-18\,;\,-1\,;\,-33\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-22\,;\,-6\,;\,-39\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-10\\-9&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-8\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times2-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)-1\times2\right)=\left(-99\,;\,-92\,;\,70\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-99\right)\times\left(-22\right)+\left(-92\right)\times\left(-6\right)+70\times\left(-39\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-15\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-16\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times1-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-4\times1\right)=\left(22\,;\,-1\,;\,-28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-16\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(11\,;\,1\,;\,-14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,6\,;\,-17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-7\right)-3\times6\,;\,3\times5-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times6-6\times5\right)=\left(-60\,;\,15\,;\,-30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-60\right)\times10+15\times6+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-17\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times7-0\times5\right)=\left(21\,;\,-3\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times9+\left(-3\right)\times7+28\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,13\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,17\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,19\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-4\right)\times17+19\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-2\times1\,;\,2\times0-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times0\right)=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-3\right)\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,7\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-11\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&3\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-\left(-11\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times8-3\times0\,;\,3\times3-4\times8\right)=\left(33\,;\,-88\,;\,-23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times11+\left(-88\right)\times7+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-1\times0\right)=\left(-24\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times8+0\times\left(-1\right)+0\times\left(-7\right)=-192$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(7\,;\,-12\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\11&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-3&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-0\times11\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-2\times2\,;\,2\times11-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times7+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)+28\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times3\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-8\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(18\,;\,6\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-2\right)+6\times6+28\times0=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,14\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,11\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,-8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&3\\-5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\10&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times10-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times10\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-65\,;\,55\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-65\right)\times\left(-9\right)+55\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times5-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-34\,;\,33\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-34\right)\times3+33\times\left(-7\right)=-312$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-14\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-4\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times4+12\times\left(-14\right)+48\times0=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,13\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\0&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-23\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)+45\times\left(-3\right)=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-44\right)\times9+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,11\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\11&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\11&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&10\\-4&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
