$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=110\times\left(-4\right)+88\times9+\left(-48\right)\times7=16$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-24\,;\,14\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-20\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\10&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times5-4\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,4\times10-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times10\right)=\left(4\,;\,40\,;\,40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-20\right)+40\times8+40\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times5-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times0-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times0\right)=\left(21\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-1\right)+5\times3+1\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,-13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-5\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-2\times4\,;\,2\times1-\left(-4\right)\times5\right)=\left(-11\,;\,-33\,;\,22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-33\right)\times\left(-6\right)+22\times\left(-13\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)+0\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-13\,;\,6\,;\,16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-9\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-8\times2\,;\,8\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times2-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,-40\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-13\right)+\left(-40\right)\times6+2\times16=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,11\,;\,12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,10\,;\,15\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&2\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-8\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(50\,;\,-18\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=50\times6+\left(-18\right)\times10+\left(-8\right)\times15=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,12\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times4-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-3\right)+0\times9+\left(-18\right)\times0=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\-1&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-2\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-6\right)+9\times1+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,8\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-15\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times1-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(16\,;\,-4\,;\,36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-15\right)+\left(-4\right)\times3+36\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-7\\-9&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\5&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times1-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times5-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-7\right)\times5\right)=\left(-70\,;\,-39\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-70\right)\times3+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-1\right)\times2=-56$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(11\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\5&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-73\,;\,-39\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times5+\left(-73\right)\times7+\left(-39\right)\times\left(-14\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\9&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-5\right)-4\times9\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times9-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-28\,;\,-28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-28\right)\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,14\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times4-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times2-4\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,32\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-8\right)+32\times14+32\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times2\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-26\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-26\right)\times0+2\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\-3&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&8\\11&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times11-9\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,9\times6-8\times11\right)=\left(-18\,;\,16\,;\,-34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times5+16\times6+\left(-34\right)\times0=6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,-10\,;\,11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,5\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,20\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times9+20\times\left(-9\right)+9\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&9\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times2-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-9\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(23\,;\,-2\,;\,22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-2\right)\times3+22\times6=57$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&10\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&2\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-10\times3\,;\,10\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times3-0\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-48\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-48\right)\times3+6\times9=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times3\right)=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-2\right)+0\times0+9\times\left(-4\right)=-54$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-2&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-11&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times4-6\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(22\,;\,66\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times2+66\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)=-180$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&1\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\8&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times3-7\times10\,;\,7\times8-1\times3\,;\,1\times10-6\times8\right)=\left(-52\,;\,53\,;\,-38\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-52\right)\times1+53\times4+\left(-38\right)\times4=8$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(15\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times\left(-7\right)+9\times5+3\times1=-57$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-7\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times3-\left(-7\right)\times2\right)=\left(26\,;\,2\,;\,29\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times\left(-2\right)+2\times0+29\times2=6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-1\right)+3\times\left(-1\right)+9\times1=5$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times7-0\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,0\times2-4\times7\,;\,4\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-28\,;\,-20\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times6+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-20\right)\times6=-344$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(14\,;\,10\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&11\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&2\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-2\times8\,;\,2\times3-11\times2\,;\,11\times8-2\times3\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-16\,;\,82\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times14+\left(-16\right)\times10+82\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,-9\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-13\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-9\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times8-7\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,7\times2-\left(-9\right)\times8\right)=\left(25\,;\,29\,;\,86\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-9\right)+29\times\left(-13\right)+86\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times1-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,22\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times5+22\times\left(-3\right)+8\times\left(-4\right)=-108$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-13\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-19\,;\,4\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-10\\8&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&2\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times8-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-10\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times2-2\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,53\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-19\right)+53\times4+\left(-2\right)\times11=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-7&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times6\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-56\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times7+\left(-56\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)=50$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,-16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,20\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times7+20\times3+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-16\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-3\right)-2\times3\,;\,2\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-5\times1\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-4\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-4\right)\times8+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(11\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times0-6\times0\,;\,6\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-24\,;\,24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times5+\left(-24\right)\times6+24\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times1-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times2+5\times3+\left(-11\right)\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times3\right)=\left(23\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-11\right)$ ។

$$=\left(6\times\left(-11\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-66\,;\,0\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-66\right)\times\left(-3\right)+0\times2+18\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-10\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\-5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\right)=\left(15\,;\,-15\,;\,15\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-17\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-10\,;\,8\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times4-6\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,6\times10-7\times4\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times10\right)=\left(-12\,;\,32\,;\,46\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times4+32\times\left(-10\right)+46\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&5\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-6\times1\,;\,6\times1-5\times2\right)=\left(11\,;\,-18\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times5+\left(-18\right)\times5+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-11$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(13\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-5\right)-3\times2\,;\,3\times9-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times2-1\times9\right)=\left(-11\,;\,47\,;\,-1\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-12\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-12\right)\times5+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-9\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,16\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,12\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-5\\-3&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-54\,;\,48\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-54\right)\times9+48\times12+30\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&8\\-2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times4-3\times9\,;\,3\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times9-8\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,30\,;\,-65\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-16\right)+30\times7+\left(-65\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times2-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times2\,;\,5\times5-5\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(25\,;\,-7\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times3+\left(-7\right)\times3+30\times\left(-2\right)=-6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times3-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times0-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(15\,;\,28\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times7+28\times\left(-6\right)+9\times2=-45$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times1-3\times4\,;\,3\times0-0\times1\,;\,0\times4-9\times0\right)=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times11+0\times2+0\times2=-33$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-5\times6\,;\,5\times0-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-31\,;\,1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-31\right)\times5+1\times10=-139$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times3\right)=\left(-51\,;\,-15\,;\,21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-51\right)\times5+\left(-15\right)\times1+21\times\left(-4\right)=-354$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&0\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-4\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-6\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-6\right)\times6+\left(-12\right)\times0=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-8\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&1\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-7\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times6-1\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,1\times6-3\times6\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times6\right)=\left(-34\,;\,-12\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times6+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-2\right)+18\times5=-90$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-10&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times2-\left(-1\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times9-9\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(27\,;\,20\,;\,45\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times0+20\times9+45\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-4\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times1-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times1-5\times1\right)=\left(-21\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times0+9\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&8\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-5\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times7-8\times3\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-31\,;\,27\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-3\right)+27\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-4&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-1\times7\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,-28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)+8\times7+\left(-28\right)\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,-12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times2-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times2\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times8+4\times3+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&5\\9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-3\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\5&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times4-5\times9\,;\,5\times5-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times9-6\times5\right)=\left(-21\,;\,37\,;\,-57\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-11\right)+37\times3+\left(-57\right)\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,10\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&5\\10&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&10\\-5&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-3\right)-5\times10\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times10-10\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-80\,;\,-28\,;\,40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-80\right)\times5+\left(-28\right)\times1+40\times6=-188$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&4\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-10&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-10\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times2-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-37\,;\,-58\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-37\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-58\right)\times3=-89$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-15\,;\,3\,;\,-11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,9\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-19\,;\,8\,;\,-16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-10\\10&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-9\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&9\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-10\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times1-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times10-9\times1\right)=\left(64\,;\,-46\,;\,-99\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=64\times\left(-19\right)+\left(-46\right)\times8+\left(-99\right)\times\left(-16\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times2\,;\,3\times0-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times2-\left(-6\right)\times0\right)=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times11+2\times\left(-2\right)+2\times4=70$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-5\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,9\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)+9\times\left(-5\right)+18\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&8\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&5\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times6-8\times2\,;\,8\times0-8\times6\,;\,8\times2-5\times0\right)=\left(14\,;\,-48\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times5+\left(-48\right)\times\left(-3\right)+16\times1=230$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-10\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-9\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&9\\-9&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\10&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-10\\-7&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times10-9\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times10\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-43\,;\,-52\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-43\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-1\right)=548$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\3&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(21\,;\,-42\,;\,-21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-42\right)\times0+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-11\right)=42$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&8\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&3\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times2-8\times0\,;\,8\times\left(-6\right)-3\times2\right)=\left(18\,;\,6\,;\,-54\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times11+6\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-54\right)\times\left(-4\right)=390$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-4\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,4\times3-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-4\times3\right)=\left(12\,;\,15\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times9+15\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-14\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-8\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times5+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-14\right)+\left(-55\right)\times4=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,11\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\0&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times8-3\times0\right)=\left(19\,;\,14\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=19\times2+14\times11+16\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\4&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-11\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-44\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-44\right)\times6+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-8\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&5\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&7\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-10\\7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-7\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,79\,;\,-52\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-10\right)+79\times0+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-2\right)=44$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(8\,;\,-23\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times4+\left(-23\right)\times2+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)=49$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-2\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-6\times0\,;\,6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-8\,;\,-38\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times7+\left(-8\right)\times3+\left(-38\right)\times2=-30$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-10\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times2-1\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-1\times2\right)=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)+1\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-9\right)\times2=-24$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,15\,;\,21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)+15\times1+21\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&9\\3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\8&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times8-9\times3\,;\,9\times\left(-3\right)-2\times8\,;\,2\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-35\,;\,-43\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times7+\left(-43\right)\times\left(-5\right)+3\times10=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(12\,;\,20\,;\,18\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,14\,;\,16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)-2\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-70\,;\,50\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times6+\left(-70\right)\times14+50\times16=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។
