$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-23\,;\,-7\,;\,33\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-7&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-5\\9&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-8&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times9-8\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(56\,;\,-19\,;\,35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=56\times\left(-23\right)+\left(-19\right)\times\left(-7\right)+35\times33=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times3\,;\,6\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(13\,;\,-14\,;\,23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times1+\left(-14\right)\times6+23\times\left(-5\right)=-186$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,15\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,13\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(9\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-1\right)\times13+8\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,17\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,12\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times4-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(-49\,;\,-28\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-49\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-28\right)\times12+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(26\,;\,11\,;\,-40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times8+11\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-40\right)\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(16\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(20\,;\,-1\,;\,-16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-6\\2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&10\\-10&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\10&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times10-10\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,10\times2-\left(-3\right)\times10\right)=\left(42\,;\,40\,;\,50\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=42\times20+40\times\left(-1\right)+50\times\left(-16\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&5\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times3-5\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,8\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-10\right)+8\times\left(-5\right)+30\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,13\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,12\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times3-3\times4\,;\,3\times7-4\times3\,;\,4\times4-\left(-4\right)\times7\right)=\left(-24\,;\,9\,;\,44\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times10+9\times12+44\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times4-4\times1\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times1+0\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-14\,;\,-7\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times1-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times1\right)=\left(14\,;\,7\,;\,35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-14\right)+7\times\left(-7\right)+35\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&3\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&10\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times2-3\times3\,;\,3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-10\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(11\,;\,-16\,;\,57\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-16\right)\times9+57\times\left(-5\right)=-495$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&9\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times1-9\times0\,;\,9\times1-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-8\times1\right)=\left(8\,;\,11\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-1\right)+11\times8+\left(-8\right)\times8=16$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,8\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,13\,;\,20\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&10\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\10&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times10-10\times5\,;\,10\times\left(-6\right)-0\times10\,;\,0\times5-8\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-60\,;\,48\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-60\right)\times13+48\times20=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,-5\,;\,24\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\2&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-11&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-6\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,6\times2-0\times6\right)=\left(8\,;\,42\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-6\right)+42\times\left(-4\right)+12\times18=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times1+\left(-1\right)\times2+\left(-2\right)\times4=-3$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times2-5\times1\,;\,5\times\left(-4\right)-5\times2\right)=\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,-30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times3+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-30\right)\times1=6$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&8\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-3\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times3-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(12\,;\,22\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times2+22\times3+\left(-15\right)\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&2\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\0&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times2-2\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,2\times0-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\right)=\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times6+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-9\right)\times1=25$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-10\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-10\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-1\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,-16\,;\,-34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-5\right)=219$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-14\,;\,11\,;\,32\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-20\,;\,14\,;\,36\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-5\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times6-10\times2\,;\,10\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,-20\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-20\right)+\left(-20\right)\times14+10\times36=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times6-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-2\right)\times4+\left(-2\right)\times10=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)+8\times\left(-9\right)+16\times7=60$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times3-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-3\times3\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-21\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-11\right)\times6=3$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-10\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-10&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\4&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,5\times4-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-10\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(48\,;\,22\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=48\times7+22\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-2\right)=210$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-11\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\-11&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-6\\-6&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-66\,;\,36\,;\,52\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-66\right)\times\left(-2\right)+36\times0+52\times0=132$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&9\\-9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-9\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-9\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,9\times2-\left(-9\right)\times7\right)=\left(89\,;\,53\,;\,81\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=89\times3+53\times\left(-6\right)+81\times\left(-6\right)=-537$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(13\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(12\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\-4&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-18\,;\,-4\,;\,-52\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times12+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,8\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-3\right)-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times3-1\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-3\,;\,24\,;\,25\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)+24\times5+25\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-18\,;\,18\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-13\,;\,13\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\7&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times7\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times\left(-13\right)+\left(-3\right)\times13+0\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times8-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-5\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-2\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(13\,;\,19\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=13\times1+19\times\left(-2\right)+9\times3=2$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-9\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times3-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times1-7\times3\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times1\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-18\,;\,-26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times0+\left(-18\right)\times0+\left(-26\right)\times1=-26$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(12\,;\,7\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(14\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times2-8\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(0\,;\,32\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times14+32\times3+\left(-24\right)\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-9\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-1\\-7&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times0-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,20\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times1+20\times8+12\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,10\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\10&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\7&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-8&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-6\times10\,;\,6\times\left(-8\right)-3\times7\,;\,3\times10-2\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-46\,;\,-69\,;\,46\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-69\right)\times4+46\times1=-92$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,-12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-10\,;\,-17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times5-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(55\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=55\times0+0\times\left(-10\right)+0\times\left(-17\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,7\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-12\right)+6\times7+15\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times2-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times1+8\times7+\left(-2\right)\times2=66$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,11\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,10\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&3\\7&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&11\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-7\right)+1\times10+53\times9=249$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-4\times1\,;\,4\times2-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times2+\left(-6\right)\times6+10\times6=26$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,-15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-16\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times5-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-1\times5\,;\,1\times1-3\times2\right)=\left(21\,;\,-17\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-17\right)\times1+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-16\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(15\,;\,2\,;\,-12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(18\,;\,0\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times9-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times0-0\times9\right)=\left(0\,;\,18\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times18+18\times0+0\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,13\,;\,22\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,12\,;\,25\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times\left(-2\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(29\,;\,-16\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=29\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-16\right)\times12+10\times25=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,12\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,13\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-4\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-6&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-1\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(29\,;\,6\,;\,-22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=29\times\left(-8\right)+6\times13+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-7\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-7&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-7&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times2-4\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,56\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-4\right)+56\times2+28\times0=160$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&5\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-9\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times4-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times0-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times0\right)=\left(-11\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times\left(-7\right)+4\times\left(-8\right)+5\times3=60$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-5\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times7-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times7-8\times7\,;\,8\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-49\,;\,11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times4+\left(-49\right)\times\left(-5\right)+11\times1=128$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-8\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times6\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-56\,;\,28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times3+\left(-56\right)\times4+28\times\left(-3\right)=-392$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&10\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-2\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times6-\left(-2\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-10\times6\,;\,10\times5-\left(-2\right)\times0\right)=\left(-2\,;\,-60\,;\,50\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-12\,;\,3\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,0\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-6\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times5-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times1-2\times5\right)=\left(-12\,;\,0\,;\,-10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-10\right)+0\times0+\left(-10\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-10\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-4\\-10&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\6&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-1\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-9\right)\times6\right)=\left(14\,;\,-18\,;\,44\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times4+\left(-18\right)\times1+44\times\left(-7\right)=-270$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-1\\-7&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-10&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-4\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,63\,;\,38\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times1+63\times2+38\times0=112$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,9\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,10\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&5\\9&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times5-5\times9\,;\,5\times1-4\times5\,;\,4\times9-10\times1\right)=\left(5\,;\,-15\,;\,26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times6+\left(-15\right)\times10+26\times2=-68$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times0-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,15\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times0+15\times2+\left(-1\right)\times0=30$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&11\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&4\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times6-11\times1\,;\,11\times0-4\times6\,;\,4\times1-1\times0\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-24\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-24\right)\times1+4\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-13\,;\,21\,;\,-26\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,11\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,26\,;\,-29\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-7\\11&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\-8&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\-7&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times11-5\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(37\,;\,25\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=37\times\left(-16\right)+25\times26+2\times\left(-29\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&1\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&8\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times7-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times0-8\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(56\,;\,57\,;\,48\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=56\times\left(-5\right)+57\times9+48\times10=713$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-9\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&4\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-9\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times1-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times3-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-9\right)\times3\right)=\left(11\,;\,13\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times4+13\times\left(-9\right)+32\times6=119$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times2-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\right)=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+32\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&10\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&7\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times2-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-10\times2\,;\,10\times3-7\times1\right)=\left(20\,;\,-22\,;\,23\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times4+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-1\right)+23\times5=217$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\9&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-3\times3\,;\,3\times3-\left(-2\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(-36\,;\,27\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times\left(-7\right)+27\times\left(-3\right)+3\times4=183$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,12\,;\,-1\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-31\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times12+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-22\,;\,-3\,;\,19\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times\left(-22\right)+\left(-37\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-29\right)\times19=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times4+18\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-38\right)\times\left(-1\right)=112$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(13\,;\,7\,;\,-2\right)$ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-13\,;\,-8\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-15\,;\,-4\,;\,13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times3-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\right)=\left(3\,;\,18\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=3\times\left(-15\right)+18\times\left(-4\right)+9\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-4&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times0-0\times9\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times9-3\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-6\right)+0\times6+12\times1=12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times4-9\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times4\right)=\left(23\,;\,35\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times\left(-2\right)+35\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)=-138$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,-6\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,8\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(20\,;\,34\,;\,-15\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-5\\10&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\5&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,7\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\7&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-10&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-7&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-6&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(16\,;\,16\,;\,18\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-29\right)\times17+32\times17=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,11\,;\,8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-11\right)\times6+0\times5+22\times3=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,8\right)$ ។

$$=\left(2\times0-4\times7\,;\,4\times0-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-2\times0\right)=\left(-28\,;\,0\,;\,-21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times\left(-9\right)+0\times13+\left(-21\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។

$$=\left(2\times1-5\times2\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-2\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-24\,;\,0\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-24\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-19\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-19\right)+\left(-53\right)\times0+0\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-21\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,9\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-18\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\9&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\5&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-2\times9\,;\,2\times5-3\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,3\times9-0\times5\right)=\left(-18\,;\,19\,;\,27\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\6&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-6\times4\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-2\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-2\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-30\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-30\right)\times3+6\times7=12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,-22\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-22\right)\times0+0\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-6\right)\times3+2\times\left(-6\right)=-10$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-1\times4\right)=\left(-57\,;\,-32\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-57\right)\times0+\left(-32\right)\times1+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-16$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-2\\7&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-4\times8\,;\,4\times7-1\times3\,;\,1\times8-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(-38\,;\,25\,;\,22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times0+25\times2+22\times9=248$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-4&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times10-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-1\times10\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-13\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times0+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-4\right)\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,25\,;\,12\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-11\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-11\,;\,5\right)$ ។

$$=\left(1\times4-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times1-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(9\,;\,21\,;\,24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-4\right)+21\times\left(-4\right)+24\times5=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&8\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times8+5\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
