ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\2&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\11&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times2-2\times8\,;\,2\times11-7\times2\,;\,7\times8-6\times11\right)=\left(-4\,;\,8\,;\,-10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times2+8\times2+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)=48$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times0+1\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-16\right)\times0=-2$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-8\,;\,-12\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-15\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-7\\-8&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times5-0\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-8\right)\right)=\left(-35\,;\,15\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times\left(-11\right)+15\times\left(-15\right)+\left(-32\right)\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&8\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-1\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-1\right)-8\times5\,;\,8\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-44\,;\,-9\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-44\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-9\right)\times9+\left(-1\right)\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(11\,;\,18\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,12\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&9\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&0\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-4&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times2-9\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-4\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(69\,;\,-36\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=69\times8+\left(-36\right)\times12+\left(-24\right)\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-3\\3&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-7\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-47\,;\,-29\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-47\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-29\right)\times11+\left(-5\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-8\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times4-0\times0\,;\,0\times5-9\times4\,;\,9\times0-\left(-8\right)\times5\right)=\left(-32\,;\,-36\,;\,40\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-32\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-8\right)+40\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-8\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-7\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-9\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-6\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times0-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,-31\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-31\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-8\right)=44$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-4&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,4\,;\,24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-6\right)+4\times\left(-3\right)+24\times\left(-7\right)=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times2-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-2\times4\right)=\left(16\,;\,-12\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times10+\left(-12\right)\times4+\left(-14\right)\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-7\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(17\,;\,2\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times\left(-1\right)+2\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-3\right)=19$$

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\-9&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-4\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-5&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=95\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-17\right)\times\left(-9\right)+46\times5=288$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-16\,;\,-30\,;\,-33\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-10\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-22\,;\,-35\,;\,-39\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=40\times\left(-22\right)+\left(-53\right)\times\left(-35\right)+25\times\left(-39\right)=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(12\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\0&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-8\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-32\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-16\right)+\left(-32\right)\times3+4\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&9\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,2\times7-9\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,9\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(20\,;\,59\,;\,-31\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times8+59\times0+\left(-31\right)\times0=160$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-11\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-11\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\-11&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-1\\9&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\5&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times9-9\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,9\times5-\left(-1\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-2\right)\times5\right)=\left(81\,;\,54\,;\,21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=81\times\left(-3\right)+54\times\left(-11\right)+21\times6=-711$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-10\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-12\,;\,14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-10&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times7-0\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-4\times7\,;\,4\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-56\,;\,-28\,;\,-56\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-56\right)\times14=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-12\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-3\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,3\times6-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(34\,;\,12\,;\,26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times2+12\times\left(-10\right)+26\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(13\,;\,-9\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(12\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&3\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-2\times0\,;\,2\times3-3\times0\,;\,3\times0-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times12+6\times\left(-6\right)+6\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,14\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&7\\10&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\7&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\-1&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times7-7\times10\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-0\times7\,;\,0\times10-6\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-7\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-7\right)\times14+6\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\7&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times7-0\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,0\times7-\left(-4\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times7\right)=\left(14\,;\,28\,;\,-2\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-11\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-1\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times5-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times5\right)=\left(-66\,;\,-59\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-66\right)\times6+\left(-59\right)\times\left(-2\right)+6\times\left(-9\right)=-332$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-10&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-2\right)-7\times9\,;\,7\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times9-3\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-69\,;\,-74\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-69\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-74\right)\times5+12\times3=149$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,-9\,;\,15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(18\,;\,-15\,;\,19\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-9&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\9&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\9&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times9-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times9-0\times9\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-3\right)\times9\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-9\,;\,27\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times18+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-15\right)+27\times19=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,12\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,11\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,17\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-9\\11&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&9\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&5\\5&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-9\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-9\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,9\times11-5\times5\right)=\left(69\,;\,9\,;\,74\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=69\times1+9\times17+74\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-10\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,22\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-7\right)+22\times\left(-10\right)+2\times\left(-9\right)=-126$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,23\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)+23\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-2\times1\right)=\left(18\,;\,-30\,;\,-34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times0+\left(-30\right)\times6+\left(-34\right)\times1=-214$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times3-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)+6\times\left(-1\right)+15\times3=75$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,11\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,11\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-7\\11&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&10\\-1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&11\\9&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-7\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times9-10\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,10\times11-11\times9\right)=\left(66\,;\,-53\,;\,11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=66\times4+\left(-53\right)\times6+11\times\left(-4\right)=-98$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-11\\-3&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&2\\-11&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(44\,;\,77\,;\,-41\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=44\times\left(-4\right)+77\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-41\right)\times\left(-10\right)=3$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,-10\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-10&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&4\\7&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\9&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times7-7\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,7\times9-4\times7\,;\,4\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times9\right)=\left(28\,;\,35\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times\left(-2\right)+35\times\left(-8\right)+14\times3=-294$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-10\right)+10\times\left(-4\right)+0\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&6\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&4\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&9\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times3-6\times2\,;\,6\times6-4\times3\,;\,4\times2-9\times6\right)=\left(15\,;\,24\,;\,-46\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=15\times2+24\times2+\left(-46\right)\times3=-60$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(-6\,;\,-9\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times7+\left(-9\right)\times5+6\times\left(-2\right)=-99$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-13\,;\,-2\,;\,-14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-17\,;\,-4\,;\,-14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-8\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times6-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-0\times1\right)=\left(16\,;\,44\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-17\right)+44\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-14\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-22\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,10\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-17\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\10&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\-2&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times3-1\times10\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times10-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,-34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times0+10\times\left(-17\right)+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-5\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(9\,;\,-9\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-5\right)+0\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\8&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times8-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-1\times8\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-1\times0\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-3\right)\times6=31$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-17\,;\,18\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,14\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-4\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\3&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\7&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-2\right)\times7\right)=\left(-38\,;\,-22\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times\left(-16\right)+\left(-22\right)\times14+30\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-5\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-3&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-5\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(25\,;\,15\,;\,-34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=25\times\left(-1\right)+15\times0+\left(-34\right)\times\left(-1\right)=9$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&0\\-5&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times10-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-7\times10\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-70\,;\,-70\,;\,-42\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-70\right)\times1+\left(-70\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-42\right)\times10=-210$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-8\,;\,-14\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-9\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-12\,;\,-18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\-9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-1&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-30\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times\left(-1\right)+4\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-18\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,10\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&4\\10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&4\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\1&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times1-4\times10\,;\,4\times1-4\times1\,;\,4\times10-10\times1\right)=\left(-30\,;\,0\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-30\right)\times7+0\times10+30\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-6\\-3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,13\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times1+13\times7+9\times\left(-7\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(7\,;\,10\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,10\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(9\,;\,14\,;\,14\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&8\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&10\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times6-8\times4\,;\,8\times5-4\times6\,;\,4\times4-10\times5\right)=\left(28\,;\,16\,;\,-34\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=28\times9+16\times14+\left(-34\right)\times14=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,7\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-5\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&8\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&9\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times0-\left(-5\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-8\times0\,;\,8\times4-9\times5\right)=\left(20\,;\,-25\,;\,-13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times10+\left(-25\right)\times7+\left(-13\right)\times\left(-5\right)=90$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,17\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,21\,;\,18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&3\\9&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\0&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times9-3\times9\,;\,3\times0-\left(-4\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times9-4\times0\right)=\left(9\,;\,36\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=9\times\left(-12\right)+36\times21+\left(-36\right)\times18=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\0&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&1\\6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times6-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times6\,;\,1\times0-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,4\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times\left(-1\right)+4\times10+12\times5=64$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-4&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times5-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,28\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times8+28\times\left(-3\right)+14\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-11\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-16\,;\,6\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-11\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-11&-1\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-11\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-11\right)\times7-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(27\,;\,-51\,;\,-82\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times\left(-16\right)+\left(-51\right)\times6+\left(-82\right)\times\left(-9\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,-10\,;\,-11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-10\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,15\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)+15\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-13\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,7\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\7&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&10\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times1-0\times7\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times7-10\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,4\,;\,22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times0+4\times9+22\times\left(-1\right)=14$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,11\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&8\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-7\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&11\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times2-8\times6\,;\,8\times2-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times6-11\times2\right)=\left(-26\,;\,30\,;\,-64\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-26\right)\times11+30\times1+\left(-64\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-1\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,20\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)+20\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)=-40$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\6&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\6&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times6-0\times4\,;\,0\times6-0\times6\,;\,0\times4-3\times6\right)=\left(18\,;\,0\,;\,-18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-2\right)+0\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-18\right)\times1=-54$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&7\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times9-7\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(57\,;\,8\,;\,28\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-9\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-9\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-9\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-6\\-9&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-9\\-6&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,12\,;\,-18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-9\right)+12\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-18\right)\times1=-126$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times4-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times4\right)=\left(16\,;\,12\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times0+12\times5+\left(-4\right)\times0=60$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times2-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times2\right)=\left(11\,;\,7\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times2+7\times2+\left(-8\right)\times6=-12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times3-5\times8\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times8-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-49\,;\,-8\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-49\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+5\times\left(-4\right)=192$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-11\,;\,-11\,;\,22\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-12\,;\,-9\,;\,18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\6&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-8\right)-2\times6\,;\,2\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-3\times4\right)=\left(-36\,;\,-24\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-36\right)\times\left(-12\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-36\right)\times18=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-11\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,7\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&1\\5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\-4&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\-11&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-4\right)-1\times5\,;\,1\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-9\times\left(-11\right)\right)=\left(-41\,;\,-31\,;\,74\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-41\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-31\right)\times7+74\times\left(-3\right)=-234$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-11\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\-3&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(16\,;\,-14\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=16\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-11\right)+4\times\left(-3\right)=14$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-6\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-3\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,3\times3-3\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,14\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)+14\times\left(-3\right)+3\times10=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(17\,;\,-17\,;\,-17\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(18\,;\,-19\,;\,-17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-4\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-6\\6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times6-4\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times6\right)=\left(26\,;\,-4\,;\,32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=26\times18+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-19\right)+32\times\left(-17\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-9\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\8&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times8-\left(-2\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-\left(-2\right)\times4\right)=\left(-14\,;\,16\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)+16\times\left(-9\right)+5\times4=-82$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&3\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times8-7\times1\,;\,7\times2-3\times8\,;\,3\times1-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(-47\,;\,-10\,;\,13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-47\right)\times7+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)+13\times\left(-1\right)=-302$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times0-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times2-\left(-5\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,20\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times5+0\times\left(-2\right)+20\times3=60$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,22\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,16\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\1&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-4\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,4\times1-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)-0\times1\right)=\left(32\,;\,7\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-3\right)+7\times16+8\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\4&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times4-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times7-0\times4\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-3\times7\right)=\left(7\,;\,-7\,;\,-21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times6+\left(-7\right)\times3+\left(-21\right)\times\left(-1\right)=42$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-9\\1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&3\\-9&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\-7&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)-3\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,3\times1-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(54\,;\,90\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=54\times1+90\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-7\right)=-532$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\3&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&0\\-9&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,0\times3-3\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-6\right)+9\times\left(-1\right)+3\times\left(-4\right)=-21$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\-1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-0\times1\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-2\,;\,12\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+12\times0+0\times\left(-4\right)=4$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&7\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-2\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-3\times1\,;\,3\times1-7\times3\,;\,7\times1-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-18\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times8+\left(-18\right)\times\left(-1\right)+9\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-6\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-2\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times4-3\times2\,;\,3\times2-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(-18\,;\,14\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times\left(-6\right)+14\times\left(-8\right)+2\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-9\right)+9\times6+18\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,20\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,22\,;\,-15\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&6\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times4-6\times0\right)=\left(-24\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times0+0\times22+0\times\left(-15\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-14\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\2&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,0\times2-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times2\right)=\left(8\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times2+4\times\left(-14\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(15\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(11\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(20\,;\,-10\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&11\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}11&-5\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times3-5\times0\,;\,5\times2-11\times3\,;\,11\times0-\left(-5\right)\times2\right)=\left(-15\,;\,-23\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times20+\left(-23\right)\times\left(-10\right)+10\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-15\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&2\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\-2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\-7&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-2\times0\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times0-4\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-30\,;\,28\right)$$
