ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-2\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times4+4\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-5\times5\,;\,5\times\left(-5\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times5-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,-26\,;\,25\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-26\right)\times9+25\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&10\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&1\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times4-10\times3\,;\,10\times\left(-6\right)-1\times4\,;\,1\times3-5\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-64\,;\,33\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-64\right)\times4+33\times6=42$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\9&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times9-6\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,6\times2-2\times9\right)=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times5+9\times2+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)=58$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&7\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-7\times8\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times8-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-55\,;\,-19\,;\,13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-55\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-19\right)\times7+13\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times0\right)=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)+0\times6+8\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&1\\5&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\9&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times5-5\times8\,;\,5\times9-1\times5\,;\,1\times8-1\times9\right)=\left(-35\,;\,40\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-35\right)\times0+40\times5+\left(-1\right)\times3=197$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-10\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&5\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-10\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times\left(-4\right)-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times3-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-10\right)\times3\right)=\left(50\,;\,23\,;\,26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=50\times\left(-6\right)+23\times\left(-4\right)+26\times6=-236$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-2\right)-0\times8\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times8-7\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,4\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times6+4\times1+30\times\left(-1\right)=-110$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,9\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,10\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\9&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\9&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\6&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times9-3\times9\,;\,3\times6-\left(-1\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times9-1\times6\right)=\left(-18\,;\,27\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-18\right)\times5+27\times10+\left(-15\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-11\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-6\\-11&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\2&-11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(-69\,;\,-6\,;\,24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-69\right)\times7+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)+24\times\left(-7\right)=-615$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-14\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-15\,;\,-10\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\-2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-3\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-15\right)+0\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-15\right)\times\left(-5\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times3+13\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-2\right)\times2=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\4&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-8&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\7&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-48\right)\times4+4\times0=-256$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&7\\-4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-7\\0&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-9\\-7&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-8\\5&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&10\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\7&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\-5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times7-10\times7\,;\,10\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times7-6\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-28\,;\,-29\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-28\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-29\right)\times5+9\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-9\,;\,-10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-10\,;\,-13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-5&-8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&7\\-8&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\6&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times6-7\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-5\right)-0\times6\right)=\left(-15\,;\,38\,;\,-35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-15\right)\times5+38\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-13\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(13\,;\,20\,;\,-13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,16\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-7&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\4&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-6&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-7\right)-2\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,32\,;\,26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times10+32\times16+26\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-9\\-4&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\-9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-3\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,-54\,;\,26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-54\right)\times2+26\times\left(-6\right)=-237$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\9&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-3&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-5\times9\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times9-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-45\,;\,-15\,;\,39\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-45\right)\times0+\left(-15\right)\times0+39\times\left(-2\right)=-78$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-4\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\4&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times4-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-3\times4\,;\,3\times\left(-3\right)-0\times5\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-32\,;\,-9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-9\right)\times\left(-2\right)=222$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,10\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&-10\\3&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-3\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&10\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(10\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-10\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-10\times1\right)=\left(-70\,;\,-40\,;\,-19\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-70\right)\times3+\left(-40\right)\times9+\left(-19\right)\times\left(-4\right)=-494$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-1\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-3\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-1&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&6\\10&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times10-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times5-6\times10\right)=\left(9\,;\,-28\,;\,-50\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&7\\-1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&6\\8&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-9\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times8-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-6\times8\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-65\,;\,-55\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-65\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-55\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-15\right)\times7=300$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,15\,;\,12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,18\,;\,13\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-4\times3\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-5\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,-11\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-11\right)\times18+12\times13=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\8&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times8-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times1-0\times8\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-3\times1\right)=\left(24\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times3+0\times2+\left(-3\right)\times0=72$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-0\times8\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times8-0\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,12\,;\,-48\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-7\right)+12\times1+\left(-48\right)\times0=12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&7\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&5\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times0-7\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-1\right)-5\times0\right)=\left(-10\,;\,14\,;\,-7\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times1+14\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-7\right)\times0=-66$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\1&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&4\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times1-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times4-1\times1\,;\,1\times4-4\times4\right)=\left(8\,;\,-5\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times7+\left(-5\right)\times4+\left(-12\right)\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&10\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-3\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)-6\times3\,;\,6\times2-10\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,10\times3-\left(-3\right)\times2\right)=\left(-12\,;\,32\,;\,36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times8+32\times3+36\times3=108$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-10&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-3\right)-1\times1\,;\,1\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-0\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-19\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times4+\left(-19\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-3\right)\times5=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(11\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,6\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-5\\6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&3\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&6\\-2&6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times0-\left(-5\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-3\times0\,;\,3\times6-6\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(30\,;\,10\,;\,30\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=30\times8+10\times6+30\times\left(-10\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,-11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,-17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\1&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\-9&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-1\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times4-4\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,4\times1-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(17\,;\,4\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=17\times8+4\times0+8\times\left(-17\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times0-7\times2\,;\,7\times\left(-4\right)-0\times0\right)=\left(4\,;\,-14\,;\,-28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-28\right)\times3=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\8&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times8-5\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(2\,;\,38\,;\,50\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times6+38\times1+50\times\left(-3\right)=-100$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,-7\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-7\,;\,0\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-12\right)$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\0&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-7\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,11\,;\,-18\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,16\,;\,-21\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-5\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-1\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-10&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,48\,;\,1\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,11\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,9\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}11&-5\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&6\\-6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&11\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(11\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-6\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,6\times2-11\times1\right)=\left(-56\,;\,31\,;\,1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-56\right)\times7+31\times9+1\times\left(-1\right)=-114$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-1\times2\,;\,1\times3-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-2\times3\right)=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)+3\times3+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-1\right)=31$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-10&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-2\\-1&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-10&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-5\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(52\,;\,-52\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=52\times0+\left(-52\right)\times\left(-8\right)+0\times\left(-3\right)=416$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-1\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,1\times2-5\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-3\times2\right)=\left(-13\,;\,27\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-13\right)\times2+27\times4+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-2\right)=114$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&6\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-8\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-2\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times0-6\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(12\,;\,-36\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=12\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-2\right)+4\times12=0$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(10\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(13\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-6\right)$ ។

$$=\left(1\times1-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times2-1\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,-9\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(15\,;\,9\,;\,14\right)$ ។

$$=\left(7\times\left(-4\right)-6\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-7\right)-1\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-1\right)-7\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-22\,;\,-38\,;\,48\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-22\right)\times15+\left(-38\right)\times9+48\times14=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(11\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-4\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times4-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-5\times4\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-12\,;\,-32\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times11+\left(-12\right)\times3+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-8\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&3\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&2\\-2&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times1-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-3\times1\,;\,3\times\left(-5\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(7\,;\,-5\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=7\times1+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-11\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(7\,;\,11\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,13\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&6\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times5-6\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-6\times5\right)=\left(-34\,;\,10\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-34\right)\times7+10\times13+\left(-36\right)\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\7&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\7&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\2&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times7-\left(-1\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(0\,;\,12\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-2\right)+12\times5+\left(-12\right)\times2=36$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-4&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,0\times4-4\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)+9\times4+12\times\left(-4\right)=-4$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-18\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-13\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\9&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\2&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times\left(-4\right)-2\times9\,;\,2\times2-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times9-5\times2\right)=\left(-38\,;\,-8\,;\,-37\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-38\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-13\right)+\left(-37\right)\times10=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times0-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-0\times0\,;\,0\times0-2\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,20\,;\,10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-5\right)+20\times2+10\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-8\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&4\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-6&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(14\,;\,-44\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-44\right)\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(7\,;\,-2\,;\,-6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&1\\0&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\0&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-3\times0\right)=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-3\right)\times3+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)+0\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,0\,;\,10\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-2\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times1-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times1\right)=\left(-8\,;\,16\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times8+16\times0+8\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-9\,;\,9\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-9&9\\-1&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times1-3\times5\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-9\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-9\right)\times5-9\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,6\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-8\right)+6\times6+\left(-36\right)\times0=84$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}8&-2\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&8\\-3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(8\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-8\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(-12\,;\,2\,;\,20\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times4+2\times4+20\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times2-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-0\times2\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times2+0\times7+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,4\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-7\\-3&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-8\\-10&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&4\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-61\,;\,-45\,;\,44\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-61\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-45\right)\times5+44\times\left(-2\right)=297$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-19\,;\,-9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-15\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-3\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times3-\left(-3\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-1\times3\,;\,1\times8-1\times1\right)=\left(27\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=27\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-15\right)+7\times\left(-9\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\4&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&7\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times4-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-7\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(32\,;\,21\,;\,19\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=32\times\left(-4\right)+21\times\left(-3\right)+19\times\left(-1\right)=-210$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,2\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\2&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-7\\-6&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-2\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times2\,;\,1\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-48\,;\,-26\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-48\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-26\right)\times\left(-2\right)=10$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-10\,;\,13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-11\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&5\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times\left(-2\right)-5\times1\,;\,5\times1-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times1-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times\left(-1\right)+5\times\left(-11\right)+5\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-9\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-8\\-9&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-9\\-6&-9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-6\right)-1\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,55\,;\,-63\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)+55\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-63\right)\times\left(-8\right)=320$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&-4\\-3&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&4\\-9&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-8\\2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-4\times\left(-9\right)\,;\,4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times2\right)=\left(60\,;\,28\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=60\times3+28\times\left(-1\right)+4\times\left(-4\right)=136$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,13\,;\,-13\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,18\,;\,-17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-4\\9&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\0&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-4\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-0\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,0\times9-3\times0\right)=\left(21\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times0+0\times18+0\times\left(-17\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-10\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-10&10\\-6&10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&5\\10&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-10\\-5&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-10\right)\times10-10\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,10\times\left(-5\right)-5\times10\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-40\,;\,-100\,;\,-80\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-40\right)\times6+\left(-100\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-80\right)\times8=-280$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&0\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\-7&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times5-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-7\right)-0\times5\,;\,0\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-35\,;\,-49\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-35\right)\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-49\right)\times3=-52$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,12\,;\,9\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,10\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-1&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(6\,;\,-8\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-8\right)\times10+14\times7=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,-3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-15\,;\,-8\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\-3&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-5\\-6&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&2\\-10&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-10\right)\right)=\left(-21\,;\,0\,;\,35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-21\right)\times\left(-15\right)+0\times\left(-8\right)+35\times\left(-9\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\0&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\-6&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times7-5\times0\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times0-0\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-7\right)+5\times0+0\times9=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-3\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-3\,;\,19\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times3+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)+19\times\left(-1\right)=-88$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\-5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-3\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,3\times2-0\times1\right)=\left(6\,;\,12\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=6\times5+12\times\left(-4\right)+6\times0=-18$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,10\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-5\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-2\\-4&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-7\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(36\,;\,8\,;\,-28\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=36\times\left(-3\right)+8\times10+\left(-28\right)\times\left(-1\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\-2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-1\\5&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times5-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times3-\left(-1\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times3\right)=\left(10\,;\,20\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times5+20\times\left(-7\right)+2\times4=-82$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(8\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&8\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&0\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times1-0\times1\,;\,0\times1-8\times1\,;\,8\times1-0\times1\right)=\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,8\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-9\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-9\,;\,11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\-5&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\6&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\-4&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times6-1\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-0\times6\,;\,0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-1\right)\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-4\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-4\right)\times11=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&0\\2&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-5\\5&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times2-7\times2\,;\,7\times5-0\times2\,;\,0\times2-\left(-5\right)\times5\right)=\left(-24\,;\,35\,;\,25\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)+35\times\left(-1\right)+25\times10=239$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(15\,;\,-13\,;\,18\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(18\,;\,-18\,;\,17\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&5\\-6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&4\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\6&-6\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times2-5\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,5\times6-4\times2\,;\,4\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-4\right)\times6\right)=\left(22\,;\,22\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times18+22\times\left(-18\right)+0\times17=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-10\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-6\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-3\\-5&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times0-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-9\,;\,28\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-9\right)\times\left(-11\right)+28\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-15\right)\times1=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(-6\,;\,9\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=19\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-21\right)\times2+28\times1=-52$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-10\,;\,8\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-11\,;\,7\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\8&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-2&-10\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&0\\-10&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-11\right)+4\times7+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-1\right)=-36$$

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-10\,;\,-6\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-5&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-7&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times2-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,13\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times\left(-10\right)+13\times\left(-6\right)+8\times1=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-9\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&9\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&-2\\5&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times4+\left(-17\right)\times0+0\times\left(-1\right)=0$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,-9\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-2\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-10\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-7\right)\times1+6\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-10\right)\times9=-151$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-4\\-1&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&3\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times3-3\times0\,;\,3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-12\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times3+\left(-12\right)\times1+6\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
