$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,8\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&1\\4&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-5\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&4\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-5\right)-1\times4\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times4-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-27\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-27\right)\times8+\left(-12\right)\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times4-3\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=1\times\left(-3\right)+2\times5+6\times1=13$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}10&0\\3&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-5&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&10\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-50\right)\times6+0\times11+40\times\left(-4\right)=-460$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&-3\\2&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times2-\left(-7\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-\left(-3\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times2-\left(-2\right)\times3\right)=\left(10\,;\,-15\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times0+\left(-15\right)\times0+0\times\left(-5\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-4\\0&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-3\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times5-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-\left(-3\right)\times5\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-\left(-1\right)\times4\right)=\left(-5\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)+4\times\left(-4\right)=21$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-7\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\-7&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&2\\-2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\4&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,0\times4-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-7\right)-0\times4\right)=\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times6+4\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-2\right)=12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-8&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&6\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&-1\\-2&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times3-6\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-2\right)-6\times3\,;\,6\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(45\,;\,-30\,;\,-50\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=45\times3+\left(-30\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-50\right)\times6=-45$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-8\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-14\,;\,-12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-4\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-4\\-5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)-1\times0\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-8\,;\,20\,;\,-22\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)+20\times\left(-14\right)+\left(-22\right)\times\left(-12\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,11\,;\,-19\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,13\,;\,-20\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-6\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&3\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&3\\-1&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times8+12\times13+15\times\left(-20\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(33\,;\,2\,;\,-20\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(10\,;\,-1\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(8\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(38\,;\,0\,;\,-23\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-8\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&10\\1&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-1\\8&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times1-\left(-8\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times8-10\times1\,;\,10\times3-\left(-1\right)\times8\right)=\left(23\,;\,-74\,;\,38\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=23\times38+\left(-74\right)\times0+38\times\left(-23\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,1\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&8\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-8\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\0&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times2-8\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,8\times0-\left(-8\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)-1\times0\right)=\left(18\,;\,16\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=18\times\left(-1\right)+16\times\left(-2\right)+16\times3=-2$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-13\,;\,-8\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-13\,;\,-9\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&10\\5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}10&-1\\4&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-10\times5\,;\,10\times6-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times5-1\times6\right)=\left(-46\,;\,64\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times\left(-13\right)+64\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-11\right)\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,13\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-6\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(13\,;\,10\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&-10\\2&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-5\\-5&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-6\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-10\right)\times2\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times4-\left(-5\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-\left(-6\right)\times4\right)=\left(50\,;\,-65\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=50\times13+\left(-65\right)\times10+14\times0=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(9\,;\,-3\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(13\,;\,0\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&3\\2&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times2-\left(-3\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times4-3\times2\,;\,3\times0-0\times4\right)=\left(0\,;\,-18\,;\,0\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times13+\left(-18\right)\times0+0\times\left(-7\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,-6\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&8\\3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&-8\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&-6\\-6&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times0-8\times3\,;\,8\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-8\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times3-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-24\,;\,-48\,;\,-60\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-24\right)\times\left(-9\right)+\left(-48\right)\times0+\left(-60\right)\times\left(-1\right)=276$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(5\,;\,-8\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&1\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&5\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-8\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-2\right)-5\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(11\,;\,3\,;\,-31\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times5+3\times\left(-8\right)+\left(-31\right)\times0=31$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-9\,;\,11\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-7\\0&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&4\\-5&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times0-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-7\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times\left(-3\right)-4\times\left(-5\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,10\,;\,41\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,11\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,2\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,10\,;\,-4\right)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(10\,;\,9\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\3&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-1\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&1\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,-3\right)$ ។

$$=\left(4\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,8\right)$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&2\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\3&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times1-2\times2\,;\,2\times3-\left(-7\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times2-6\times3\right)=\left(2\,;\,13\,;\,-32\right)$$

ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(24\,;\,-18\,;\,-12\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(29\,;\,-19\,;\,-18\right)$ ។

$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times29+\left(-37\right)\times\left(-19\right)+31\times\left(-18\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-6\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\-7&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\8&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&0\\2&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times8-3\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,3\times2-\left(-1\right)\times8\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)-0\times2\right)=\left(21\,;\,14\,;\,7\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times4+14\times\left(-6\right)+7\times4=28$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(14\,;\,-21\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,-18\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-8\\9&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-2&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&0\\-4&9\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-8\right)\times9\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times9-0\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(72\,;\,36\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=72\times10+36\times\left(-18\right)+18\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-1\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,8\,;\,11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\8&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\11&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&1\\-3&8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times11-0\times8\,;\,0\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times8-1\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(11\,;\,22\,;\,-13\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=11\times\left(-5\right)+22\times2+\left(-13\right)\times5=-76$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&3\\1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-3\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&6\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times6-3\times1\,;\,3\times2-\left(-3\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-6\times2\right)=\left(33\,;\,24\,;\,-15\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=33\times4+24\times3+\left(-15\right)\times3=159$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-5\\7&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-6&5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times7-5\times5\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-5\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times5-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(-46\,;\,5\,;\,-43\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times4+5\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-43\right)\times4=-371$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(1\,;\,-8\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-8&2\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-8\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-8\right)\times3-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-1\times3\,;\,1\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-16\,;\,-11\,;\,-36\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-16\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-11\right)\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-36\right)\times7=-159$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-7\,;\,21\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,21\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-2\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-1\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&6\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times3-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-1\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-6\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(24\,;\,11\,;\,21\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=24\times\left(-7\right)+11\times21+21\times\left(-3\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,4\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-10\,;\,11\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-10\,;\,12\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&7\\-5&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\5&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times5-7\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,7\times1-2\times5\,;\,2\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\right)=\left(10\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times3+\left(-3\right)\times\left(-10\right)+\left(-5\right)\times12=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(6\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(7\,;\,-3\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\3&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\-4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-3\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times1-2\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,2\times3-\left(-3\right)\times1\right)=\left(21\,;\,5\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=21\times7+5\times\left(-3\right)+9\times5=177$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-4\\5&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times3-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times5-4\times3\,;\,4\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-4\right)\times5\right)=\left(-10\,;\,-2\,;\,16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-10\right)\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-2\right)\times\left(-2\right)+16\times\left(-4\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-2\\7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\5&7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times3-\left(-2\right)\times7\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times5-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times7-0\times5\right)=\left(14\,;\,-4\,;\,-14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times3+\left(-4\right)\times0+\left(-14\right)\times\left(-3\right)=84$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-8\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&-8\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&3\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times2-0\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-3\times2\right)=\left(-19\,;\,-16\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-19\right)\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-16\right)\times7+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-6\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-8\,;\,-5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=0\times\left(-8\right)+1\times\left(-5\right)+\left(-1\right)\times0=-5$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-2\right)$ និង $D\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-7\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&-1\\-5&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-3\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-3\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(10\,;\,-14\,;\,12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=10\times\left(-7\right)+\left(-14\right)\times5+12\times0=-140$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,6\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&-10\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&0\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-10\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times1-0\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,0\times\left(-1\right)-1\times1\right)=\left(-12\,;\,-10\,;\,-1\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-12\right)\times8+\left(-10\right)\times6+\left(-1\right)\times\left(-7\right)=-149$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,-6\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-7\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,1\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-7&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\3&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&-6\\5&-7\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times3-2\times\left(-7\right)\,;\,2\times5-5\times3\,;\,5\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-6\right)\times5\right)=\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-4\right)\times3+\left(-5\right)\times\left(-1\right)+\left(-5\right)\times1=-12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,-5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(4\,;\,-8\,;\,3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,11\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-2\\11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&2\\-2&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\2&11\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times11\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times2-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times11-4\times2\right)=\left(14\,;\,0\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=14\times2+0\times\left(-3\right)+14\times\left(-2\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(2\,;\,7\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(7\,;\,-1\,;\,2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&2\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&7\\-1&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-1\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-2\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,2\times2-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times2\right)=\left(5\,;\,11\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=5\times3+11\times3+\left(-12\right)\times4=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(3\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(18\,;\,5\,;\,15\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(2\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(17\,;\,8\,;\,18\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\-1&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\6&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&3\\2&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times6-4\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,4\times2-5\times6\,;\,5\times\left(-1\right)-3\times2\right)=\left(22\,;\,-22\,;\,-11\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=22\times17+\left(-22\right)\times8+\left(-11\right)\times18=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,6\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(17\,;\,2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,4\,;\,-10\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,-11\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(20\,;\,5\,;\,-9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-10\\3&-11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&9\\-11&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&4\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-11\right)-\left(-10\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-2\right)-9\times\left(-11\right)\,;\,9\times3-4\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-14\,;\,119\,;\,35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-14\right)\times20+119\times5+35\times\left(-9\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,6\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-4\,;\,5\right)$ និង $D\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-6\,;\,-6\,;\,7\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-9\,;\,-10\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,8\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-6&7\\-10&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&-6\\6&-9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-6\\-9&-10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-6\right)\times6-7\times\left(-10\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-9\right)-\left(-6\right)\times6\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-10\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-9\right)\right)=\left(34\,;\,-27\,;\,6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=34\times\left(-3\right)+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-2\right)+6\times8=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ C\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ និង $D\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-1&-5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&6\\-5&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}6&0\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-5\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-6\times\left(-5\right)\,;\,6\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,36\,;\,-6\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times0+36\times0+\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)=12$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ B\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,9\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\4&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&1\\-4&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times4-0\times3\,;\,0\times\left(-4\right)-0\times4\,;\,0\times3-1\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=4\times\left(-2\right)+0\times0+4\times9=28$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(5\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(11\,;\,0\,;\,-8\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-4\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-4\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,-4\,;\,-11\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-4&-6\\-4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&2\\-1&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-4\\-4&-4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-4\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-4\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-4\right)\right)=\left(-20\,;\,26\,;\,-24\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-20\right)\times8+26\times\left(-4\right)+\left(-24\right)\times\left(-11\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(-2\,;\,-4\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(3\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,-8\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(10\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\-8&-4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&3\\-4&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-9\\11&-8\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-4\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-8\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times11-3\times\left(-4\right)\,;\,3\times\left(-8\right)-\left(-9\right)\times11\right)=\left(20\,;\,-10\,;\,75\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=20\times10+\left(-10\right)\times1+75\times5=565$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-2\,;\,9\,;\,-4\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(8\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&-4\\0&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-2\\-3&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&9\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times0-9\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(-27\,;\,2\,;\,18\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-27\right)\times8+2\times1+18\times0=-214$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)\,,\ C\left(4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(4\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(5\,;\,-2\,;\,8\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(6\,;\,-6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&-3\\-2&8\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&4\\8&5\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\5&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times8-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times5-4\times8\,;\,4\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-5\right)\times5\right)=\left(-46\,;\,-47\,;\,17\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-46\right)\times6+\left(-47\right)\times\left(-6\right)+17\times\left(-3\right)=-45$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-5\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(11\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\4&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\3&11\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&5\\11&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times3-5\times4\,;\,5\times11-5\times3\,;\,5\times4-5\times11\right)=\left(-5\,;\,40\,;\,-35\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-5\right)\times1+40\times1+\left(-35\right)\times5=-140$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,4\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,1\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និង $D\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-9\,;\,-2\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-3\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-4\,;\,-6\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-9&-2\\0&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\-6&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-9\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-9\right)\times\left(-6\right)-\left(-2\right)\times0\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-0\times\left(-6\right)\,;\,0\times0-\left(-9\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(54\,;\,6\,;\,-27\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=54\times\left(-4\right)+6\times\left(-6\right)+\left(-27\right)\times\left(-6\right)=-90$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)\,,\ B\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(-5\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-6\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-2\,;\,-11\,;\,-5\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&5\\-2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\1&-6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-6&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times1-5\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-6\right)-2\times1\,;\,2\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-6\right)\right)=\left(8\,;\,-32\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=8\times\left(-2\right)+\left(-32\right)\times\left(-11\right)+\left(-16\right)\times\left(-5\right)=416$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(-3\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ B\left(6\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)\,,\ C\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ និង $D\left(15\,;\,8\,;\,5\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(9\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(9\,;\,10\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(18\,;\,13\,;\,6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}3&5\\10&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&9\\1&9\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}9&3\\9&10\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(3\times1-5\times10\,;\,5\times9-9\times1\,;\,9\times10-3\times9\right)=\left(-47\,;\,36\,;\,63\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-47\right)\times18+36\times13+63\times6=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,5\right)\,,\ C\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,-7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(2\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&5\\2&6\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\6&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&2\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times6-5\times2\,;\,5\times1-2\times6\,;\,2\times2-2\times1\right)=\left(2\,;\,-7\,;\,2\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=2\times0+\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)+2\times\left(-7\right)=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(4\,;\,-2\,;\,3\right)\,,\ B\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)\,,\ C\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ និង $D\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(-8\,;\,0\,;\,-6\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(-7\,;\,-1\,;\,-1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-8\\-1&-7\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-8&0\\-7&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-7\right)-\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-8\right)\times\left(-1\right)-0\times\left(-7\right)\right)=\left(-6\,;\,34\,;\,8\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)+34\times1+8\times\left(-7\right)=-16$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះខុសពី $0$ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{មិននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ទេ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យចំណុច $A\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)\,,\ B\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,6\right)\,,\ C\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,6\right)$ និង $D\left(5\,;\,3\,;\,7\right)$ ។ តើចំណុចទាំងបួននៅលើប្លង់តែមួយឬទេ ?

$\vec{AB}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AC}=\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)\,,\ \vec{AD}=\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-3&1\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&0\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-3\right)\times1-1\times3\,;\,1\times3-0\times1\,;\,0\times3-\left(-3\right)\times3\right)=\left(-6\,;\,3\,;\,9\right)$$
$$\left(\vec{AB}\wedge\vec{AC}\right)\cdot\vec{AD}=\left(-6\right)\times3+3\times0+9\times2=0$$
ផលគុណចម្រុះស្មើ $0$ ដូច្នេះវ៉ិចទ័រទាំងបីនៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ ។
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{A\,,\,B\,,\,C\,,\,D\ \text{នៅលើប្លង់តែមួយ}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,6\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(1\,;\,7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}7&-4\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-3&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&7\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(7\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times0-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times3-7\times0\right)=\left(-9\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-9\right)^2+3^2+3^2}=3 \sqrt{11}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{0^2+3^2+\left(-3\right)^2}=3 \sqrt{2}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{11}}{3 \sqrt{2}}=\frac{\sqrt{22}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{22}}{2}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(5\,;\,-1\,;\,6\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,-1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-2\,;\,5\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-7\,;\,6\,;\,-10\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-10\\1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-10&-7\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&6\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-10\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-10\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times1-6\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(4\,;\,23\,;\,11\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{4^2+23^2+11^2}=3 \sqrt{74}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{\left(-3\right)^2+1^2+\left(-1\right)^2}=\sqrt{11}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{74}}{\sqrt{11}}=\frac{3 \sqrt{814}}{11}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{814}}{11}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-1\,;\,-7\,;\,-6\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-6\\-2&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&-1\\-2&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-7\\-1&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-6\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-1\right)\right)=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{2^2+4^2+\left(-5\right)^2}=3 \sqrt{5}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{\left(-1\right)^2+\left(-2\right)^2+\left(-2\right)^2}=3$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{5}}{3}=\sqrt{5}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\sqrt{5}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&4\\0&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}4&-3\\4&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&2\\2&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times4-4\times0\,;\,4\times2-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-2\times2\right)=\left(8\,;\,20\,;\,-4\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{8^2+20^2+\left(-4\right)^2}=4 \sqrt{30}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{2^2+0^2+4^2}=2 \sqrt{5}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{4 \sqrt{30}}{2 \sqrt{5}}=2 \sqrt{6}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=2 \sqrt{6}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{5 \sqrt{5}}{\sqrt{21}}=\frac{5 \sqrt{105}}{21}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{5 \sqrt{105}}{21}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-3\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(5\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{10 \sqrt{1102}}{29}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(0\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,0\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-4\,;\,-2\,;\,1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-1\right)^2+\left(-1\right)^2+\left(-2\right)^2}=\sqrt{6}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{\left(-1\right)^2+1^2+0^2}=\sqrt{2}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{\sqrt{2}}=\sqrt{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\sqrt{3}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(3\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{4 \sqrt{19}}{\sqrt{34}}=\frac{2 \sqrt{646}}{17}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{2 \sqrt{646}}{17}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,1\,;\,2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(2\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(4\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-2\,;\,-1\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-1\,;\,-1\,;\,3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-1&3\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-1\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$

$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{0^2+9^2+3^2}=3 \sqrt{10}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{4^2+1^2+\left(-3\right)^2}=\sqrt{26}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{10}}{\sqrt{26}}=\frac{3 \sqrt{65}}{13}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{65}}{13}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,2\,;\,3\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-5\right)$ ។

$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{3^2+\left(-18\right)^2+9^2}=3 \sqrt{46}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{3^2+1^2+1^2}=\sqrt{11}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{46}}{\sqrt{11}}=\frac{3 \sqrt{506}}{11}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{506}}{11}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(1\,;\,2\,;\,1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-4\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-5\,;\,9\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}9&2\\2&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-5\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&9\\1&2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(9\times1-2\times2\,;\,2\times1-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times2-9\times1\right)=\left(5\,;\,7\,;\,-19\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{5^2+7^2+\left(-19\right)^2}=\sqrt{435}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{1^2+2^2+1^2}=\sqrt{6}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-3\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(0\,;\,-7\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-7&-4\\-2&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&0\\0&2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-7\\2&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-7\right)\times0-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times2-0\times0\,;\,0\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-7\right)\times2\right)=\left(-8\,;\,-8\,;\,14\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-8\right)^2+\left(-8\right)^2+14^2}=18\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{2^2+\left(-2\right)^2+0^2}=2 \sqrt{2}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{18}{2 \sqrt{2}}=\frac{9 \sqrt{2}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{9 \sqrt{2}}{2}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(6\,;\,1\,;\,3\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(3\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-3\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\0&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-3\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&5\\1&0\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times1-2\times0\,;\,2\times1-\left(-3\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times0-5\times1\right)=\left(5\,;\,5\,;\,-5\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{5^2+5^2+\left(-5\right)^2}=5 \sqrt{3}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{1^2+0^2+1^2}=\sqrt{2}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{5 \sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{5 \sqrt{6}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{5 \sqrt{6}}{2}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(2\,;\,5\,;\,-2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-2\,;\,-2\,;\,-2\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&-2\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-2\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(0\,;\,12\,;\,-12\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{0^2+12^2+\left(-12\right)^2}=12 \sqrt{2}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{\left(-3\right)^2+3^2+3^2}=3 \sqrt{3}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{12 \sqrt{2}}{3 \sqrt{3}}=\frac{4 \sqrt{6}}{3}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{4 \sqrt{6}}{3}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-3\,;\,6\,;\,4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-5\,;\,6\,;\,1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-2\,;\,0\,;\,-3\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&-3\\4&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-3&-2\\-1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-2&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(0\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-3\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-2\right)\times4-0\times3\right)=\left(12\,;\,-11\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{12^2+\left(-11\right)^2+\left(-8\right)^2}=\sqrt{329}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{3^2+4^2+\left(-1\right)^2}=\sqrt{26}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{329}}{\sqrt{26}}=\frac{\sqrt{8554}}{26}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{8554}}{26}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,-3\,;\,0\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(4\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(1\,;\,6\,;\,-4\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}6&-4\\-3&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&1\\-3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&6\\4&-3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(6\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-4\right)\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times4-1\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,1\times\left(-3\right)-6\times4\right)=\left(-30\,;\,-13\,;\,-27\right)$$

$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{1798}}{\sqrt{34}}=\frac{\sqrt{15283}}{17}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{15283}}{17}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(6\,;\,5\,;\,0\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-2\,;\,6\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{2 \sqrt{30}}{\sqrt{6}}=2 \sqrt{5}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=2 \sqrt{5}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(3\,;\,-1\,;\,-4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(1\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(0\,;\,-2\,;\,0\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-3\,;\,-1\,;\,4\right)$ ។

$$=\left(\left(-1\right)\times\left(-1\right)-4\times3\,;\,4\times1-\left(-3\right)\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,\left(-3\right)\times3-\left(-1\right)\times1\right)=\left(-11\,;\,1\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-11\right)^2+1^2+\left(-8\right)^2}=\sqrt{186}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{1^2+3^2+\left(-1\right)^2}=\sqrt{11}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{186}}{\sqrt{11}}=\frac{\sqrt{2046}}{11}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{2046}}{11}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(5\,;\,-4\,;\,0\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,4\,;\,-1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{4^2+\left(-14\right)^2+\left(-48\right)^2}=2 \sqrt{629}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{2^2+4^2+\left(-1\right)^2}=\sqrt{21}$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{2 \sqrt{13209}}{21}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{22 \sqrt{17}}{17}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(1\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(0\,;\,-5\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{10761}}{17}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-4\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,4\,;\,4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,-3\,;\,-2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(4\,;\,2\,;\,4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,5\,;\,2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(1\,;\,-2\,;\,-1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-2\,;\,1\,;\,6\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(4\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,0\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,0\,;\,-1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(1\,;\,-3\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,3\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-4\,;\,3\,;\,6\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(1\,;\,5\,;\,6\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(0\,;\,-3\,;\,3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(3\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-1\,;\,-2\,;\,2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-3\,;\,-2\,;\,4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-3\,;\,4\,;\,2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-5\,;\,3\,;\,3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(3\,;\,-5\,;\,3\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,2\,;\,-1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,-4\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,4\,;\,0\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,0\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(4\,;\,-4\,;\,-2\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(3\,;\,3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(5\,;\,6\,;\,5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-3\,;\,2\,;\,6\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-5\,;\,0\,;\,-5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-1\,;\,3\,;\,-2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,-5\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(2\,;\,1\,;\,-2\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-5\,;\,-3\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-1\,;\,-5\,;\,-3\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-3\,;\,3\,;\,0\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(1\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-2&7\\-1&-1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}7&2\\-1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}2&-2\\-3&-1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-2\right)\times\left(-1\right)-7\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,7\times\left(-3\right)-2\times\left(-1\right)\,;\,2\times\left(-1\right)-\left(-2\right)\times\left(-3\right)\right)=\left(9\,;\,-19\,;\,-8\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{9^2+\left(-19\right)^2+\left(-8\right)^2}=\sqrt{506}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{\left(-3\right)^2+\left(-1\right)^2+\left(-1\right)^2}=\sqrt{11}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{506}}{\sqrt{11}}=\sqrt{46}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\sqrt{46}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-2\,;\,-5\,;\,6\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,-2\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(3\,;\,-3\,;\,-1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(5\,;\,2\,;\,-7\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}2&-7\\-2&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-7&5\\-3&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}5&2\\3&-2\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(2\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-7\right)\times\left(-2\right)\,;\,\left(-7\right)\times3-5\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,5\times\left(-2\right)-2\times3\right)=\left(-20\,;\,-6\,;\,-16\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-20\right)^2+\left(-6\right)^2+\left(-16\right)^2}=2 \sqrt{173}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{3^2+\left(-2\right)^2+\left(-3\right)^2}=\sqrt{22}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{2 \sqrt{173}}{\sqrt{22}}=\frac{\sqrt{3806}}{11}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{3806}}{11}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-3\,;\,-4\,;\,-1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-4\,;\,1\,;\,-5\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}5&-4\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-4&-1\\4&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&5\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(5\times4-\left(-4\right)\times3\,;\,\left(-4\right)\times\left(-2\right)-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-5\times\left(-2\right)\right)=\left(32\,;\,12\,;\,7\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{32^2+12^2+7^2}=\sqrt{1217}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{\left(-2\right)^2+3^2+4^2}=\sqrt{29}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{1217}}{\sqrt{29}}=\frac{\sqrt{35293}}{29}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{35293}}{29}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(-4\,;\,-5\,;\,2\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(1\,;\,1\,;\,-3\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(4\,;\,-1\,;\,-3\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}4&-5\\1&-3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-5&8\\-3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}8&4\\1&1\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(4\times\left(-3\right)-\left(-5\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-5\right)\times1-8\times\left(-3\right)\,;\,8\times1-4\times1\right)=\left(-7\,;\,19\,;\,4\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-7\right)^2+19^2+4^2}=\sqrt{426}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{1^2+1^2+\left(-3\right)^2}=\sqrt{11}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{426}}{\sqrt{11}}=\frac{\sqrt{4686}}{11}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\sqrt{4686}}{11}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(5\,;\,1\,;\,4\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(3\,;\,4\,;\,1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-1\,;\,2\,;\,5\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}1&1\\4&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}1&-6\\1&3\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&1\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(1\times1-1\times4\,;\,1\times3-\left(-6\right)\times1\,;\,\left(-6\right)\times4-1\times3\right)=\left(-3\,;\,9\,;\,-27\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-3\right)^2+9^2+\left(-27\right)^2}=3 \sqrt{91}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{3^2+4^2+1^2}=\sqrt{26}$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{91}}{\sqrt{26}}=\frac{3 \sqrt{14}}{2}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{3 \sqrt{14}}{2}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(0\,;\,5\,;\,1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(0\,;\,3\,;\,4\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(-1\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$

$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}-5&0\\3&4\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-1\\4&0\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-1&-5\\0&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
$$=\left(\left(-5\right)\times4-0\times3\,;\,0\times0-\left(-1\right)\times4\,;\,\left(-1\right)\times3-\left(-5\right)\times0\right)=\left(-20\,;\,4\,;\,-3\right)$$
$$\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|=\sqrt{\left(-20\right)^2+4^2+\left(-3\right)^2}=5 \sqrt{17}\,,\quad\|\vec{u}\|=\sqrt{0^2+3^2+4^2}=5$$
$$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{5 \sqrt{17}}{5}=\sqrt{17}$$
ដូចនេះ $\boxed{d\left(M,(d)\right)=\sqrt{17}}$ ។

ក្នុងលំហប្រដាប់ដោយតម្រុយអរតូណរម៉ាល់ $(O,\vec{i},\vec{j},\vec{k})$ គេឱ្យបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ កាត់តាម $A\left(6\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ មានវ៉ិចទ័រប្រាប់ទិស $\vec{u}=\left(-2\,;\,3\,;\,1\right)$ និងចំណុច $M\left(0\,;\,0\,;\,1\right)$ ។ គណនាចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ ។

ចម្ងាយពី $M$ ទៅបន្ទាត់ $(d)$ គឺ $$d\left(M,(d)\right)=\frac{\left\|\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}\right\|}{\|\vec{u}\|}$$
$\vec{AM}=\left(-6\,;\,0\,;\,0\right)$ ។
$$\vec{AM}\wedge\vec{u}=\left(\begin{vmatrix}0&0\\3&1\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}0&-6\\1&-2\end{vmatrix}\,;\,\begin{vmatrix}-6&0\\-2&3\end{vmatrix}\right)$$
